question: गृहणीष्व पिठरं तानं मया दत्त नराधिप। यावद् वय॑ति पाञ्चाली पात्रेणानेन सुव्रत॥ फलमूलामिषं शाकं संस्कृतं यन्महानसे। चतुर्विधं तदन्नाद्यमक्षय्यं ते भविष्यति॥ इतश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे भूयो राज्यमवाप्स्यसि।
answer: O king, accept this copper vessel that I present you. O man of excellent vows, so long the Panchala excellent vows, so long the Panchala Princess (Draupadi) will hold this vessel without partaking of it contents-fruits, roots, meat and vegetables, cooked in your kitchen-the four kinds of food, shall from this day be (there) inexhaustible. You shall regain your kingdom on the fourteenth year from this.

question: पुष्पेषूपहतेष्वेवं रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः॥ अवतीर्णो नदी स्नातुं गङ्गामिव महागजः। तत्र स्नात्वा च विधिवज्जप्त्वा जप्यमनुत्तमम्॥ नर्मदासलिलात्तस्मादुत्ततार स रावणः।
answer: Flowers being thus collected, Rāvana, the king of Rākşasas descended into the Narmadā for bathing like a huge elephant into the Gangā. And having bathed he got up, reciting excellent incantations.

question: यथा ह्यनुदका नद्यो यथा वाप्यतृणं वनम्। अगोपाला यथा गावस्तथा राष्ट्रमराजकम्॥
answer: Even as a river without water, a wood without grass, a herd of kine without a keeper, is a kingdom without a king.

question: ज्योत्स्नाकालीति यामाहुर्द्वितीयां रूपतः श्रियम्। अदित्याश्चैव यः पुत्रो ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठः कृतः स्मृतः॥
answer: She (the daughter of Soma) is known as Jyotsnakali who has been said to be second Lakshmi or Sri in point of beauty; and she, it is within our recollection, had chosen the eldest son of Aditi as her husband (before this).

question: स्तं कीचकं क्रोधसरागनेत्रः। मुद्धान्तनेत्रं व्यसुमुत्ससर्ज॥
answer: Saying this, that foremost of men, with eyes reddened with ire, left off Kichaka, whose dress and ornaments had been thrown off his body, whose eyes were rolling and who was even then trembling.

question: मृतः श्रूयेत यो जीवः परेयुः पशवो यदा। इष्टिरष्टाकपालेन कार्या सुरभिमतेऽग्नये॥
answer: If at the time of the Agnihotra sacrifice, the death of any creature is spoken of or any animal dies, then rectification must be made with the performance of the Ashtakapala rites in the honour of the fire Surabhiman.

question: यदुरुवाच जरायां बहवो दोषाः पानभोजनकारिताः। तस्माजरां न ते राजन् ग्रहीष्य इति मे मतिः॥
answer: Over are Yadu said: There are many inconveniences in old age about eating and drinking. Therefore, O king, I shall not take your decrepitude upon me. This is my determination.

question: ततः स वाक्यैर्मधुरैर्हनूमतो निशम्य हृष्टो भरतः कृताञ्जलिः। उवाच वाणी मनसः प्रहर्षिणी चिरस्य पूर्णं खलु मे मनोरथः॥
answer: Thereupon being delighted with the sweet accents of Hanumān, Bharata addressed him, with folded hands, with words affording delight, saying, "After a long time my desire has been fulfilled.”

question: तर्पितास्ते शरैस्तस्य भारद्वाजस्य धन्विनः। अतिथेयं गृहं प्राप्य नृपतेऽतिथयो यथा॥
answer: Then like the guests becoming gratified with hospitality of their hosts, those heroes were gratified with the shafts sped at them by that bowman viz., the son of Bharadvaja.

question: युगादिकृद् युगावर्तो नैकमायो महाशनः। अदृश्योऽव्यक्तरूपश्च सहस्रजिदनन्तजित्॥
answer: He who sets the four Cycles to begin their course. He who causes the Cycles to continually revolve as on a wheel. He who is gifted with various kinds of illusion. He who is the greatest of eaters. He who is incapable of being seized. He who is manifest. he who subjugates thousands of foes. He who subjugates innumerable foes. (300-307) sets fafgree: fred: FYTGUST TEHT qu:1

question: तमाशीभिः प्रशस्ताभिः प्रेषयामास रावणः। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषैः सैन्यैश्चापि वरायुधैः॥
answer: Rāvana sent him with choice benedictions, while he caused kettle-drums and conchs to be sounded and force equipped with excellent weapons, to accompany Kumbhakarņa.

question: शतचन्द्रं च तचर्म गौतमस्तस्य भारत। व्यधमत् सायकैस्तूर्णं तत उचुक्रुशुर्जनाः॥
answer: The son of Gautama then quickly cut-off with his arrows the shield of Prishata's son that was adorned with a hundred moons. At this his people made a loud uproar.

question: तूष्णीं बभूव राजेन्द्र रुजासौ विह्वलो भृशम्। तथा दृष्ट्वा तु राजानं बाष्पशोकसमन्वितम्॥ द्रौणिः क्रोधेन जज्वाल यथा वह्निर्जगत्क्षये।
answer: Seeing the king in tear and grief, Drona's son burned in anger like the fire at the universal dissolution.

question: इति ब्रुवन्तं वचनं सरोषं रामं महात्मानमदीनसत्त्वम्। उवाच पथ्यं पुनरास्तिकं च सत्यं वचः सानुनयं च विप्रः॥
answer: When the magnanimous Rama of undiminished strength had wrathfully said this, that Vipra with supplications again spoke words fraught with morality and high spiritual truth.

question: कच्चिदग्निषु ते युक्तो विधिज्ञो मतिमानृजुः। हुतं च होष्यमाणं च काले वेदयते सदा॥
answer: Do intelligent and sincere people cognizant of the rules, look after the sacrificial fire? And do they regularly inform you of the proper seasons for performing the fire-sacrifice?

question: स मण्डलीकृतधनू रावणिः समितिंजयः॥ हरीनभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः परं लाघवमास्थितः।
answer: That victor in battle— Rāvana's son fired with wrath, summoning all his celerity, slaughtered monkeys, drawing his bow into a circle.

question: कस्मिन् धर्मे मया स्थेयं प्रजा: संरक्षता मुने॥ कथं च वर्तमानो वैन च्यवेयं स्वधर्मतः।
answer: Yudhishthira said : ORishi, if I am to protect my subjects, what course of action must I follow? How should I behave, so that I may not fall away from the duties of my order?

question: यथा नदति सुग्रीवो बलवानेष वानरः। मन्ये चाश्रयवान् प्राप्तो न त्वं निष्क्रान्तुमर्हसि॥
answer: "From the manner in which this powerful monkey Sugriva is roaring, I think he has received assistance. (Therefore) do not go out."

question: प्रकाशितस्त्वं स्वगुणैर्यशोगर्भगभस्तिभिः। शशाङ्ककरसंस्पर्श«द्यैरात्मप्रकाशितैः॥
answer: You shine with the effulgence of your own merits covered by fame,-with an effulgence that is as sweet as that of the moon.

question: तान् हृष्टान् पुरुषव्याघ्रान् पञ्चालान् पाण्डवैः सह।। १७ ब्रुवतोऽसदृशं तत्र प्रोवाच मधुसूदनः। न न्याय्यं निहतं शत्रु भूयो हन्तुं नराधिपाः॥ असकृद् वाग्भिरुयाभिनिहतो होष मन्दधीः।
answer: Whilst, viz., Panchalas and the Pandavas, all filled with joy were thus expressing themselves, the slayer of Madhu addressed them, saying-Ye kings, it is not becoming to kill a slain fe with such cruel words repeatedly. This wicked man has already been slain.

question: कृतशास्त्रानुगा बुद्धिर्मा भूत् तस्य कदाचन। सत्यसंधः सतां श्रेष्ठो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
answer: May the sense of him never follow scripture, that had approved the exile into the woods of that foremost of the good, the noble Rāma intent senses. on truth!

question: एवं दुर्मर्षितो राजा स मात्रा बभ्रुवाहनः । मनश्चक्रे महातेजा युद्धाय भरतर्षभ।॥ संना काञ्चनं वर्म शिरस्त्राणं च भानुमत्। तूणीरशतसम्बाधमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्॥ सर्वोपकरणोपेतं युक्तमश्वैर्मनोजवैः। स चक्रोपस्करं श्रीमान् हेमभाण्डपरिष्कृतम्॥
answer: Thus was king Babhruvahana incited against his father by his (step) mother. At last, gifted as he was with great energy, he made up his mind, O chief of the Bharatas, to fight Dhananjaya, Putting on his armour of bright gold and his shining head-dress, he got upon an excellent car which had hundreds of quivers ready on it. That car was equipped with necessaries for battle and had horses yoked to it which were fleet like the mind. It had excellent wheels and a strong Upashkara, and was adorned with golden ornaments of every sort.

question: ते सर्वे विनिवर्तन्तां ये च मिष्टभुजो द्विजाः। पक्वान्नलेह्यपानानां मांसानां च विकल्पकाः॥
answer: Let those Brahmanas also that live on sweet meats, that desire cooked food and the food that is sucked or drunk and meat desist (from following me).

question: न क्षस्यति पिता पुत्रं पुत्रश्च पितरं तथा। भार्याश्च पतिशुश्रूषां न करिष्यन्ति संक्षय॥
answer: Fathers will not forgive their sons and the sons will not forgive their fathers; at this time wives will not serve their husbands.

question: अपतन्त रथौघाश्च तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः। तत् सैन्यं भयसंविग्नं ददाह युधि भारत॥
answer: Thousands and thousands of car divisions then fell on that field; and ( Bharata, the illustrious God of fire then consumed that army of the Pandavas.

question: दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि बदर्यामेष शाश्वतः। तपश्चचार विपुलं सह गाण्डीवधन्त्रना॥
answer: Accompanied by the holder of Gandiva, Vasudeva practised eternal penances in the hermitage of Badari for ten thousand years.

question: तन्नारदवचः श्रुत्वा साब्रवीदृषिसंसदि॥ तपसोऽर्धं प्रयच्छामि पाणिग्राहस्य सत्तम।
answer: Hearing these words of Narada, the old lady went to an assemblage of Rishis and said, 'I shall give him half my penances who will marry ine.'

question: आस्याद् वमन् पावकं स संवर्तकसम तदा। तान् सर्वान् नृपतेः पुत्रानदहत् स्वेन तेजसा॥
answer: Thereupon he vomited from his mouth the fire, that was like the Samvartaka (appearing at the end of the Yoga); and he burnt the sons of the king by these his own flames.

question: के वानुरक्ताः राजानः के भयात् समुपाश्रिताः। मध्यस्थदोषाः के चैषामिति नित्यं विचिन्तयेत्॥
answer: You should always determine who amongst the dependent kings is truly devoted to you, and who is loyal to you from fear, and who amongst them has faults.

question: प्रासादेषु विचित्रेषु गोष्ठीषूपवनेषु च। कथा विचित्राः कुर्वाणाः पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः।।२९।
answer: It is in beautiful places, assemblies and gardens where beautiful speeches are to be made that the learned men seem to be in their proper places.

question: पतनारोहणमिदं कथयिष्यन्ति ये नराः। विषमाण्यपि ते प्राप्तास्तरिष्यन्ति न संशयः॥
answer: Those men, who will converse on this story of your fall and recession, will attain salvation though affected by sins; there is no doubt of it.

question: देवदानवरक्षोभिः पिशाचपतगोरगैः। पूज्यमानं महातेजा दिशागजमपश्यत॥
answer: He found an exceedingly powerful elephant belonging to the cardinal point, worshipped by deities, and Dānavas, and Rākşasas, and goblins, and birds, and Uragas.

question: तान् पूर्वेन्द्रानभिवीक्ष्याभिरूपान् शक्रात्मजं चेन्द्ररूपं निशम्य। प्रीतो राजा दुपदो विस्मितश्च दिव्यां मायां तामवेक्ष्याप्रमेयाम्॥
answer: Seeing the (four others) Pandavas in the forms of the (present) Indra sprang from Indra himself, the king Drupada was exceedingly pleased. He was greatly surprised on seeing the celestial manifestation of Maya.

question: तथा स वीरो हत्वा तं ततोऽन्यान् समुपाद्रवत्॥ संसुप्तानेव राजेन्द्र तत्र तत्र महारथान्।
answer: Having killed Yudhamanyu thus, that hero went against the other car-warriors of the king, who were all asleep.

question: न चाहं समरे तात कृतवर्मा न चैव हि। अनिर्जित्य रणे पाण्डून् न च यास्यामि कर्हिचित्।। १८
answer: Neither I, O son, nor Kritavarman will ever retreat from battle without having defeated the Pandus.

question: तां न देवा न गन्धर्वा नासुरोरगराक्षसाः। उत्सहन्तेऽन्यथा कर्तुं प्रतिज्ञां सव्यसाचिनः॥
answer: Neither the Gods, nor the Gandharvas, nor the Asuras, nor the reptiles nor the Rakshasas would venture to baffle that Vow of Savyasachin (Arjuna).

question: किं मया मनसा ध्यातमशुभं धर्मदूषणम्। येनाहं चलित: स्थानादिति राजा व्यचिन्तयत्॥
answer: "What inauspicious and sinful thought was entertained by me in my mind, in consequence of which I have been turned out from my place in heaven?” Thus did the king think within himself.

question: वसिष्ठ उवाच बलस्थश्चासि राजा च बाहुवीर्यश्च क्षत्रियः॥ यथेच्छसि तथा क्षिप्रं कुरु मा त्वं विचारय।
answer: Vasishtha said: You are a powerful king, you are a Kshatriya possessing great strength of arms; do what you desire without delay and without stopping to consider over it.

question: सर्प उवाच नहुषो नाम राजाहमासं पूर्वस्तवानघ। प्रथितः पञ्चमः सोमादायोः पुत्रो नराधिप।॥
answer: The snake replied O sinless being, O monarch, I was your ancestor, the son of Ayu and fifth in descent from Soma and was known by the name of king Nahusha.

question: तव प्रसादाद् भगवन्निदं वर्तेत् त्रिधा जगत्। अनागतममीनं च यच्च सम्प्रति वर्तते॥
answer: Through your grace, O almighty Lord, the universe is divided in three divisions, viz., the Past, the Present and the Future. Let it remain as it is;

question: राघवस्य हरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः। कस्मिन्देशे किमाश्रित्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः॥
answer: Do you relate truly to me, how and in what country the union between Rāghava and the monkeys was brought about.

question: महर्षीणां वधो घोरः सर्वदेवैश्च विग्रहः। अभिमानश्च रोषश्च वैरत्वं प्रतिकूलता॥ एते दोषा मम भ्रातुर्जीवितैश्वर्यनाशनाः। गुणान्प्रच्छादयामासुः पर्वतानिव तोयदाः॥
answer: The dreadful slaughter of sages, rebellion against all the gods, overweening conceit, anger long-continued enmity, and running amuck of counsel, these sins are sapping the life and fortune of my brother; and they have hidden his virtues even as clouds cover a mountain.

question: अथान्ये धनुषी चित्रे प्रगृह्य च महाशरान्। सात्यकिं छादयन्तौ तौ चेरतुर्लघु सुष्ठु च॥
answer: Then having grasped two other beautiful bows and most effective shafts, they two, too, shrounded Satyaki (with the arrows) and roved about in the field with immense activity and expertness.

question: मोक्षितस्ते बलश्लाघिन्यस्मादेवं विभीषणः। विमुच्य राक्षसं शक्तिस्त्वयीयं विनिपात्यते॥
answer: O you proud of your prowess! as Vibhīşana has this wise been delivered by you, passing by the Raksasa, this dart, discharged from my bludgeon of an arms, will depart depriving you of your life.

question: पत्तींश्च निहतान् वीर शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। धनुर्भृतश्चर्मभृतः शयानान् रुधिरोक्षितान्॥
answer: Hundreds and thousands of foot-soldiers, O hero, are lying slain (on the ground) in a pool of blood wielding their bows and shields.

question: सुदक्षिणश्च निहतः स च राजा श्रुतायुधः। श्रुतायुश्चाच्युतायुश्चम्लेच्छाश्चायुतशो हताः॥
answer: as He by whom Sudakshina and king Shrutayusha have been slain, also Shrutayusha and Achytayusha and myriads of Mlechchas also have been slain.

question: लोके चेदं सर्वलोकस्य न ा च्चातुर्वण्र्यं वेदवादाश्च न स्युः। सर्वाश्चज्याः सर्वलोकक्रियाश्च सद्यः सर्वे चाश्रमस्थान वै स्युः॥
answer: If Vishnu be not pleased, the happiness of all men in heaven, the merit arising from the duties prescribed by the four orders, the injunctions of the Vedas, all kinds of sacrifices, and all other religions acts of men, and all the duties of the various modes of life, become lost.

question: इत्यब्रवीदर्जुनो योत्स्यमानो गाण्डीवधन्वा लोहितपद्मनेत्रः। न चेद् राज्यं मुञ्चति धार्तराष्ट्रो युधिष्ठिरस्याजमीढस्य राज्ञः॥
answer: Thus spoke Arjuna eager for fight armed with the Gandharva-bow and with his lotus eyes looking red-If the son of Dhritarashtra does not surrender the kingdom of Yudhishthira, the king of Ajmida.

question: स लक्ष्मणं शोकवशाभिपन्न शोके निमग्नो विपुले तु रामः। मुष्णं विनिःश्वस्य रुदन् सशोकम्॥
answer: Sunk in the abyss of grief, Rāma, sighing hot and weeping piteously, spoke to Laksmana who was equally aggrieved, words worthy of being said on that occasion.

question: अधर्मज्ञस्य विलयं प्रजा गच्छन्ति निग्रहात्। राजा मूलं त्रिवर्गस्य स्वप्रमत्तोऽनुपालयेत्॥
answer: If the king happens to be sinful, his subjects, for his oppressions, meet with destruction. The king is the root of threefold objects, i.e., Virtue, Wealth, and Pleasure. He should protect his subject carefully.

question: मयूरहंसयुक्तं च विमानं लभते नरः। सप्तर्षीणां सदा लोके सोऽप्सरोभिर्वसेत् सह॥
answer: Proceeding to the region of the seven Rishis, he lives there, surrounded by Apsaras of great beauty. It is wellknown that such residence lasts for full three Padmas of years.

question: यत्रार्जुनो द्वारवतीमेत्य वृष्णिविनाकृताम्। दृष्ट्वा विषादमगमत्परां चार्तिं नरर्षभः॥
answer: Then is described the arrival of Arjuna, the foremost of men, at Dwarka and his sorrow and affliction seeing the city destitute of the Vrishnis.

question: क्षीणः सर्वार्थहीनश्च निर्घातिबन्धुवर्जितः। को दिशं प्रतिपत्स्यामि दीनः शत्रुवशं गतः॥
answer: Now I am weak, destitute of all resources and deprived of all kinsmen and left my friends and also I am poor and possessed by my foes-To what point of the horizon shall I depart?

question: ततस्तु सुमहाप्राज्ञो माल्यवान्नाम राक्षसः। रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा इति मातामहोऽब्रवीत्॥
answer: Then the maternal grand sire (of Rāvaņa), possessed of exceeding wisdom, named Malyavān, hearing his words, said.

question: ब्रह्मणः पदमव्यक्तं मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः। नाहं पुनरिहागन्ता मर्त्यलोकं परंतप॥
answer: Indeed, I shall come by the condition, which is unmanifest, of Brahma. Do not doubt this. O scorcher of enemies. I shall not return to this world of mortal creatures.

question: जनमेजय उवाच कथं युयुधिरे वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। पार्थिवाः सुमहात्मानो नानादेशसमागताः॥
answer: Janamejaya said How did those great warriors, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas and the other illustrious kings who assembled from various countries fight?

question: कस्य प्रसादाद् दारांश्च पुत्रांश्चैव गृहाणि च। इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्धार्थाः सुखिनो वयम्॥
answer: By whose favour shall we, crowned with success and rendered happy, returning from this place, shall behold our wives and our son, and our homes?

question: इच्छतोपेक्षितो नाशः कुरूणां मधुसूदन। यस्मात् त्वया महाबाहो फलं तस्मादवाप्नुहि॥
answer: Since deliberately, O slayer of Madhu, you were indifferent to this universal destruction therefore, O mighty-armed one, you should feel the consequences of this act.

question: ध्वजेनोच्छ्रितदण्डेन गृध्रराजेन राजितम्। लोहितापताकं त अन्त्रमालाविभूषितम्॥
answer: A prince of vultures sat on its towering standard. (That car) was adorned with red flags furnished with rows of bones.

question: पश्याश्रमपदं रम्यं दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्। एषां तपस्विनां वीर तपसा भावितात्मनाम्॥
answer: Behold the beauteous asylums, O hero. of these pure-spirited ascetics inhabiting the forest of Dandaka.

question: राजसूयाश्वमेधानां क्रतूनां दक्षिणावताम्। आहर्ता पार्थिवश्रेष्ठः पृथुचार्वञ्चितेक्षणः॥ ब्रह्मण्यः साधुवृत्तश्च सत्यवागनसूयकः। शीलवान् वीर्यसम्पन्नः पृथुश्रीधर्मविच्छुचिः॥ सम्यग् गोप्ता विदर्भाणां निर्जितारिगणः प्रभुः। तस्य मां विद्धि तनयां भगवंस्त्वामुपस्थिताम्॥
answer: That foremnost of the descendants of Prithu, performed the Rajasuya sacrifice and the horse-sacrifice accompanied by profuse Dakshinas. Possessing large and beautiful eyes graced with arching brows, well-versed in the Vedas, of pious nature, true-speaking, free from jealously, of good character, endued with prowess, of immense prosperity, acquainted with all morality and pure, that lord defeating all his adversaries completely protect the people of Vidharbha. O mighty one! know me to be his daughter thus approaching you.

question: शिष्टाचारे मनः कृत्वा प्रतिष्ठाप्य च सर्वशः। यामयं लभते वृत्तिं सा न शक्या हतोऽन्यथा॥
answer: Once can wholly obtain credit by directing the heart towards virtuous behaviours. This he gains only be practising the above four; Otherwise to gain this becomes impossible.

question: तासां मध्यात् समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीतामसितेक्षमाम्॥ जनकस्यात्मजां साध्वीं स्नुषां दशरथस्य च।
answer: Then sitting up in their midst, Trijatā spoke, “Do you without delay fall to your own selves; but never (eat up) the dark-eyed Sītā, the chaste daughter to Janaka and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha."

question: नाहं तामनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरोऽपि सन्। महात्मा च विनीतश्च किं पुन तिमान् महान्॥
answer: A despicable monkey as I am, I do not grieve for her,-and what again shall I say of one that is magnanimous, endued with meekness and firmness, and great?

question: जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः केशा दन्ता जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः। चक्षुःश्रोत्रे च जीर्येते तृष्णैका न तु जीर्यते॥
answer: With age, man's hair grows grey; his teeth become loose; his eyes and ears too become dim in action; but the only thing that does not decline is his desire for enjoyments.

question: तत: प्राप्तं त्वया वीर ग्रहणं शत्रुभिर्बलात्॥ मोक्षितश्चासि धर्मज्ञैः पाण्डवैर्न च लज्जसे।
answer: O hero, you were forcibly taken captive by the enemy; you were rescued by the virtuous Pandavas, but still you were not ashamed.

question: गतिः पतिः समस्थाया विषमे च पिता गतिः। प्रव्रज्या हि सुदुःखेयं सुकुमार्या विशेषतः॥
answer: A husband is a woman's refuge under smoother circumstances and in a difficult situation a father is the refuge; roaming about is a hard task, especially for those brought up in luxury.

question: लङ्कायास्तूत्तरद्वारं शैलशृङ्गमिवोत्रतम्। रामः सहानुजो धन्वी जुगोप च रुरोध च॥ लङ्कामुपनिविष्टस्तु रामो दशरथात्मजः। लक्ष्णानुचरो वीरः पुरीं रावणपालिताम्॥ उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः। नान्यो रामाद्धि तद्वारं समर्थः परिरक्षितुम्॥ रावणाधिष्ठितं भीमं वरुणेनेव सागरम्। सायुधै राक्षसैीमैरभिगुप्तं समन्ततः॥ लघूनां त्रासजननं पातालमिव दानवैः। विन्यस्तानि च योधाना बहूनि विविधानि च॥ ददर्शायुधजालानि तथैव कवचानि च।
answer: Coming to Lanka ruled by Ravana, that hero, Rama, son to Dasaratha, along with Laksmana, remained stationed at the Northern gate, where Råvaņa used to reside. None save Rāma was competent to protect that dreadful gate, where Råvaņa used to reside and guarded by Rāvana himself, like the Ocean guarded by Varuna, and protected on all sides by terrible Rākşasas equipped with weapons; capable of striking terror into the weak; like to the nether regions guarded by Danavas. And (Rama) saw there : many and various arms and mail of the warriors, ranged together.

question: स मालया तदा वीरः शुशुभे कण्ठसक्तया। श्रीमानिव महाशैलो मलयो मेघमालया॥
answer: Thereupon that hero adorned with that garland on his neck shone like the beautiful and mighty Malaya mountain encircled with the clouds. in

question: तं विना कैकयीपुत्रं भरतं धर्मचारिणाम्। न मे स्नानं बहुमतं वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च॥
answer: Without Bharata the son of Kaikeyi, ever performing pious rites, I do not value bathing or these clothes and ornaments.

question: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय वेगघ्नं रुक्मभूषितम्। चित्ररूपधर चक्रे चित्रसेनं शरोर्मिभिः॥
answer: Then he (Shrutakarman) took up another bow, that was capable of casting away fierce arrows and was adorned with gold, made Chitrasena, by piercing him with the torrents of shafts, wear a varied appearance. to

question: ययातिरुवाच ययातिरस्मि राजर्षिः क्षीणपुण्यश्च्युतो दिवः। पतेयं सत्स्विति ध्यायन् भवत्सु पतितस्ततः॥
answer: Yayati said I am the royal Rishi Yayati and the religious merit acquired by me being spent up have been turned out from heaven; and wishing in my mind that I should fall among the good, I have fallen among you.

question: तैक्ष्ण्यं जिह्मत्वमादाल्भ्यं सत्यमार्जवमेव च। मध्यस्थः सत्त्वमातिष्ठंस्तथा वै सुखमृच्छति॥
answer: Keenness, crookedness, truth, and sincerity, are the qualities which should be present in him. He should practise impartially the qualities of goodness if he is to acquire happiness.

question: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्मध्ये न्यस्याम जनकात्मजाम्। किं व्यलीकैस्तु तान् सर्वान् वानरान् वानरर्षभान्॥ वयमेव हि गत्वा तान् हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवान्। राघवं द्रष्टुमर्हामः सुग्रीवं सहलक्ष्मणम्॥
answer: And we shall place Janaka's daughter between Rāma and Lakşmana. what is the use of putting the other residents of Kiskindha into trouble? It therefore behove us alone to go to Lankā and after slaying the best of the Rākşasas, to see Sugriva, Rāma and Laksmana."

question: वासुदेववचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। मुहूर्तं चिन्तयित्वा तु ततो दारुणमाहवम्॥ प्रायाद् द्रुतममित्रनो यत्र भीमो व्यवस्थितः। विनिप्रंस्तावकान् योधान् व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥५३
answer: Hearing these words of Vasudeva, the virtuous king Yudhishthira reflected for a moment and then proceeded towards the spot where the battle was raging hot and furious and where, Bhima, the slayer of his foes, taking up his station, was destroying your warriors like the (grim) Destroyer with gaping mouth.

question: प्रासादै रत्नचित्रैश्च गिरेस्तस्य समन्ततः। स देशः शोभितो राजन् कल्पवृक्षैश्च सर्वशः॥
answer: O king, the region around the hill was adorned with many mansions filled with various gems and they appeared as if they are all Kalpavrikshas (trees giving whatever wanted.)

question: तं दृष्ट्वा सहसा यान्तं सूतपुत्रजिघांसया। शोकोपहतसंकल्पं दह्यमानमिवाग्निना॥
answer: At that moment, behoiding the very virtuous king Yudhishthira proceed with impetuosity for bringing about the slaughter of Suta's son, Vyasa approached him and said these words to him who was then burning with the fire of grief and whose reason was clouded by it.

question: संरम्भात् पाण्डवं संख्ये युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्। तौ समेतौ महाराज स्पर्धमानौ महाबलौ॥
answer: In rage, against that son of Pandu who stood before him in the attitude of fighting. O mighty monarch, those two highly puissant heroes, looking at their respective feats and encountering each other.

question: भीमसेनादिभिः सर्वैर्धातृभिः परिवारितः। पाञ्चाल्या ब्राह्मणाश्चैव न्यवसन्त सुखं तदा॥
answer: He happily lived there surrounded by Bhimasena and his other brothers and also by the Panchala princess and the Brahmanas.

question: कूपमध्ये च या जाता वल्ली यत्र स मानवः। प्रताने लम्बते लग्नो जीविताशा शरीरिणाम्॥
answer: The cluster of creepers growing in that pit and by whose spreading stems the man hangs down is the man hangs down is the desire for life which every creature entertains.

question: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कांस्तत्र संजयापश्यः प्रीत्यर्थेन समागतान्। ये योत्स्यन्ते पाण्डवार्थं पुत्रस्य मम वाहिनीम्॥
answer: Dhritarashtra said Whom have you, O Sanjaya, seen there coming out of love and who will fight with the army of my sons on behalf of the sons of Pandu?

question: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्य दूतेन दुपदस्य तदा नृप। चोरस्येव गृहीतस्य न प्रावर्तत भारती॥
answer: Bhishma said Thus addressed by that messenger, O king, the king Drupada, like a thief caught (red handed), could not utter a word.

question: ततस्तस्यामिषीकायां पावकः समजायत। प्रधक्ष्यन्निव लोकांस्त्रीन् कालान्तकयमोपमः॥
answer: A fire then was begotten of that blade of grass, which appeared capable of destroying the three worlds like the all-destroying Yama at the end of the cycle."

question: किमस्माभिः कृतं तेषां कस्मिन् वा पुनरागसि। धार्तराष्ट्रान् जिघांसन्ति पाण्डवाः संजयैः सह॥
answer: What has been done by us to them and for what injury again do those sons of Pandu united with this Srinjayas, try to slay the sons of Dhritarashtra?

question: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना। सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे॥
answer: Being thus addressed by the high-souled Rāghava, Hanumān, related to him all of what Sita had said,

question: तस्यापकृत्तशीर्षं तु शरीरं पतितं रथात्॥ रुधिरेणावसिक्ताङ्गं दृष्ट्वा सैन्यमभज्यत।
answer: Beholding his headless trunk, bathed in blood, fallen down from his car, the Kaurava troops were dispersed.

question: सा विषण्णा च संत्रस्ता मुखेन परिशुष्यता। राजानमेवाभिमुखी कैकेयी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Losing her complexion and agitated with fear, with her countenance fallen, Kaikeyi faced the king and said.

question: वर्जयन्ति च राजानस्तत् पुरं भरतर्षभ। भयादग्नेर्महाराज तदाप्रभृति सर्वदा॥
answer: O best of the Bharata race, O great king, from that day all the kings avoid this city for the fear of fire.

question: तीक्ष्णवीर्यास्तु भूतानां दुरालम्भाः सकण्टकाः। रक्तभूयिष्ठवर्णाश्च कृष्णाश्चैवोपहारयेत्॥
answer: Such flowers as have keen energy, as are painful to the touch, as grow on trees and plants having thorns, and as are either bloodyred or black, should be offered to (evil) spirits an unearthly beings.

question: ततस्तद् भवनं श्रेष्ठं प्राकम्पत मुहुर्मुहुः। बलवच्चापि संक्रुद्धावन्योन्यं प्रति गर्जतः॥
answer: While enraged they were thus roaring at each other, that best of houses shook at every moment.

question: भानुमन्तं महाघोषं सर्वरत्नमनोरमम्। ससर्ज यं सुतपसा भौमनो भुवनप्रभुः॥ प्रजापतिरनिर्देश्यं यस्य रूपं रवेरिव। यं स्म सोमः समारुह्य दानवानजयत् प्रभुः॥
answer: Its splendour was very great and the sound of its wheels were tremendous; it delighted the heart of every creature that looked at it. It was created by Prajapati after severe ascetic mediation. It was as effulgent as the sun and its splendour was so great that none could gaze at it. It was that very chariot riding on which the lord Soma defeated the Danavas.

question: अपि धिक्रियमाणोऽपि त्यज्यमानोऽप्यनेकधा। आत्मनो दर्शनाद् विप्रान्न हन्तास्मीति मार्गया घटमानः स्वकार्येषु कुरु निःश्रेयसं परम्॥
answer: Though they have censured you and though they have deserted you, do you still, guided by knowledge of self, solemnly promise never to injure them, Engaged in becoming acts, try to do what is for your highest good.

question: नृत्यमाने च ते सेने समेयातां परस्परम्। तेषां पक्षैः प्रपक्षेभ्यो निर्जग्मुस्ते युयुत्सवः॥
answer: The two armies came face to face, meeting cach other, as if dancing (in great cheer). The heroes on both the sides, who were most desirous of battle, came forth accompanied by their respective divisions.

question: यावच्च मार्दवेनैतान् राजन्नुपचरिष्यसि। तावदेते हरिष्यन्ति तव राज्यमरिंदम॥
answer: So long as you treat these, O king, with kindness, they will deprive you of your kingdom, O you chastiser of your foes.

question: प्रार्थितः पुरुषो यश्च स निवेद्यस्त्वया मम। विमृश्याहं प्रदास्यामि वरय त्वं यथेप्सितम्॥
answer: Speak of that person, to me, whom you desire (for your husband). Choose, whom you like, for your husband. I will (afterwards) on (due) deliberation give you away (to him).

question: दमयन्ती तु यं हंसं समुपाधावदन्तिके। स मानुषी गिरं कृत्वा दमयन्तीमथाब्रवीत्॥
answer: The swan which Damayanti pursued, led her into a solitary corner of the gardens and addressed her a human speech the following words,

question: विश्वसृग्भ्यस्तु भूतेभ्यो महाभूतास्तु सर्वशः। भूतेभ्यश्चापि पञ्चभ्यो मुक्तो गच्छेत् परां गतिम्॥
answer: All the great elements are beyond those elements which form the universe. He who is released from those five clements goes to the highest goal.

question: अथान्योऽप्यश्वार्थी ब्राह्मण आगच्छत्। तथैव चैनमुक्त्वा वामपाणिमभ्यदादथ प्रायात् पुनरपि चान्योऽप्यश्वार्थी ब्राह्मण आगच्छत् त्वरितोऽथ तस्मै अपना वाम धुर्यमददत्॥
answer: There came to him another Brahmana desiring to get a horse. Saying as before, he then unyoked the horse on the left (side of the car) and gave it to him. He then went on. But another Brahmana, desiring to get a horse again, came to him. He then gave him the horse yoked to the left front of his car.

question: एतद्धि सर्वकार्याणां परमं कृत्यमाहवे। तमब्रवीन्महाराज धृष्टद्युम्नो वृकोदरम्॥
answer: This indeed should be your foremost duty in the course of this fight." O mighty monarch, Dhrishtadyumna then replied to Vrikodara

question: एवमेव महाबाहो धर्मेषु परितिष्ठता। स्वप्तव्यं क्षत्रियेणाजो शरतल्पगतेन वै॥
answer: O mighty-armed hero this indeed is the way in which a Kshatriya not transgressing his duties, should sleep on the battle-field lying on an arrowy bed.

question: एतां बुद्धिं ततश्चकुः सर्वे ते हरियूथपाः। अवतार्य गिरेः शृङ्गाद् गृध्रमाहाङ्गदस्तदा॥
answer: Then those monkey-chiefs resolved thus. And descending from the summit of the mountain, Angada spoke to the vulture,

question: जरा मृत्युः कुतस्तेषां हर्षः प्रीतिः सुखं न च। न दुःखं न सुखं चापि रागद्वेषौ कुतो मुने॥
answer: Old, age, death they have none; for them there is neither ecstacy, nor joy nor happiness. They have neither happiness nor misery, O Rishi, anger and aversion they have none.

question: स हि राजा दशरथः पिता जनयिता मम। आज्ञापयन्मां यत् तस्य न तन्मिथ्या भविष्यति॥
answer: Therefore, what my father, king Dasaratha has commanded me to do, must not be falsified.

question: पिता पुत्रं न जानीते पुत्रो वा पितरं तथा। निर्मर्यादे तथाभूते वैशसे लोमहर्षणे॥
answer: Father could not distinguish his son nor the son his father, in that horripilating, carnage where no consideration was of any evil.

question: दादाय चर्मालरुक्मचन्द्रम। आकाशसंकाशमसिं प्रगृह्य दोधूयमानः स्त्रगवचचार॥
answer: Nakula then got down from his horseless chariot and taking up a shield that was studded with golden moons and a sky colored sword jumping now and then looked like a sprightly bird.

question: ऋणमेतत् प्रवृद्धं मे हृदयानापसर्पति। यद् गोविन्देति चुक्रोश कृष्णा मां दूरवासिनम्॥
answer: That old debt has not yet been wiped off from my mind (for I have not paid it), that is the invocation of me living at a distance by Krishna saying "Govinda".

question: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रु भाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान् हरियूथपः॥
answer: Hearing Vaidehī's piteous words uttered with tearful eyes, that leader of monkey-bands, the exceedingly energetic Hanumān, said,

question: शैलादभ्युच्छ्यवता चयाट्टालकशोभिना। द्वारतोरणनिर्वृहध्वजसंवाहशोभिना॥
answer: Higher than a mountain peak, adorned with ramparts and towers, graced with doorways, gates and rows of flags,

question: सर्ववृत्तान्ततवत्ज्ञो भवान् दिव्येन चक्षुषा। युक्तः पश्यसि विप्रर्षे गतिर्या विविधा नृणाम्॥
answer: You know the truth of every affair. Gifted with celestial vision, you behold, O twice-born Rishi, what the various ends are of human beings.

question: गजा हयाः पदाताश्च विमिश्रा दन्तिभिर्हताः। रथाश्वाः दन्तिनश्चैव पत्तिभिस्तत्र सूदिताः॥
answer: Horses and elephants, and foot-soldiers, mixing with one another, was siain by the tuskers; and car-warriors, and horse-soldiers, and tuskers were also slain in that battle by foot-soldiers.

question: भूयश्चैव च तप्तव्यं तपश्चरणमुत्तमम्। स्वर्गं त्ववश्यं गन्तव्यं त्वया शत्रुनिषूदन॥
answer: O destroyer of foes, you will have to practise severe austerities again, for O Pandava, you will surely have to stay in heaven (now in this mortal frame).

question: अत्र वै हिमवत्पृष्ठे नित्यमास्ते महेश्वरः। प्रकृत्या पुरुषः सार्धं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः॥
answer: Here on the breast of the Himayat mountain even lives Maheshvara who is endued with effulgence like that of the fire which blazes at the termination of each Yuga, like Purusha in company with Prakriti.

question: स पूज्यमानो देवैश्च गन्धर्वैर्ऋषिभिस्तथा।॥ यक्षराक्षससंघेश्च विद्याधरगणैस्तथा।
answer: He was worshipped by the Gandharvas and the Rishis, by Yakhas and Rakshasas, and by all tribes of the Vidyadharas.

question: महासत्त्वौ हि तौ दृष्ट्वा सहितौ केशवार्जुनौ। हतमाधिरथिं मेने संख्ये गाण्डीवधन्वना॥
answer: Having seen the mightiest Sri Krishna and Arjuna came together, he was conformed in mind that Arjuna, the holder of Gandiva has were killed Karna, the son of charioteer in the battlefield.

question: तेन त्वां निहनिष्यामि सानुबन्धं सबान्धवम्। समीकरिष्ये तत् पापं यत् पुरा कृतवानसि॥
answer: For all these act of yours, I will, this day, slay you with all your relations, and will avenge all those wrongs you did formerly inflict on us".

question: पापं कर्म कृतं किंचिद् यदि तस्मिन् न दृश्यते। नृपते तस्य पुत्रेषु पौत्रेष्वपि च नतृषु॥
answer: If the fruits of a sinful act be not seen in the perpetrator himself, they would certainly be seen. O king, in his sons; or son's sons, ci daughter's sons!

question: व्याधिमिच्छामि ते ज्ञातुं प्रतिकुर्यां हि तत्र वै। एवमुक्तः स पुत्रेण शान्तनुः प्रत्यभाषत॥
answer: I wish to know the disease from which you suffer, so that I may try to get a remedy." Having been thus addressed by his son, Shantanu replied,

question: यदा मन्दः परबाणान् विमुक्तान् ममे षुभिर्जियमाणान् प्रतीपम्। स्तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
answer: When the fool sees the arrows shot from the bows of our enemies being struck by my arrows twined back or cut off being pierced obliquely by my shafts; then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

question: दुखुरुवाच न गजं न रथं नाश्वं जीर्णो भुङ्क्तेन च स्त्रियम्। वाक्सङ्गश्चास्य भवति तां जरां नाभिकामये॥
answer: Druhyu said: O king, one, if he is decrepit, cannot enjoy elephants, cars, horses or women. His voice also becomes indistinct. Therefore, I do no desire (to take upon myself) your old age.

question: तद् दृष्ट्वा तादृशं युद्धं सुशर्मा युद्धदुर्मदः। चिन्तयामास मनसा किं शेषं हि बलस्य मे। अपरो दृश्यते सैन्ये पुरा मग्नो महाबले॥
answer: Thought within his mind: "Is this the end of my army. I see my brother drowned in the midst of his powerful army.”

question: स मन्यमानो विमुखं पितरं बभ्रुवाहनः। शरैराशीविषाकारैः पुनरेवार्दयद् बली॥
answer: The powerful Babhruvahana, thinking that his father was no longer able to face him, again afflicted him with many arrows resembling snakes of dreadful poison.

question: क्षतक्षीणाभितप्तानां ग्राम्यधर्मरतात्मनाम्। अध्वना कर्शितानां च न मांसाद्विद्यते परम्॥
answer: There is nothing that is more beneficial than meat to persons who are lean or weak, or afflicted with disease or addicted to sexual union or exhausted with travel.

question: मार्दवं सर्वभूतानामनसूया क्षमा धृतिः। आयुष्याणि बुधाः प्राहुर्मित्राणां चाविमानना॥
answer: On the other hand, leaving them to be too much exercised would ruin the gods even; humility, kindness to all creatures, forgiveness and patience.

question: स उपाध्यायं प्रत्युवाच-'भो भैक्ष्येण वृत्तिं कल्पयामि' इति॥
answer: He answered to his preceptor, “I support myself by begging."

question: एतान्यादित्यवर्णानि तपनीयनिभानि च। रोषरोदनताम्राणि वक्त्राणि कुरुयोषिताम्॥
answer: The faces of those fair ladies have, with weeping and ire, become effulgent as the morning sun, or gold, or burnished copper.

question: पश्यामि बहुलान् राजन् वृक्षानुदकसंश्रयान्। सारसानां च निदिमत्रोदकमसंशयम्॥
answer: "O king, I see numerous trees growing near water and also hear the cries of the Sarasas. Therefore, surely water must be somewhere here."

question: विषमं च समं चैव हतैरश्वपदातिभिः॥ रथैश्च कुञ्चरैश्चैव न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन।
answer: The earth became so covered over with dead bodies of horses, foot soldiers, elephants and with broken cars that it became impossible to distinguish the even land from the uneven.

question: महाबलैर्भीमरवैः संरम्भोवृत्तलोचनैः॥ उपस्थितैस्ततो युद्धे राक्षसैयुद्धदुर्मदैः।
answer: Were dreadful to look at, excited with wrath and their eyes were rolling in ire. Accompanied by those Rakshasas difficult of being vanquished. (Ghatotkacha) appeared on the field of battle.

question: तत्र रम्ये शिवे देशे बहुवृक्षसमाकुले। पूर्वस्यां दिशि रम्यायां समुद्राभ्याशतो नृप॥
answer: When, O king, towards a blessed country abounding in numerous trees and situated in the region of the east near the sea.

question: देवयान्युवाच आहुतं चाग्निहोत्रं ते सूर्यश्चास्तं गतः प्रभो। अगोपाचागता गावः कचस्तात न दृश्यते॥
answer: Devayani said: O sire, the Agnihotra (evening fire) is kindled, the sun has also set. The kine have come back without their cowherd. But Kacha is not to be seen.

question: अपि कीट: पतङ्गो वा भवेयं शङ्कराज्ञया। न तु शक्र त्वया दत्तं त्रैलोक्यमपि कामये॥
answer: Ordered by Mahadeva I shall cheerfully become a worm or an insect, but I do not desire for even the sovereignty of the three worlds if bestowed by you, O Shakra.

question: एतदुन्मेषमात्रेण विनष्टं स्थाणु जङ्गमम्। कूर्मपृष्ठसमा भूमिर्भवत्यथ समन्ततः॥
answer: Within, the twinkling of the eye all mobile and immobile creatures being thus destroyed, the Earth becomes on all sides, bare as a tortoise shell.

question: जहि वीर महावीयौं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। अदृश्योदृश्यमानो वा सर्वथा त्वं बलाधिकः॥
answer: O hero, gifted with great prowess as you are, do you, hidden (in clouds) or appearing before them, slay the two heroic brothers Rāma and Laksmana.

question: ततो रामः परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणानुगतं वचः॥
answer: Thereupon embracing Sugrīva, of a pleasant countenance and like to Lakşmaņa, the highly wise Rāma spoke to him, saying,

question: तं समासाद्य लङ्केशः परिष्वज्याथ बाहुभिः। अब्रवीत्किमिदं वत्स वर्तसे ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः॥
answer: Having seen him (there) and embraced him by his arms the lord of Lankā said: “What are you after, O my child? Tell me the truth."

question: जातमात्रः पुरा चैव ममाङ्कात् पतितो गिरौ। शरीरगौरवादस्य शिला गात्रैविचूर्णिता॥
answer: As soon as he was born, he fell from my lap on the stone. The mass of stone on which he fell was broken into pieces by the weight of his body.

question: तदलं ज्वलितं घोरं लक्ष्मणः शरमाहितम्। अतिकायाय चिक्षेप कालदण्डमिवान्तकः॥
answer: And even as the reaper hurled his rod, did Lakşmaņa hurl that weapon inspired with divine energy, dreadful and aflame, at Atikaya.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तु कृतदारेभ्यः पाण्डुभ्यः प्राहिणोद्वरिः। वैदूर्यमणिचित्राणि हैमान्याभरणानि च॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : After the Pandavas had been married, Hari (Krishna) sent them various golden ornaments set with pearls and Vaidurya gems.

question: दिलीप उवाच उदपानप्लवे ग्रामे ब्राह्मणो वृषलीपतिः। तस्य लोकान् स व्रजतु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
answer: Dilipa said Let him who has stolen your stalks attain to those regions of misery an infamy which are reserved for that Brahmana who lives in a village having but one well and who knows a Shudra woman.

question: वृद्धानां वचनं श्रुत्वा योऽभ्युत्थानं प्रयोजयेत्॥ उत्थानस्य फलं सम्यक् तदा स लभतेऽचिरात्।
answer: He who exert after listening to the words of the old, soon reaps abundant fruits.

question: तमागतमहं श्रुत्वा विषयान्तं महाबलम्। अभ्यगच्छं जवेनाशु प्रीत्या तेजोनिधिं प्रभुम्॥
answer: Hearing of the arrival of that one endued with great strength at the boundary of my kingdom I went to that lord, the ocean of energy, with great cheerfulness,

question: अधर्मात् तु महोत्पातो भविष्यति हि साम्प्रतम्। नैते धर्मं विजानन्ति राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः॥
answer: Mighty is the disaster that shall arise on account of this crime—the Räkşasas who live on flesh do not know what virtue is.

question: सूर्यारुणौ यथा दृष्ट्वा तमो नश्यति मारिष। तता नश्यन्तु कौन्तेयाः : सपञ्चाला: ससुंजयाः॥
answer: As, O sire, the thick gloom is destroyed at the very view of both the Sun and Arjuna, even so let all the descendants of Kunti along with the Panchalas and the Srinjayas be destroyed (at the sight of Karna and Shalya in the battle).

question: चर्मवर्माणि संछिन्नान्यपतन् भुवि देहिनाम्। विषेहुर्नास्य संस्पर्शं द्वितीयस्य पतत्रिणः॥
answer: Being broken into pieces, the shields and coats of mail, belonging to the warriors, fell upon the earth; and none of them could bear the touch of a second arrow (to be shot by Karna).

question: तामश्मवृष्टिं तुमुलां पर्वतीयैः समीरिताम्। चिच्छेदोरगसंकाशैर्नाराचैः शिनिपुङ्गवः॥
answer: The foremost scion of the Sini race baffled with his Narachas resembling venomous reptiles. Then with those lustrous fragments of stones looking like a flight of fire flies.

question: यथा धेनुसहस्रेषु वत्सो विन्दति मातरम्। तथा पूर्वकृतं कर्म कर्तारमनुगच्छति॥
answer: As a calf recognises and comes to it mother in the midst of even a thousand kine, so the pristine acts recognise and visit the doer in his new life.

question: किं च कृत्वा परं स्थानं प्राप्नुवन्ति मनीषिणः। केन देवाः पवित्रेण स्वर्गमश्नन्ति वा विभो॥
answer: What is that act by doing which wise men succeed in acquiring the highest region? What is that sacred deed by which the celestials enjoy divine happiness?

question: दर्शयित्वा तथाऽऽत्मानं रौद्रं रुद्रपराक्रमः। अवरुद्धोऽचरत् पार्थो वर्षाणि त्रिदशानि च।
answer: Displaying his own fierce prowess, Partha of dreadful prowess ranged in the battle-field pouring his celestials weapons.

question: ततो वाचस्पतिर्जज्ञे तं मनः पर्यवेक्षते। रूपं भवति वैवर्णं समनुद्रवते मनः॥
answer: From that was produced the Veda or Word), (then was born Mind); Mind (desirous of creation) sets itself on the Veda (or the Word). Then arises forin colour) undistinguished by particular colours. It runs towards the Mind. or

question: तमेवं वृत्तसम्पन्नमप्रधृष्यपराक्रमम्। लोकनाथोपमं नाथमकामयत मेदिनी॥
answer: And the Earth desired for her lord even him (Rāma) possessing an excellent character and of prowess incapable of being repressed, like to Lokanātha (Vişnu.) himself.

question: ततो दुन्दुभयश्चैव शङ्खाश्च सुमहास्वनाः। मुरजा डिण्डिमाश्चैव प्रावाद्यन्त सहस्रशः॥
answer: At the same time drums, and conchs of loud blare, and kettle-drums and tabors in thousands began to beat and blow.

question: अदृष्टपूर्वा भगवन्कस्याप्येषा महात्मनः। पत्नी श्रीरिव संमोहाद्विरौति विकृतानना॥
answer: O great Rşi, we do not know the wife of what great man, beautiful like the very Lakşmī, and not seen before, is crying aloud very poorly?

question: ततोऽहं तामिषुभिर्दीप्यमानां समायान्तीमन्तकालार्कदीप्ताम्। छित्त्वा त्रिधा पातयामास भूमौ ततो ववौ पवनः पुण्यगन्धिः॥
answer: I too cut asunder that blazing weapon which was coming against me like the blazing sun at the time of the destruction of the universe and felled it to the earth cut up into three pieces by my felled it to the earth cut of into three pieces by my arrows: then did sweetsmelling breeze blow about me.

question: रजस्तमः सत्त्वमथो येषां निधोतमात्मनः। शौचाशौचसमायुक्ताः स्वकार्यपरिमार्गिणः॥ सर्वत्यागेष्वभिरताः सर्वज्ञाः समदर्शिनः। शौचेन वृत्तशौचार्थास्तु तीर्थाः शुचयश्च ये॥
answer: Those persons from whose souls the qualities of goodness, darkness, and ignorance have been washed off, they who, not caring for purity and impurity, pursue the ends they have proposed to themselves, they who have renounced everything, they who are possessed of omniscience and gifted with universal sight, and they who are of pure conduct, are considered as Tirthas possessing the purifying power.

question: भक्त्या ह्यस्य विरुध्यन्ते तव पुत्रैः सदैव ते। अनर्हानेव तु वधे धर्मयुक्तान् विकर्मणा॥ योऽक्लेशयत् पाण्डुपुत्रान् यो विद्वेष्ट्यधुनापि वै। सर्वोपायनियन्तव्यः सानुगः पापपूरुषः॥
answer: Out of regard for him, they are ever against your sons. He who troubles the sons of Pandu endued with virtue and undeserving of injury by unworthy actions and he who despises them even now, that evil-minded man, along with his followers, should be checked by all means.

question: किं तैर्येऽनडुहो नोह्याः किं धेन्वा वाप्यदुग्धया। वन्ध्यया भार्यया कोऽर्थः कोऽर्थो राज्ञाप्यरक्षता॥
answer: What use is there of bulls, that would not carry burdens, or of kine that would not give milk, or of a wife who is barren? Likewise, what need is there for a king who is not capable to grant protection?

question: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शिविरे मया प्रणिहिताश्चराः। त इमे शीघ्रमागम्य प्रवृत्तिं वेदयन्ति नः॥
answer: I had deputed spies in the encampment of the sons of Dhristarastra. Those spies, returning soon furnished with this information.

question: ततस्तै रावणामात्यैरमात्यास्ते नृपस्य तु। सूदिताश्चापि ते युद्धे भक्षिताश्च बुभुक्षितैः॥
answer: Thereupon the hungry councillors of Rāvana, slew some of the ministers of the king and devoured some.

question: अन्योन्यमभिमृद्नन्ति नगराणि युयुत्सवः। पद्मोत्पलानि वृक्षेषु जायन्ते कुमुदानि च॥
answer: Being desirous of battle, they are breaking down the towns (they have made in sports). Lotuses and lilies are growing on trees.

question: अवाप्यैतानि कर्माणि वेदोक्तानि धनंजय। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञो निग्रहश्चैव दुर्ग्रहः॥ दक्षिणेन च पन्थानमर्यम्णो ये दिवं गताः। एतान् क्रियावतां लोकानुक्तवान् पूर्वमप्यहम्॥
answer: By performing those acts, O Dhananjaya, that are laid down in the Vedas, viz., battle, study of the Vedas, Sacrifices, the control of passion that is so difficult, one goes to heaven by the southern path of the Sun. I have, before this, told you that those very regions are reserved for persons who perform (Vedic) acts.

question: केचिदाहुर्युवा श्रीमान् नागराजकरोपमः। पीनस्कन्धोरुबाहुश्च धैर्येण हिमवानिव॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : The others said, This handsome youth, who is like a truck of a mighty elephant, whose shoulders, arms and thighs are so well built, who is patience looks like the Himalayas,

question: धर्मान्वितेषु विज्ञाता मन्त्री गुप्तश्च पाण्डव। आप्तो राजा कुलीनश्च पर्याप्तो राजसंग्रह॥
answer: That confident and high-born king who seeks instruction from learned and pious Brahmanas and who is protected by his ministers, can keep all his tributary chiefs under proper control.

question: अन्ये ऋक्षवतः प्रस्थानुपतस्थुः सहस्रशः॥ अन्ये नानाविधाञ्छैलान् काननानि च भेजिरे।
answer: Some of these monkeys began to dwell on the top of the Rkşavān mountain; while others inhabited various other mountains and forests.

question: स्तत्रानु ते यान्ति न तरन्ति मृत्युम्। सदर्थयोगानवगमात् समन्तात् प्रवर्तते भोगयोगेन देही॥
answer: Those, however, who have faith in the fruits of actions, when the time for the fruits comes, go to heaven, without meeting with Death (i.e. they simply transfer their souls elsewhere. Creatures having bodies, however), owing to their incapacity to understand Brahman and owing to their being wedded to earthly enjoyments have come to this world again and again, in all directions (i.e. sometimes they are born in the same position as before, at other times they are born higher or lower according to the effects of their work).

question: परमात्मानमीशानमात्मनः प्रभवं तथा॥ ये त्वन्ये ब्रह्मसदने सिद्धसंघाः समागताः। तेभ्यस्तच्छावयामास पुराणं वेदसम्मितम्॥ तेषां सकाशात् सूर्यस्तु श्रुत्वा वै भावितात्मनाम्। आत्मानुगामिनां राजन् श्रावयामास वै ततः॥ षट् षष्टिर्हि सहस्राणि ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम्।
answer: He knows that Narayana is the Supreme Soul, that He is the Supreme Lord, that He is Creator of Brahman himself. Narada recited this very ancient narrative which is perfectly consistent with the Vedas, to that assembly of Rishis crowned with ascetic success that came to the abode of Brahman. The gods Surya, having heard that narrative from those Rishis crowned with ascetic success, repeated it to the sixty-six thousands of Rishis, O king, of purified souls, that follow in his train.

question: श्रद्धा च गुरुशुश्रूषा यमयोः परुषग्ययोः। अजातशत्रो भद्रं ते खाण्डवप्रस्थमाविश। भ्रातृभिस्तेऽस्तु सौभ्रानं धर्मे ते धीयतां मनः॥
answer: And in those foremost of men, the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva), are pure reverence and service to superiors. O Ajatasatru, be blessed. Return to Khandavaprastha. Let there be brotherly love between you and your cousins. Let your mind be always fixed in virtue.

question: अभिषिक्तेन स ऋषिरभिषिक्तः पुरोहितः॥ स तं पुरोधाय सुखमवसद् भरतर्षभ।
answer: But soon after his own installation as king, he installed the rebora Rishi as his priest. Having made the Brahmana his priest, the king began to pass his days happily.

question: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तोऽसौ विश्रवा मुनिपुंगवः। प्राञ्जलिं धनदं प्राह शृणु पुत्र वचो मम॥
answer: Thus accosted, that foremost of ascetics, the Brahmarși Viśravă spoke to the lord of riches (standing) with joined hands, 'O son, listen to my words.

question: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। ऊचुर्वाचं सुसंक्रुद्धा ब्रह्मघ्नाः शूलपाणयः॥ संरक्तनयना घोरा रामं संरक्तलोचनम्। परुषा मधुराभाषं हृष्टा दृष्टपराक्रमम्॥
answer: Hearing those words of his, those fourteen grim Rākşasas bearing darts in their hands, exceedingly enraged, with their eyes reddened, breathing high spirits, harshly said to the sweetspeeched Rāma, having his eyes reddened whose prowess they had not seen before.

question: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम्। मम वानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः॥
answer: I bestow my favours (on all men) in the way in which they worship Me. All men, O Partha, follow in my path, in every way.

question: भेरीमृदङ्गपणवान् नादयन्तश्च पुष्करान्। पाण्डवा अभ्यवर्तन्त नदन्तो भैरवान् स्वान्॥
answer: And with fierce yells, the Pandavas rushed to battle. With the sound of our drums, cyrnbals conchs, Dundubhis,

question: कल्पप्रयोगे चोत्पन्ने ज्योतिषे च परं गतः॥ सांख्ये चैव परा प्रीतिस्तस्य चैवं व्यवर्धत।
answer: The reborn Rishi gained great perfection in all sacrifices ordained in the Sutras, of the Vedanga which deals with religious rites and observances, astrology and astronomy. He took great pleasure in the Sankhya philosophy too.

question: तां कालरात्रीमिव पाशहस्तां यमस्य धात्रीमिव चोग्ररूपाम्। स ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमाममोघां ससर्ज यत्तो युधि धर्मराजः॥
answer: King Yudhishthira, in that battle, carefully discharged that dart which resembled the Death-night armed with the dreadful noose or the dreadful mother of Yama himself and which like the Brahmana's curse, was of sure effect.

question: श्वापदैरुपसृष्टानि दुर्गाणि विषमाणि च। अगम्यानि नरैरल्पैस्तीर्थानि मनुजेश्वर॥
answer: O ruler of men, they are full of dangers and abound in wild beasts; they are inaccessible and are to be reached through dragged ways. Men in small parties cannot reach these Tirthas.

question: वृकोदरेण सदृशो बलेनान्यो न विद्यते। योऽभ्युदीयाद् युधि श्रेष्ठमपि वज्रधरं स्वयम्॥
answer: There is none so strong as Vrikodara; he may even vanquish in battle the thunderer (Indra) himself.

question: भास्करस्यैव पतनं समुद्रस्येव शोषणम्। विपर्यासं यथा मेरोर्वासवस्येव निर्जयम्॥ अमर्षणीयं तद् दृष्ट्वा भारद्वाजस्य पातनम्। त्रस्तरूपतरा राजन् कौरवाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
answer: Beholding that unthought-of over-throw of Bharadvaja's son, that was like falling the sun on the earth or the drying up of the ocean or the transplantation of Meru nountain or the defeat of Vasava himself, your troops, O king, began to fly away, panic lending speed to their legs.

question: नारद उवाच जित्वा तु पृथिवीं दैत्यौ निःसपत्नौ गतव्यथौ। कृत्वा त्रैलोक्यमव्यग्रं कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः॥
answer: Narada said: Subjugating the whole earth, the two Danavas became unrivalled; and when they had brought the three worlds under their sway, they then considered themselves free from fatigue and regarded that their works were done.

question: कर्मणा पुनरेवाहं सुखमागामि लक्षये। तच्छ्रोतुमहमिच्छामि त्वत्तः श्रेयस्तपोधन॥
answer: I think that on account of that deed, I shall once more succeed in regaining happiness. O you having asceticism for wealth you know everything, Tell me please what is for my behoof.

question: तस्माद् भयं समुत्पन्नमस्माकं वै पितामह। परित्रायस्व नो देव न ह्यन्या गतिरस्ति नः॥
answer: O Grandfather, we fear him greatly. O illustrious one, do you save us! We have no other refuge than you.

question: न पुत्रमरणं केचिद् द्रक्ष्यन्ति पुरुषाः क्वचित्। नार्यश्चाविधवा नित्यं भविष्यन्ति पतिव्रताः॥
answer: Where a no person is to witness his son's death, and women will be ever chaste, and never bear widow-hood.

question: तत्रैव च महाराज यक्षिणी लोकविश्रुताम्। स्नात्वाभिगम्य राजेन्द्र सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्॥
answer: O great king, there is the celebrated Tirtha called Yakshini; O king of kings, going and bathing in that Tirtha one's all desires are fulfilled.

question: अभावः सहसा राजन् कुरुराजस्य तर्कितः॥ हतप्रवीरास्तु वयं निकृत्ताश्च शितैः शरैः।
answer: O king, the destruction of the Kuru monarch became apparent. Mangled with sharp shafts and with our foremost heroes slain,

question: एवं विजानल्लोकेऽस्मिन् कः कस्येत्यभिनिश्चितः। मोक्षे निवेशय मनो भूयश्चाप्युपधारय॥
answer: When such is the case, who is the world is to be considered as whose? Do you, therefore, think of acquiring Liberation. Hear now what more I shall say to you.

question: न पश्यति रजोऽप्यस्य यदा रामस्य भूमिपः। तदार्तश्च निषण्णश्च पपात धरणीतले॥
answer: When the ruler of earth could no longer perceive even the dust raised by Rāma's car, then pierced with sorrow, and in heaviness of heart, he fell down to the ground.

question: पादचारमिवादित्यं निष्पतन्तं सुदुर्दृशम्। ततस्ते प्रत्यभिज्ञाय अर्जुनाय न्यवेदयन्॥
answer: Beholding that dreadful Rșis approach like to Āditya walking on foot, the warders communicated the intelligence to the king Arjuna.

question: तावद् गर्जस्व राधेय यावत् पार्थं न पश्यसि। आरात् पार्थं हि ते दृष्ट्वा दुर्लभं गर्जितं पुनः॥
answer: Continue, O son Radha, to roar so long as you do not behold Partha; (for) you will cease roaring when you will see Partha near.

question: विविंशतिः पञ्चभिश्च त्रिभिर्दुःशासनस्तथा। तान् प्रत्यविध्यद् राजेन्द्र पार्षतः शत्रुतापनः॥
answer: Vivingshati with five, and Dushasana with three. Them, O monarch, the son of Prishata, the slayer of his foes, pierced.

question: ततः संचिन्त्य मनसा मुहूर्तमिव वासवः। शक्त्यर्थं पृथिवीपाल कर्णं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्॥
answer: Thereupon, O lord of the earth, Vasava reflecting a moment with in his mind for the dart, spoke to Karna these words.

question: यं यं देशं समुद्रस्य जगाम स महिकपिः। स तु तस्याङ्गवेगेन सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते॥
answer: And wherever that mighty monkey went about the sea, the state of things appeared to undergo a violent convulsion owing to impetus imparted by his body.

question: विष्णुना वसता चापि गृहे दशरथस्य वै। दशग्रीवो हतश्छन्नं संयुगे भीमकर्मणा॥
answer: And also living disguised in the abode of Dasharatha, the dreadful acted Lord Vishnu killed the ten-necked Ravana in battle.

question: अभिमन्योश्च बालस्य विनाशं रणमूर्धनि। कर्णस्य च महाबाहो संग्रामेप्वपलायिनः॥ तथैव द्रौपदेयानामन्येषां सुहृदामपि। वधं संस्मृत्य ते वीरा नानिप्रमनसोऽभवन्॥
answer: Indeed, thinking of the destruction of the youthful Abhimanyu on the field of battle, of the mighty-armed Karna who never retreated from fight, of the sons of Draupadi, and of other friends of theirs, those heroes became highly dispirited.

question: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शब्दो भेरीशङ्खसमाकुलः। श्रुतो वै सर्वसैन्यानां कम्पयन्धरणीतलम्॥
answer: In the meanwhile there was heard a mighty uproar occasioned by the whole host, and drums and conchs, which shook the earth.

question: नह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तं बोधयिष्यति मादृशम्। तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम्।७० ॥
answer: One does not awaken my like for a light cause. therefore do you give the real truth of the cause of your awakening me.

question: देवानामेष वै गोष्ठो यदरण्यमिति श्रुतिः। निबन्धनी रज्जुरेषा या ग्रामे वसतो रतिः॥
answer: The Shruti says that what is called the forest is the true fold for the deities, while the joy one feels in living in the midst of men is, as it were, the fetter for binding the dweller.

question: तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन दुरात्मना। तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्॥
answer: His wife Sītā has been carried off by the wicked Rāvana. At Rāma's mandate I go to her as an envoy.

question: अभक्षयन् वृथा मांसममांसाशी भवत्युत। दानं ददत् पवित्री स्यादस्वप्नश्च दिवास्वपन्॥
answer: By abstaining from all meat obtained from animals killed for nothing, one becomes an abstainer from meat. By making gifts one becomes purged of all sins, and by abstaining from sleep during day time, one comes to be considered always awake,

question: तपोवीर्यबलोपेताद्वेवदेदाङ्गपारगात्। आस्तीकाद्विजमुख्याद्वै सर्पसत्रे द्विजोत्तम॥
answer: It was by Astika learned in the Vedas and the Vedangas and mighty in spiritual power.

question: आवृण्वानं महाज्वालमर्चिभिः सर्वतोऽम्बरम्। दहन्तमिव तीक्ष्णांशुं चण्डवायुसमीरितम्॥
answer: The terrible flames of that fire covered whole of the sky and moved by violent winds, they bent on burning the very sun.

question: स्वस्तिकान् वर्धमानांश्च नन्द्यावर्ताश्च काञ्चनान्। माल्यं च जलकुम्भांश्च ज्वलितं च हुताशनम्॥
answer: Auspicious objects capable of increasing good fortune, golden Nandyavartas, garlands of flowers, jars of water, blazing fire.

question: स्वभावाल्लभते प्रज्ञां शान्तिमेति स्वभावतः। स्वभावादेव तत्सर्वं यत्किचिदनुपश्यसि॥
answer: Know this, however, that one gains wisdom from Nature, and that the acquisition of tranquillity also is owing to the same cause. Indeed, everything else that you see is due to Nature.

question: असुराश्च सुराश्चैव पुण्यहेतोर्मखक्रियाम्। प्रयतन्ते महात्मानस्तस्माद् यज्ञाः परायणम्॥
answer: The great celestials and Asuras celebrate sacrifices for acquiring religious mcrit; and therefore sacrifices are of great importance.

question: कृतं युवाभ्यां कर्मेदममरैरपि दुष्करम्। वरं वृणीतं तुष्टांऽस्मि दुर्लभं पुरुषेष्विह॥
answer: “You have achieved a feat that even a celestial can never do. Ask each of you a boon that is not obtainable by man. I am very much pleased with you”.

question: प्राग्जोतिषं नाम बभूव दुर्गं पुरं घोरमसुराणामसह्यम्। महाबलो नरकस्तत्र भौमो जहारादित्या मणिकुण्डले शुभे॥
answer: There was fastness of the Asuras, terrible and impenetrable, named Pragjyotisha. There Naraka, son of the Earth of great strength stole the beautiful earrings of Aditi bedecked with gems and kept them.

question: ते तु लोकाः सहस्राक्ष शृणु यादृग्गुणान्विताः। न तत्र क्रमते कालो न जरा न च पावकः॥ तथा नास्त्यशुभं किंचिन्न व्याधिस्तत्र न क्रमः।
answer: O you, of a thousand eyes, hear me as I tell you what the attributes are of those regions. There the very course of Time is stopped. Decrepitude is not there nor Fire which is omnipresent in the universe. There is slightest transgression does not take place, nor disease, nor weakness of any sort.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच गार्हस्थ्यं धर्ममखिलं प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ। ऋद्धिमाप्नोति किं कृत्वा मनुष्य इह पार्थिव॥
answer: Yudhishthira said O foremost one of Bharata's race, do you describe to me all the deities of the household mode and tell me all that a man should do in order to acquire prosperity in this world.

question: ज्वलन्तीं प्राहिणोत् तस्मै भूतं तामपि चाग्रसत्। ततः सर्वायुधाभावे वीक्षमाणस्ततस्ततः॥
answer: At last, when all his weapons were exhausted, Ashvatthaman, looking around, saw the entire sky densely crowded with images of Janarddana.

question: तं परिस्तोमसंकीर्णैर्नानारत्नविभूषितैः। यानैरनुययुर्यक्षा राक्षसाश्च सहस्रशः॥
answer: Thousands of Yakshas and Rakshasas followed him in conveyances covered with painted cushions and adorned with many gems.

question: इहापि विषयः सर्वो यथादेहं प्रवर्तितः। मानुषाः स्थैर्यजाश्चैव पृथग्भोगा विशेषतः॥
answer: In this condition every object of enjoyment exists for me according to the necessity of my body. Human beings and those creatures which originate from immobile objects have different enjoyments.

question: ततो विद्युत्प्रभो वाक्यमभ्यभाषत वासवम्। अयं सूक्ष्मतरो धर्मस्तं निबोध शतक्रतो॥
answer: Besides this, he should touch (After bathing) the back of a cow and bow his head to her tail. Vidutprabha, after this, once more addressing Vasava said, I shall describe a rite that is more subtle. Listen to me, O you of a hundred sacrifices.

question: सगर उवाच पितुश्च तेऽहं त्यागेन पुत्राणां निधनेन च। अलाभेन तथाश्वस्य परितप्यामि पुत्रक॥
answer: Sagara said: O son, I am greatly aggrieved on account of the abandonment of my son, on account of the death of my sons and also on account of being unsuccessful in getting the horse.

question: तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा द्रोणेनामिततेजसा। नाशक्नुवन् वारयितुं समस्तास्ते महारथाः॥
answer: Beholding their array thus shattered by Drona of immeasurable prowess, all those mighty car-warrior were not able to check the former.

question: पाणौ पृषत्का लिखिता ममैते धनुश्च दिव्यं विततं सबाणम्। पादौ च मे सरथौ सध्वजौ च न मादृशं युद्धगतं जयन्ति॥
answer: My palms bear the marks of these arrows and this superb and out-stretched bow with its string trimmed with arrow; the soles of my feet also bear the marks of a car and a standard; and so when a person (with all these marks on) goes to battle, he, least of all, can be triumphed over."

question: ततः प्रववृत्ते युद्धं कुरूणां पाण्डवैः सह। अक्षद्यूतकृतं राजन् सुघोरं वैशसं तदा॥
answer: Then ensued a battle between the Kurus and the Pandavas. O king, that owed its origin to that game at dice and that brought about awful carnage.

question: ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या न शिष्यन्ति जनाधिप। एकवर्णस्तदा लोको भविष्यति युगक्षये॥
answer: O ruler of men, the Brahmanas, the Kshatriyas and the Vaishyas will disappear, leaving no trace of their orders. At this time all men will be of one order.

question: प्रास्फुरन्नयनं चास्य वाम बाहुस्तथैव च। विमनाश्चाभवद् युद्धे दृष्ट्वा पार्षतमग्रतः॥
answer: His eyes and his left arms began to tremble. And beholding Prishata's son before him, he became cheerless.

question: पादजोच्छिष्टकांस्यं यद् गवा ध्रातमथापि वा। गण्डूषोच्छिष्टमपि वा विशुध्येद् दशभिस्तु तत्॥
answer: Plates desercated by a Shudra eating off it, or a vessel of the same metal that has been smelt by a cow, or stained by a Brahmana's Gandusha, may be cleansed by the ten purifying substances.

question: मत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तं न त्वां कश्चित् समुत्सहेत्। मनसा ग्रहणं कर्तुं रक्षाध्यक्षपुरस्कृतम्॥
answer: When you have sought my protection, know that no one will have the courage to even think of catching you, who have such a protector to take care of your body.

question: असंशयं पुण्यशीलः प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम्। त्रिविष्टपे पुण्यतमं स्थानं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
answer: Forsooth, a person of righteous deeds acquires a high end. By such deeds men earn highly happy regions in heaven.

question: यक्षा: साध्याः पिशाचाश्च गुह्यकाः पितरस्तथा। ततः प्रसूता विद्वांसः शिष्टा ब्रह्मर्षि-सत्तमाः॥ राजर्षयश्च बहवः सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः। आपो द्यौः पृथिवी वायुरन्तरिक्षं दिशस्तथा॥
answer: The Yakshas, the Sadhyas, the Pisachas, the Guhyakas and the Pitris. Then were produced the wise and the most holy Brahmarshi and the numerous Rajarshis, distinguished for every noble quality, then the water, the heavens, the earth, the sky and the points of the heavens.

question: नगाह्वयो नाम नगारिसूनुः। एषोऽङ्गनावेषधरः किरीटी जित्वा वयं नेष्यति चाद्य गावः॥
answer: O you born of a river (Bhishma), this man dressed as a woman, is Kiriti (Arjuna) the son of the enemy of mountains (Indra) and having on his banner the emblem of the destroyer of Lanka's gardens. Defeating us today he will surely take away the kine.

question: लोहिताम्बरसंवीतो लोहितस्त्रग्विभूषणः। लोहिताश्वो महाबाहुर्हिरण्यकवचः प्रभुः॥
answer: That mighty armed lord was clad in red , clothes, adorned with garlands of red flowers and incased in golden armour.

question: पितुर्निदेशं नियमेन कृत्वा वनान्निवृत्तश्चरितव्रतश्च। स्त्रीभिस्तु मन्ये विपुलेक्षणाभिः संरंस्यसे वीतभयः कृतार्थः॥
answer: And duly satisfying your sire's command, and returning successfully from the forest, you shall fearlessly sport with many a damsel having large eyes.

question: धर्मात्मा धृतिमान् वीरः सत्यसंधो जितेन्द्रियः। जनमेजयं सुधन्वानं गयं पूरुं बृहद्रथम्॥ असितं च नृगं चैव मान्धाता मनुजोऽजयत्।
answer: Of righteous soul, endued with great intelligence and heroic and devoted to truth and of controlled passions, Mandhatri conquered, through the force of his bow, Janarmejaya, Sudhanva, Gaya, Puru, Brihadratha, Asita and king Nriga.

question: अनुक्रोशो दया चैव यथार्ह मयि वः कृतः। चिरं दुःखस्य पापीयो गम्यतामर्थसिद्धये॥
answer: You have shown due compassion and regret for me. To grieve long is not fit. do you therefore repair to look after your interests.

question: पितर ऊचुः नार्हसे क्षत्रबन्धुंस्त्वं निहन्तुं जयतां वरा नेह युक्तं त्वया हन्तुं ब्राह्मणेन सता नृपान्॥
answer: The departed manes then said, O foremost of all victorious men, you should not kill these inferior Kshatriyas! It is not proper that your self, being a Brahmanas should kill these kings.

question: व्राह्मण उवाच गन्धान् न जिघ्रामि न वेधि रसान् रूपं न पश्यामि न च स्पृशामि। न चापि शब्दान् विविधाशृणोमि न चापि संकल्पमुपैमि कंचित्॥
answer: I do not smell scents. I do not get tastes. I do not see colours. I do not likewise hear the various sounds Nor do I entertain purposes of any kind.

question: स विनद्य महानादं गजः किङ्किणभूषणः। पतन्नवाक्शिरा भूमौ हस्त्यारोहमपोथयत्॥
answer: Then emitting a loud noise that elephant, clad with mail, fell headlong upon the ground crushing its riders by its fall.

question: आवर्जिता इवाभान्ति नीपाश्चित्रककौकुराः। कारस्कारा लोहजङ्घा युधिष्ठिरनिवेशने॥
answer: The Nipas, the Chitrakas, the Kukuras, the Karaskaras and the Lohajanghas are living in the Yudhishthira's palace like bondsmen.

question: श्रीभगवानुवाच प्रतिगृहणे वरं वीरावीप्सितश्च वरो मम। युवां हि वीर्यसम्पन्नौ न वामस्ति समः पुमान्॥ वध्यत्वमुपगच्छेतां मम सत्यपराक्रमौ। एतदिच्छाम्यहं कामं प्राप्तुं लोकहिताय वै॥
answer: The Deity said: I shall accept a boon from you. There is a boon which I desire (to have from you). Both of you are indeed endued with very great prowess. There is none equal to you (on earth). O heroes of matchless prowess, allow yourselves to be killed by me. This is what I desire to do for the good of the world.

question: हतपुत्रास्मि भगवंस्तव पुत्रैर्महाबलैः। शक्रहन्तारमिच्छामि पुत्रं दीर्घतपोर्जितम्॥
answer: O adorable one, your high-souled sons have slain mine. I now wish for a son, who, obtained through long austerities, will be able to slay Sakra.

question: त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभि व शक्यं पदात् पदम्। क्वचिद् गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते॥
answer: Verily we speak to you, O foremost of monkeys, that without your permission, none among us, is capable of advancing a single step.”

question: कथमस्याभवद् वैरं कारणं किं च तत् प्रभो। शंस पृष्टो महाप्राज्ञ न हि तृष्यामि कथ्यति॥
answer: What, O lord, was the cause of the quarrel between Vashishtha and Vishvamitra? Asked by me, O you of great wisdom, tell me all this. I am never satiated with hearing your account.”

question: लाजगन्धोदवर्षैस्तु सेव्यमानः शनैः शनैः। राजवीथ्यास्तु शीतत्वात्संज्ञां प्राप महाबलः।॥
answer: Then the mighty one (Sugriva) slowly recovered his senses with the shower of fried paddy and sweet scent and the sprinkling of water as well as with the coolness of the streets.

question: योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्ती।त्युत्तमविक्रमः। अनिःश्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति॥
answer: Having cleared an hundred Yoyanas, that monkey gifted with first-rate prowess, did not heave sighs or feel any fatigue.

question: देवाः साध्यास्तथा विश्वे तथैव च महर्षयः। यामा धामाश्च मौद्गल्य गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा।॥ एषां देवनिकायानां पृथक् पृथगनेकशः। भास्वन्त: कामसम्पन्ना लोकास्तेजोमयाः शुभाः॥
answer: O Mudgala, there are established separately myriads of beautiful, shinning and respendent worlds bestowing every object of desire owned by those celestial beings, the gods, the Sadhyas, the Vishvadevas, the great sages, the Yamas, the Dhamas and the Gandharvas and the Apsaras.

question: स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः। अभवद् वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः॥
answer: And with his limbs wounded by them, and his hair wetted with blood, that monkey resembling in splendour the infant sun, grew furiously enraged.

question: यथा ग्रामान्तरं गच्छन् नरः कश्चिद् बहिर्वसेत्। उत्सृज्य च तमावासं प्रतिष्ठेतापरेऽहनि॥ एवमेव मनुष्याणां पिता माता गृहं वसु। आवासमात्रं काकुत्स्थ सज्जन्ते नात्र सज्जनाः॥
answer: No individual has any one (in the world). As on the eve of setting out for another country, a person stays somewhere (outside the village he lives in), and the next day goes away, renouncing that abode, even such are a man's father and mother, house and wealth. O Kākutstha, worthy people never bear affection towards a mere abode.

question: तौ पौत्रौ तव दुर्घर्षों परस्परवधैषिणौ। पितॄणामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थे चक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम्॥
answer: Those two grandsons of yours, of prowess difficult of being checked, desirous of slaying each other. Fought admirable with each other for bringing about the success of their respective sire's purposes.

question: स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ। वानरैः सहितः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह॥
answer: And adoring Sugrīva and the highly powerful descendants of Raghu, he along with other heroic monkeys, leaped up in the sky.

question: अथ सा स्त्री तथोवाच भगवन् पश्य वै रवेः। रूपं संध्याभ्रसंरक्तं किमुपस्थाष्यतां तव॥
answer: The lady then addressed him, saying O illustrious one, look at the Sun reddened by the evening clouds! What service shall I do to you.

question: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तथा प्रशस्य ह्यभिपूज्य चैव वरस्त्रियं तामृषयः समागताः। नरेन्द्रमामन्त्र्य सपुत्रमञ्जसा शिवेन जग्मुर्मुदिताः स्वमालयम्॥
answer: Markandeya said : The assembled sages, then, having eulogised and paid their adorations to that most exalted lady and having taken leave of that most excellent of kings together with his son, soon left for their respective asylums in peace and with merry hearts.

question: विषेण सर्पबन्धैश्च यतिताः पाण्डवास्त्वया। सर्वोपायैर्विनाशाय न समृद्धं च तत् तव॥
answer: By poison, by snake, and by rope, in fact by every means was the destruction of the sons of Pandu attempted by you but that attempt of yours was not successful.

question: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन् द्रौपदी योषितां वरा॥ चिन्तामवाप परमामन्नहेतोः पतिव्रता।
answer: In the interval, O king, Draupadi, the best of women ever devoted to her husband, began to think how she could provide food.

question: यच्छेद् वाङ्मनसी बुद्ध्या तां यच्छेज्ज्ञानचक्षुषा। ज्ञानमात्मावबोधेन यच्छेदात्मानमात्मना॥
answer: Speech and mind are to be controlled by the Understanding, and the Understanding, in its turn, by the eye of knowledge. Knowledge, again, is to be controlled by the knowledge of the Soul, and finally the Soul it to be controlled by the Soul.

question: जङ्गमानि च भूतानि सर्वाण्येवावतस्थिरे। देवर्षयश्च प्रवरास्तथैव च दिवौकसः॥
answer: And the mobile beings-all these creatures arrived there. The most exalted Devarshis, the celestials,

question: कीट उवाच शकटस्यास्य महतो घोषं श्रुत्वा भयं मम। आगतं वै महाबुद्धे स्वन एष हि दारुणः॥
answer: The worm said I am stricken with fear on hearing the rattle of that large car. O you of great intelligence, it makes a fearful roar. It is almost come.

question: ऋत्विज ऊचुः यथा शास्त्राणि न: प्राहुर्यथा शंसति पावकः। इन्द्रस्य भवने राजस्तक्षको भयपीडितः॥
answer: The Ritvijas said : O king, Takshaka is now living in fear in the abode of Indra. The Shastra declares this to us and the Fire also says it.

question: अनुजग्मुश्च तं वीरं देव्यस्ता वै स्वलंकृताः। स्त्रीसहस्रः परिवृता वधूभिश्च सहस्रशः॥
answer: The body of the hero was followed by his wives decked in ornaments and surrounded by thousands of women and thousands of their daughter-in-law.

question: अलीकं मानसं त्वेकं हृदयं दहते मम। स्वयं यन्नाह मां राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्॥
answer: But this one sorrow burns my heart, why king did not tell me personally of the installation of Bharata.

question: अत्रेश्चैवौरसः श्रीमान् राजा सोमश्च वीर्यवान्। सहस्रं यश्च दिव्यानां युगानां पर्युपासिता॥
answer: Atri had another son born of his lions, viz., the handsome and princely Soma of great power. He practised penances for a thousand divine cycles.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच उपातिष्ठत सा सूर्यं मुहूर्तमबला ततः। स तस्यास्तनुमध्यायाः सर्वं सूर्योऽवबुद्धवान्॥
answer: Vaishampayana said Then that helpless one worshipped the sungod for a moment and the deity understood all the prayers of her of slender waist.

question: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुराहं रूपमास्थितः। उदतिष्ठन्महाबाहो स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः॥
answer: Meanwhile, O mighty-armed one, Vishnu in his Boar form came before the assembled gods, his praises lauded by the great Rishis.

question: शल्यं सेनापतिं कृत्वा मद्रराजं महारथाः। प्रविभज्य बलं सर्वमनीकेषु व्यवस्थिताः॥
answer: Having made the king of the Madras their leader, the great car-warriors, of the Kauravas, made detachments of their soldiers.

question: तस्याः स्वयंवरः शक्र भविता न चिरादिव। तत्र गच्छन्ति राजानो राजपुत्राश्च सर्वशः॥
answer: O Shakra, her Svayamvara will shortly take place. There the kings and princes are going from all directions.

question: विभीषणमुखानां च सुहृदां राघवाज्ञया। सर्ववानरमुख्यानां चिकित्सासमकरोत्तदा ॥
answer: At the mandate of Rāghava he likewise treated his friends headed by Vibhișaņa and all the principal monkeys.

question: शक्त्या निपातितं दृष्ट्वा रावणेन बलीयसा। लक्ष्मणं समरे शूरं शोणितौधपरिप्लुतम् ॥ स दत्त्वा तुमुलं युद्ध रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। विसृजन्नेव बाणौघान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Seeing the heroic Lakşmaņa brought down by the dart discharged by the powerful Rāvana and lying drenched in blood, he (Rama) after having fought furiously with the wicked-minded Ravana-and having showered vollies of shafts, addressed Susena, saying.

question: स निर्भिद्य रणे पार्थ सूतपुत्रधनुश्च्युतः। अगच्छद् दारयन् भूमिं चित्रपुलः शिलीमुखः॥
answer: That shaft or variegated wing shot from the bow of Suta's son pierced through the son of Pritha and then penetrating the earth went inside it.

question: सोऽहमेनां गतिं प्राप्तो यथा न कुशलं तथा त्वया साधो समागम्य विमुक्तः पापयोनितः॥
answer: It was for this I had led a life like one of uncleaned soul! O righteous one, by you, however, I have been rescued from that sinful life.

question: ततो बाणसहस्राणि प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः। सूतपुत्रवधाकाङ्क्षी त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी॥
answer: Then the puissant son of Pandu quickly shot thousands of arrows, desirous of accomplishing the death of Suta's son.

question: द्रौणिरुवाच इममात्मानमद्याहं जातमाङ्गिरसे कुले। स्वग्नौ जुहोमि भगवन् प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मां बलिम्॥
answer: Ashvatthaman said Born in Angira's family I am about to pour my soul, O god, as a lit ion on this fire. Accept, O lord, this victim.

question: शब्दश्च तुमुल: संख्ये शराणां पततामभूत्। महावेणुवनस्येव दह्यमानस्य पर्वते॥
answer: Loud noise, of the falling shafts in that battle, resembled that of a vast forest of bamboo's while burning on every side.

question: ततोऽभ्यगाद् देवराजो विरूपाक्षपुरं तदा। प्राह चेदं विरूपाक्षं दिष्ट्या संजीवितस्त्वया॥
answer: At this time, the king of the gods himself came to the city of Virupaksha. Addressing the Rakshasa king, Indra said, —By good luck, you have revived the prince of cranes.

question: ततः सोमाश्रमं गत्वा देवगन्धर्वसेवितम्। कालं नाम महासानुं पर्वतं तं गमिष्यथ॥
answer: Then, coming upon the hermitage of Soma, frequented by gods and Gandharvas, do you repair to the mountain called kāla possessing spacious plateaus,

question: स वायुवीर्यप्रतिमो वायुवेगसमो जवे। वायुवद् व्यचरद् भीमो वायुपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥
answer: Bhima, the son of the Wind-god and himself possessing the prowess and impetuousity of the wind, that valiant Bhima began to career in that battle like that of the wind itself.

question: न लुब्धो बुध्यते दोषाँ ल्लोभान्मोहात् प्रवर्तते। मधुलिप्सुर्हि नापश्यं प्रपातमहमीदृशम्॥
answer: A covetous man never finds his own shortcomings; and it is from folly, that covetousness proceeds. Desirous of collecting the honey, I could not see that such a fall threatened me.

question: स त्वं क्षुद्रसमाचारो नीचात्मा पापनिश्चयः॥ आकेशाग्रान्नखाग्राच्च वक्तव्यो वक्तुमिच्छसि।
answer: Ill-behaved, of low mind and sinful resolutions, you are condemnable from the end of your hair to the tip of your toe. Yet do you desire to censure others?

question: व्यायच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा तत्परं रावणं रणे॥ प्रहसन्निव काकुत्स्थः संदधे निशिताञ्छरान्। स मुमोच ततो बाणाञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
answer: Beholding Rāvana in the encounter thus actively engaged in the discharged of arrows, Kakuthstha, smiling set up pointed shafts, and discharged them by hundreds and thousands.

question: यस्य सत्त्वस्य या योनिस्तस्यां तत् परिमार्गते। न शक्यं प्रमदा नष्टा मृगीषु परिमार्गितुम्॥
answer: People search for creatures among the species to which they happen to belong: none scarchets for a lost lady among female deer.

question: बलाहकेनेव महाबलाहको यद्दच्छया वा गिरिणा यथा गिरिः। तथा धनुातलनेमिनिस्वनैः समीयतुस्ताविषुवर्षवर्षिणौ॥
answer: Those two warriors, with bows twanging loudly and sending forth hosts of shafts and the palms of their hands also producing great sounds when shooting them and their carwheels making rattling, encountered each other like the collision of two heavy masses of clouds or two mountains.

question: नूनं वैवस्वतश्च त्वां वरुणश्च प्रियातिथिम्॥ शतक्रतुर्धनेशश्च प्राप्तमर्चन्त्यभीरुकम्।
answer: "Surely Yama, Varuna, Indra of hundred sacrifices and Kubera, receiving yourself as a welcome guest, are making preparations for worshipping you.”

question: यत्र तिष्ठन्ति नित्यं हि हंसाः सर्वगुणान्विताः। अथ अर्ध्वं तु गत्वा वै मरुत्पथमनुत्तमम्॥
answer: He then went to the excellent upper aerial region where live perpetually ganders gifted with many accomplishments.

question: उवाच पार्थो मा भैषीः प्रहस्य स्वनवत् तदा।३५॥ युध्यमानस्य मे वीर गन्धर्वैः सुमहाबलैः। सहायो घोषयात्रायां कस्तदाऽऽसीत्सखा मम॥ तथा प्रतिभये तस्मिन् देवदानवसंकुले। खाण्डवे युध्यमानस्य कस्तदाऽऽसीत्सखा मम॥ निवातकवचैः सार्धं पौलोमैश्च महाबलैः। युध्यतो देवराजार्थे कः सहायस्तदाभवत्॥ स्वयंवरे तु पाञ्चाल्या राजभिः सह संयुगे। युध्यतो बहुभिस्तात कः सहायस्तदाभवत्॥ उपजीव्य गुरुं द्रोणं शक्रं वैश्रवणं यमम्। वरुणं पावकं चैव कृपं कृष्णं च माधवम्॥ पिनाकपाणिनं चैव कथमेतान् न योधये। रथं वाहय मे शीघ्रं व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः॥
answer: Then smiling Partha said to him-"What friendly follower I had, O hero, while fighting with the powerful Gandharvas on the occasion of Ghoshayatra? Who was my friend while fighting at a terrible battle at Khandava with so many celestials and Danavas? Who was my friend, when I fought for the celestials with the powerful Nivatakavachas and the Paulamas? And who was my friend when I fought with the numberless kings at the Svayamvara of the princess of Panchala? Learning the art of fighting from the preceptor Drona, Shakra, Vaishravana, Yama, Varuna, Agni, Kripa, Krishna of Madhu's race and the holder of trident why shall I not fight with these? Drive this car speedily-and let the fears of your heart be removed.

question: सुप्तायां दमयन्त्यां तु नलो राजा विशाम्यते। शोकोन्मथितचित्तात्मा न स्म शेते तथा पुरा॥
answer: O lord of your subjects! when Damayanti fell asleep, king Nala, owing to his heart and mind being agitated with grief, could not sleep as before (in his days of happiness).

question: पुन तेन मां जित्वा वनवासं सुदारुणम्। प्रावाजयन् महारण्यमजिनैः परिवारितम्॥
answer: And defeating me at dice a second time, they have exiled me into the fearful woods, where I lead a disastrous life, clad in deer-skin.

question: तथैवाप्सरसामङ्के प्रतिसुप्तः प्रबोध्यते॥ नूपुराणां निनादेन मेखलानां च नि:स्वनैः।
answer: He sleeps on the lap of Apsaras and is awakened every morning by the melodious sound of Nupuras and Kanchis.
