question: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञामश्वत्थामा महाबलः। धनुः प्रपीड्य वामेन करेणामित्रकर्शनः॥
answer: Regaining his consciousness, that grinder of foes, the mighty car-warriors Ashvatthama, drawing powerfully his bow with the left hand.

question: सर्वथा त्वक्षमं चैतद् रोचते च ममानघ। यत् त्वं पितरि भीष्मे च प्रणिपातं समाचरेः॥
answer: It is proper by all means and my wish, too, that you should pay proper respects to him who is like a father to you, as also to Bhishma.

question: पश्चादिमां पिता प्रादाद्धगवेऽनृतकारकः। सेयं यदि वरारोहा भृगोर्भार्या रहोगता॥
answer: was a But her vile father subsequently gave her to Bhrigu. (Tell me truly) if she can be truly called the wife of Bhrigu.

question: भोजयित्वा दशशतं नरो वेदविदां नृप। न्यायविद्धर्मविदुषामितिहासविदां तथा॥ न याति नरकं घोरं संसारांश्च न सेवते। सर्वकामसमायुक्तः प्रेत्य चाप्यश्नुते सुखम्॥
answer: A person by feeding, O king a thousand Brahmanas who are all conversant with duties and the scriptures and the sacred histories, has not to go to Hell and to return to this world for going through rebirths. Gifted with the fruition of every desire he enjoys great happiness in the next world.

question: चिरकारिक भद्रं ते भद्रं ते चिरकारिक। यद्यद्य चिरकारी त्वं ततोऽसि चिरकारिकः॥
answer: Twice blessed be you, O Chirakarin! If on this occasion you have delayed accomplishing the work, then are you truly worthy of your name!

question: पुण्यानि यानि कुर्वीत श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः। अनाप्तदक्षिणैर्यज्ञैर्न यजेत कथञ्चन॥
answer: A person should, after having controlled his senses, and with proper devotion, do all the meritorious acts. One should never adore gods in sacrifices in which no Dakshina is given.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच अव्याहरति राजेन्द्रे धर्मपुत्रे युधिष्ठिरे। गुडाकेशो हृषीकेशमभ्यभाषत पाण्डवः॥
answer: "That highest of kings, viz., Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, still rentained silent and Pandu's son Arjuna addressed Krishna and spoke as follows.

question: के पूर्वं प्राहरंस्तत्र युद्धे हृदयकम्पने। मामकाः पाण्डवेया वा तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
answer: In the great battle that makes every one's heart tremble, who were they who struck the first blow; were they my men or did they belong to the Pandavas? O Sanjaya, tell me all this in detail.

question: इदमन्यत् प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा दृष्टं गिरौ मया। श्रुत्वा तदपि कौरव्य यथा श्रेयस्तथा कुरु॥
answer: or I shall speak of something else, which was seen by me in a mountain and hearing that too, O son of Kuru, do whatever is good.

question: यथाप्रतिज्ञं कौरव्यः स चापि समितिंजयः। पार्थानामकरोद् भीष्मः सततं समितिक्षयम्॥
answer: That conqueror of assembled enemies, viz., Bhishma, that foremost of Kuru heroes ever redeeming his vows, also destroyed the hosts of the Pandavas.

question: निर्जने मृगसंकीर्णे नानादुमलताकुले। लताप्रतानबहुले नानागुल्मसमावृते॥
answer: Solitary, abounding in wild animals, filled with various trees, creepers, entwining creepers and various groves.

question: अथ जीवति नः शत्रुर्वयं च कृतसंयुगाः। ततः समभिपत्स्यामो मनसा यत्समीक्षितम्॥
answer: But if our foe live after fight and we also having faught the fight, then shall we do what I conceive in my mind.

question: कामक्रोधौ हि पुरुषमर्थेभ्यो व्यपकर्षतः। तौ तु शत्रु विनिर्जित्य राजा विजयते महीम्॥
answer: Desire and wrath snatch away a man from earthy good; after subjugating these two enemies does a king conquer the earth.

question: भग्ना इत्येव भज्यन्ते विद्वांसोऽपि न कारणम्। उदारसारा महती रुरुसंघोपमा चमूः॥
answer: Seeing some routed, others, even through they are brave and skilled in fight, break without sufficient cause. A larger army, consisting of brave soldiers, is like a large herd or Ruru deer.

question: स्थितं पूर्वं जलं यत्र पुनस्तत्रैव गच्छति। इति पर्यायमिच्छन्ती प्रतीक्षे उदयं पुनः॥
answer: It is with this hope, I am expecting the return of favorable fortune; once before where there was water, there comes it back again. Hoping for this change, I am awaiting the return of prosperity.

question: ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदायाग्रं यः सुहृद्भिः सहाश्नुते। स प्रेत्य लभते स्वर्गमिह चानन्त्यमश्नुते॥
answer: He, however, who dedicates the first portion of Brahmanas, and takes the residue, dividing it with friends and kinsmen acquires great felicity in the next world and infinite happiness here.

question: माल्यैर्गन्धैश्च विविधैरर्चयित्वा यथाविधि। कुल्यानि तेषां संयोज्य तदाचख्युर्महीपतेः॥
answer: Having duly honoured those remains with garlands and scents of various kinds and disposed of them, they informed Yudhishthria of the accomplishment of their task.

question: वृक्षाणां ककुदोऽसि त्वं गिरीणां शिखराणि च। व्याघ्रो मृगाणां पततां तार्योऽनन्तश्च भोगिनाम्॥
answer: You are the tops of all tress, you are the highest summits of all mountains. You are the tiger among the lower animals, you are Garuda among birds, and you are Ananta among snakes.

question: हयौधान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा द्रवमाणांस्ततस्ततः। रणे माधवपार्थाभ्यां मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
answer: Mescems my sons are lamenting seeing large bodies of steeds slain and routed in all directions in battle, by the son of Pritha and the descendant of Madhu's race.

question: श्रुत्वा यथेष्टं च कुरु वीर यत् तव रोचते। भवान् प्राज्ञतमो नित्यं मम चैव परा गतिः॥
answer: O hero, you are the greatest sage are always my highest protection as well. Now, having heard my words, do whatever you desire, or whatever you like most.

question: पुरा कृतयुगे तात आसीद् राजा हकम्पनः। स शत्रुवशमापन्नो मध्ये संग्राममूर्धनि॥
answer: In the days of yore during the Krita-yuga, O Sire, there lived a certain king by name Akampana. Once on a time, on the field of battle, amongst his foes, he was on the point of succumbing to his enemies.

question: ऋक्षाः पृषतमुख्याश्च रुरवश्च समन्ततः। दृश्यन्ते वनवाटेषु गिरिष्वपि नदीषु च॥ .
answer: And bears and Prsatas and Rurus were on all sides seen in the forest-ways, and on hills and rivers.

question: कुतोऽहमागतः कोऽस्मि क्व गमिष्यामि कस्य वा। कस्मिन् स्थितः क्व भविता कस्मात्किमनुशोचसि।।१४।
answer: Whence have I come? Who am I? Where shall I go? Whose am I? Before what do I rest? What shall I be? Why then do you grieve for what?

question: वसुदेवसुतो यद्वत् पाण्डवाय दृढव्रतः। वसु चैव शरीरं च पुत्रदारं तथा यशः॥ सर्वं दुर्योधनस्यार्थे त्यक्त मे भूरिदक्षिण। मा चैतद् व्याधिमरणं क्षत्रं स्यादिति कौरव॥
answer: Like the son of Vasudeva who is firmly resolved to do good to the Pandavas, I also, have set at naught, you that bestow profuse gifts to the Brahmanas, my wealth, my sons, my wife and even my own body and honour. Death resulting from disease is not, indeed, a meet end for a Kshatriya, O you of Kuru's race.

question: मुञ्जवज्जर्जरीभूता बहवस्तत्र पादपाः॥ चीराणीव व्युदस्तानि रेजुस्तत्र महावने। तद् वृक्षयुद्धमभवन्मुहूर्तं भरतर्षभ। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य नराणामुत्तमस्य च॥
answer: In that great forest innumerable trees, crushed like reeds, lay scattered like rags. O best of the Bharata race, that fight with trees between that foremost of Rakshasass (Kirmira) and that best of men (Bhima) lasted but for a moment.

question: ततः सृष्टानि भूतानि तानि यान्ति पुनः पुनः। महाभूतानि भूतेभ्य ऊर्मयः सागरे यथा॥
answer: From those five primal elements are created all creatures, and into those five great elements all creatures resolve themselves, again and again, like the numberless waves of the Ocean rising from the Ocean and merging into that which causes thein.

question: एवमेष चरन् पार्थ कालचक्रमतन्द्रितः। प्रकर्षन् सर्वभूतानि सविता परिवर्तते॥
answer: Thus increasingly turning on the wheel of time and influencing all creatures, O Partha, Savita goes on his course.

question: यानन्यान् ददृशे भीमश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतान्। पुत्रांस्तव महाराज त्वरया ताञ्जघान ह॥
answer: O mighty-armed one, other sons of yours, who became the objects of Bhima's sight, were slain by him in a moment,

question: आप्तो दूतः संजय सुप्रियोऽसि कल्याणवाक् शीलवांस्तृप्तिमांश्च। न मुह्येस्त्वं संजय जातु मत्या न च क्रुद्ध्येरुच्यमानो दुरुक्तैः॥
answer: As an enjoy sent (by them) O Sanjaya, you have made yourself dear to us and you are of peaceful speech, well behaved and satisfy every body. You are not ill disposed towards us and through spoken to harshly you are never angry.

question: स राज्ञा स्वयमाचार्यो भृशमत्रार्थितोऽर्जुन। संविधानं च विहितं रथाश्च किल सज्जिताः॥
answer: O Arjuna, thus addressed the king himself entreated the preceptor to undertake to protect Jayadratha. All remedial measures have been adopted; and chariots and steeds have been duly arranged.

question: रोमकूपेषु च तथा सूर्यस्येव मरीचयः। तं दृष्ट्वा घोरमात्मानं केशवस्य महात्मनः॥
answer: From the poor of his skin issued in the same way something like the rays of the sun; seeing that frightful appearance of the greatsouled Keshava.

question: येऽधिगच्छन्ति तं सन्त स्तेषां नास्ति भयं पुनः। ऊर्वे चाधश्च तिर्यक् च तस्य नान्तोऽधिगम्यते॥
answer: Its end cannot be determined upwards, downwards, or horizontally.

question: अन्तर्भेदे च संजाते दुःखं संस्मृत्य च प्रभो। अभूतपूर्वो बीभत्सोर्दुःखान्मन्युरजायत॥
answer: And agitated at heart and remembering all his former woes, O lord, Vibhatsu was possessed by an anger engendered of brief, the like of which had never possessed him before.

question: निर्बन्धतस्तु बहुशो गालवस्य तपस्विनः। किंचिदागतसंरम्भो विश्वामित्रऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
answer: Vishvamitra, a little angry at the excessive obstinacy of the devotee Galava, said this to him:

question: संस्कारैः संस्कृतः पूर्वं यथावच्चरितव्रतः। जातौ गुणविशिष्टायां समावर्तेत तत्त्ववित्॥
answer: He who has been first purified by ceremonies, who has duly observed vows, who belongs by birth to a family of high qualifications, and who understands the Vedas, should return (from his preceptor's house).

question: एवमुक्ते तु वचने शतानन्दस्य संनिधौ। आगताः केचिदव्यग्रा जनकस्तान् समादिशत्॥
answer: This having been said to Satānanda, some competent persons presented themselves; and Janaka commanded them (to set up) for Sāņkāśyā.

question: जात्यन्धैरिह तुल्यास्ते मृतैः पङ्गुभिरेव च। समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति गङ्गां पुण्यजलां शिवाम्॥
answer: Those who, although physically able do not seek to see the sacred Ganga, are, forsooth, comparable persons suffering from congenital blindness or those who are dead or those who are benumbed through palsy or lameness.

question: सा समीक्ष्य तु तान् देवान् पुण्यश्लोकं च भारत। नैषधं वरयामास भैमीधर्मेण पाण्डव॥
answer: O Bharata, she saw both the celestials and that righteous king. But, O descendant of Pandu, the daughter of Bhima accepted (as her husband) the prince of the Nishadhas in accordance with her vow.

question: निद्राविशदनेत्रस्तु कलुषीकृतलोचनः। चारयन्सर्वतो दृष्टिं तानुवाच निशाचरान्॥
answer: Then with his eyes discoloured and drooping from drowsiness, he casting his eyes around addressed those night-rangers.

question: धौम्य उवाच विहितं पाण्डवाः सर्वं ब्राह्मणेषु सुहृत्सु च। याने प्रहरणे चैव तथैवाग्निषु भारत॥
answer: O Pandavas, you have made arrangements in regard to the Brahmanas, friends, weapons and also in regard to the fires.

question: तस्य चास्त्राणि दिव्यानि विविधानि महात्मनः। गाण्डीवस्य न निर्घोषो धैर्याणि हरते हि नः॥
answer: Thai high-souled warrior is a master of many sorts of celestial weapons. The twang, of Gandiva, deprives us of our energies.

question: स्वजनं हि यदा मृत्युर्हन्त्येव तव पश्यतः। कृतेऽपि यत्ने महति तत्र बोद्धव्यमात्मना॥
answer: When your relatives are carried away by Death in your very presence and despite you utmost efforts to save them, that circumstance alone should awaken you.

question: ब्रह्मोवाच य उत्पन्नो महान् पूर्वमहंकारः स उच्यते। अहमित्येव सम्भूतो द्वितीयः सर्ग उच्यते॥
answer: Brahman said That Mahat or principle of greatness who was first produced is called Egoism. When, it originated as I, it came to be called as the second creation.

question: विद्यमाने धने लोभाद् दानभोगविवर्जितः। पश्चान्नास्तीति यो ब्रूयात् सोऽक्षयं नरकं व्रजेत्॥
answer: He also who has wealth, but who never enjoys it nor gives it away through avarice and says he has none, is doomed to eternal damnation.

question: एतद्विदितमार्यस्य विवासकरणं तव। भर्तुर्भवतु किं चान्यत् क्रियतां तद् वदस्व मे॥
answer: I have thus told you the reason of my husband's absence from home. Be that as it may, what else is there that I can do for you? Tell me this.

question: समरेषु च विक्रान्तं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्। आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह॥ मया विनिर्जिताः पूर्वं मरुतश्च शचीपते। त्वमेव शक्र जानासि देवासुरसमागमे॥ नियतं कालपाशेन बद्धं शक्र विकस्थसे। समेता विबुधा भग्नास्तरसा समरे मया। पर्वताश्चासकृत् क्षिप्ताः सवनाः सवनौकसः॥
answer: The energy and might used to display in all my battles, prove it clearly. The Adityas, the Rudras, the Saddhyas, the Vasus, and the Maruts, O lord of Shachi, were all defeated by me. You know it well yourself, O Shakra, that in the great battle between the gods and the Asuras, the assembled gods were speedily। routed by me by the fury of my attack. Mountains with their forests and the denizens, were repeatedly hurled by us.

question: तेषां दुर्योधनः श्रुत्वा तानि वाक्यानि जल्पताम्। युधिष्ठिरानुरक्तानां पर्यतप्यत दुर्मतिः॥
answer: The wicked-minded Duryodhana, hearing these words of the men attached towards Yudhisthira, was exceedingly grieved.

question: स्वरूपतामात्मकृतं च विस्तरं कुलान्वयं द्रव्यसमृद्धिसंचयम्। नरो हि सर्वो लभते यथाकृतं शुभाशुभेनात्मकृतेन कर्मणा॥
answer: Through acts good and bad done by himself in his pristine lives, man acquires gold and animals, and wives, and children, and honour of birth, and costly possessions, and his entire affluence.

question: तस्मिन् कुर्वीत विश्वासं राजा कस्याञ्चिदापदि। तापसेषु हि विश्वासमपि कुर्वन्ति दस्यवः॥
answer: Whatever the distress which he befalls him, he should confide in an anchorite. The very ribbers place confidence upon persons of that character.

question: स्वयं तु भार्यां कौमारी चिरमध्युषितां सतीम्। शैलूष इव मां राम परेभ्यो दातुमिच्छसि॥
answer: Do you, like to an ordinary actor, wish to hand me over to others, who am chaste, pure as a virgin, and long held in conjugal affection?

question: शक्राशनिसमस्पर्शेर्लक्ष्मणेनाहतः शरैः। मुहूर्तमभवन्मूढः सर्वसंक्षुभितेन्द्रियः।॥
answer: And smite by Lakşmaņa with arrows having the touch of the levin, (Indrajit) for a while was stupefied and had his senses overwhelmed.

question: यदा तु विषमीभावमाविशन्ति परस्परम्। तदा देहैर्देहवन्तो व्यतिरोहन्ति नान्यथा॥
answer: When these (elements), not existing in the natural state, exist with one another, then all creatures without any deviation spring into life with various sorts of bodies.

question: उत्तरं श्रुतिसम्बद्धं ब्रवीत्यश्रुतियोजितम्। अधर्मस्त्रिविधस्तस्य वर्तते रागदोषजः॥
answer: They are ready with various answers which are neither sound nor convincing. From their attachment for evil ways, they are guilty of threefold sins.

question: चेकितानः शिखण्डी च द्रौपदेयाश्च मारिष।॥ हत्वा त्वदीयं सुमहत् सैन्यं शङ्खांस्तथाधमन्।
answer: Having killed your huge army Chikitan, Shikhandin and the five sons of Draupadi blew their conchs.

question: भृगुरुवाच घनानामपि वृक्षाणामाकाशोऽस्ति न संशयः। तेषां पुष्पफलव्यक्तिर्नित्यं समुपपद्यते॥
answer: Bhrigu said Forsooth, though possessed of density, trees have space within them. They always bear flowers and fruits.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्पूजयन्तस्ते कृष्णां प्रेक्ष्य सभासदः। युधिष्ठिरस्य कोपात् तु ललाटे स्वेद आगमत्॥
answer: Vaishampayana said While the courtiers, seeing Krishna, were praising her in this way, there came from ire the drops of perspiration on the forehead of Yudhishthira.

question: वध्यमानं ततस्तत्र शरैः पार्थस्य संयुगे। दुद्राव कौरवं सैन्यं विषादभयकम्पितम्॥
answer: Thus slaughtered in the battle with the arrows of Partha, the Kuru army, trembling in grief and fear fled away.

question: त्वदीयानां तदा युद्धे संसक्तानां जयैषिणाम्। गिरिमस्तं समासाद्य प्रत्यपद्यत भानुमान्॥
answer: Thus whilst the battle raged most fearfully amongst your troops, who most were enthusiastic with the desire of victory, the Sun, approaching the setting mountain, entered into it.

question: स ददर्श ततः सीतां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। शोकभारैरिव न्यस्तां भारै वमिवाम्भसि॥
answer: And thereupon he beheld Sītā, having a moon-like countenance, plunged in grief like to a laden boat sunk in water.

question: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच अतिहर्षमिमं प्राप्तं शृणु मे त्वं धनंजय। अतीव मनसः सद्यः प्रसादकरमुत्तमम्॥
answer: Vasudeva's son said Overwhelming is the delight that has filled me now. Hear it, O Dhananjaya. What I shall tell you will immediately dispel your sorrow impart joy on your beast.

question: तमसा लोभयुक्तानि क्रोधजानि च सेवते। हिंसाविहाराभिरतस्तन्द्रीनिद्रासमन्वितः॥
answer: Through qualities born of Ignorance, one does all acts fraught with cupidity and springing from anger. In consequence of the attribute of Ignorance, one feels sleep and procrastination and becomes addicted to all acts of crucily and carnality.

question: अगाराणीव शून्यानि शान्तार्चिष इवाग्नयः। इन्द्रियाणि न भासन्ते मया होनानि नित्यशः॥
answer: It always occurs that without inyself, the senses never shine, like habitations cmpty of inmates or fires whose flames have been quenched.

question: देवस्य महतस्तात वारुणीं बिभ्रतस्तनुम्। ऐश्वर्ये वारुणे राम रुद्रस्येशस्य वै प्रभो॥ आजग्मुर्मुनयः सर्वे देवाश्चाग्निपुरोगमाः। यज्ञाङ्गानि च सर्वाणि वषट्कारश्च मूर्तिमान्॥
answer: To a sacrifice performed formerly by that foremost of gods, viz., the Lord of Rudra, O you of great power, who on that occasion had assumed the form of Varuna, there came the ascetics and all the celestials headed by Agni. There also came to that sacrifice all the sacrificial limbs (in their embodied forms), and the Mantra called Vashat in his embodied forin.

question: त्वरन्नेकरथेनैव समेत्य द्रोणमब्रवीत्। गतः स पुरुषव्याघ्रः प्रमथ्यैतां महाचमूम्॥
answer: Hastily riding on a single car, he repaired to Drona ‘and addressing him said "That foremost of men Arjuna has already passed through this mighty army, having crushed it completely.

question: लोकयज्ञैर्नृयज्ञैश्च कपर्दी विदधे धनुः। धनुः सृष्टमभूत् तस्य पञ्चकिष्कुप्रमाणतः॥
answer: Kaparddin made that bow out of the materials of the first and the fourth kinds of Sacrifices. The length of that bow was five cubits.

question: तस्या द्वारं समासाद्य न्यसेथाः कुणपं क्वचित्। तं दृष्ट्वा यो निवर्तेत संवर्तः स महीपते॥ तं पृष्ठतोऽनुगच्छेथा यत्र गच्छेत् स वीर्यवान्। तमेकान्ते समासाद्य प्राञ्जलिः शरणं व्रजेः॥
answer: And having reached the gate of the city, you must place a dead body somewhere near it, and the man who shall turn away on seeing the dead body, do you, O prince, know that man to be Samvarta, and knowing him, do you follow his footsteps wherever that powerful man wishes to go, and finding him (at length) in a lonely place you must seek his protection with your hands clasped together.

question: तस्य नागं मणिमयं रत्नचित्रध्वजे स्थितम्। भल्लाभ्यां कार्मुकं चैव क्षिप्रं चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥
answer: Duryodhana had an (artificial) elephant embossed with gems and jewels as the device gracing his banner; this elephant together with the former's blow, the son of Pandu severed with two Bhallas in all haste.

question: यतमानांस्तुतान् वीरान् भारद्वाजः शिलीमुखैः। यमाय प्रेषयामास चेदिमुख्यान् विशेषतः॥
answer: As those heroes were struggling against him, the son of Bharadvaja with his arrows, dispatched them to the regions of Death, specially those foremost among the Chedis. one

question: क्रोधाद् यं पुरुषं पश्येस्तथा शकसमाते। स क्षिप्रं न भवेद् व्यक्तमिति त्वां वेनि कौरव॥
answer: O you of effulgence equal to Shakra (Indra), that person on whom you cast a look of anger, surely meets with death for it has been seen and so I know, O Kaurava.

question: धनैर्विशिष्टान् मतिशीलपूजितान् गुणोपपन्नान् युधि दृष्टविक्रमान्। गुणेषु दृष्ट्वा न चिरादिवात्मवान् यतोऽभिसंधाय निहन्ति शात्रवान्॥
answer: By properly looking to the requirements of war and peace, a careful king, succeeds in killing even such foes as are highly rich, adored for intelligence and good conduct, endued with accomplishments, brave in battle, and ready for work.

question: कथं नु दृष्ट्वा पाञ्चालीं तथा कृष्ण सभागताम्। अवधेन प्रशाम्येत मम मन्युः सुयोधनेः॥
answer: Having seen the princess of Panchala come in the assembly, O Krishna, annoyed in that fashion, how can my wrath towards Suyodhana be appeased without killing him?

question: क्षणेन स रथस्तस्य सहयः सहसारथिः। शरवर्षेण महता संछन्नो न प्रकाशते॥
answer: In a moment (Arjuna's) car with its standard and charioteer became invisible having been covered with that shower of arrows.

question: विशिखोन्मथितैर्गात्रैर्बाहुभिश्च सकार्मुकैः। सहस्ताभरणैश्चान्यैः प्रच्छन्ना भादि मेदिनी॥
answer: The earth was covered with human bodies mangled by shafts, arms with bows and hands with ornaments.

question: द्रौपदी चाब्रवीद् भीममभिप्रेक्ष्य युधिष्ठिरम्। दासोऽयं मुच्यतां राज्ञस्त्वया पञ्चसटः कृतः॥
answer: Beholding Yudhishthira Draupadi also said to Bhima, "Release him who is the slave of the king and whom you have disfigured by leaving five tufts on his head."

question: तां नदीमाकुलावा सर्वत्रानुसरन्नृपः। आगतः सप्रजो रामस्तं देशं रघुनन्दनः॥
answer: And having crossing that river of rising waves to some extent, Răma, with his followers arrived at the place where he should give up his person.

question: सा ददर्श नगान् नैकान् नैकाश्च सरितस्तथा। नैकांश्च पर्वतान् रम्यान् नैकांश्च मृगपक्षिणः॥
answer: She beheld many trees and many streams, many charming mountains and various kinds of birds and beasts.

question: पार्श्वस्तु दारितैरन्ये वारणैर्वरवारणाः। धातूनिव महीधराः॥
answer: Other huge elephants having their sides opened by their hostile compeers, copiously shed blood like mountains discharging liquefied red chalk.

question: तधुवां हृष्टमनसौ श्वः प्रभाते समाहितौ। गायतं मधुरं गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम्॥
answer: Do you therefore both, delightedly and with a collected mind, early in the morning, sing the theme in a sweet voice and accompanied by the music of the stringed instrument.

question: आषाढमेकभक्तेन स्थित्वा मासमतन्द्रितः। बहुधान्यो बहुधनो बहुपुत्रश्च जायते॥
answer: He who passes the month of Ashada, taking himself one meal a day and with senses steadily concentrated upon his duties, becomes possessed of much corn, great riches and large progeny.

question: ध्वजे पताकादण्डेषु रथे यन्त्रे हयेषु च। अन्येषु च रथाङ्गेषु न शरीरे न सारथौ॥
answer: These arrows he shot at his flag and flagstaff and car and poles and yoke and the horses sparing the body of his-enemy and his cardriver.

question: यस्य नार्षं प्रमाणं स्याच्छिष्टाचारच भाविनि। न वै तस्य परो लोको नायमस्तीति निश्चयः॥
answer: For him, O fair lady, who disregards the words of the Rishis and does not care for the evidence of the pious, neither this world nor the next exists.

question: ऋतुपर्णं स राजानमुपतस्थे सुदुःखितः। भृति चोपययौ तस्य सारथ्येन महीपते॥
answer: He approached king Rituparna with a sorrowful heart and entered into the service of the monarch as a charioteer.

question: चरमाणस्तु सोऽरण्ये तृणवीरुत्समावृते। कृष्णाजिनोत्तरासङ्गं ददर्श मुनिमन्तिके॥
answer: While he was wandering in the forest covered with grass and creepers he saw near (him) a Muni wrapped up in an antelope's skin which served as an upper garment.

question: स्यूमरश्मिरुवाच योषा परमा काष्ठा योषा परमा गतिः। गृहस्थानव्यपाश्रित्य नाश्रमोऽन्यः प्रवर्तते॥
answer: If, indeed, that be the highest object of acquisition, if that be truly the highest end then the importance of the domestic mode of life becomes clear, because without the domestic mode no other mode of life ever becomes possible.

question: अत्र पूर्वं वसिष्ठस्य पौराणस्य द्विजर्षभ। सूतिश्चैव प्रतिष्ठा च निधनं च प्रकाशते॥
answer: Here, in days of old, O best among the twice born, took place the birth, attainment to fame and death of the ancient Rishi Vasishtha.

question: निरिन्द्रियस्याबीजस्य निर्द्रव्यस्याप्यदेहिनः। कथं गुणा भविष्यन्ति निर्गुणत्वान्महात्मनः॥
answer: When the Supreme Being is without senses, without seed, without matter, without body, He must be divested of all qualities; and on account of His being so, how, indeed, can He have qualities of any kind?

question: अल्पान्तरमिदं शश्वत् पुराणा मेनिरे जनाः। यो यजेताश्वमेधेन दद्याद् वा साधवे महीम्॥
answer: The ancients thought that there is always very little difference between the man who celebrates a Horse-Sacrifice and him who makes a gift of earth to one who is righteous.

question: उपपन्नं महाशस्त्रैः सर्वोपकरणान्वितम्। तत्कुलीनेन वीरेण हयशास्त्रविदाणे॥
answer: It was also furnished with great weapons and all other necessary things and guided by a charioteer of good birth well versed in the art of the management of horses,

question: भीष्म उवाच प्रजानां क्रोशतीनां वै नैवाक्षुभ्यत मे मनः। प्रतिज्ञां रक्षमाणस्य सद् वृत्तं स्मरतस्तथा॥ ततः पौरा महाराज माताकाली च मे शुभा।
answer: Bhishma said My heart remained unmoved at that grief of the subjects remembering that the observance of a vow is the duty of a good man. Then did my citizens, O great king, and my mother, the blessed Kali,

question: कर्ता सर्वस्य लोकस्य श्रेष्ठो ज्ञानविदां विभुः। उपेक्षसे कथं सीतां पतन्ती हव्यवाहने।। कथं देवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानं नावबुद्ध्यसे॥
answer: O lord, you are the preserver of all the worlds and the foremost of the wise, why did you neglect Sītā entering into fire? Why did you not understand yourself the foremost of the celestials?

question: उताहोस्विद् भवेद् राजा नल: परपुरंजयः। सोऽयं नृपतिरायात इत्येवं समचिन्तयत्॥
answer: He continued to think, “That he might be king Nala, the reducer of hostile cities, who has come here.

question: तदङ्गपतिना गुप्तं कृपेण च मनस्विना। शारदाम्बुधरप्रख्यं प्राच्यानां सुमहद् बलम्॥
answer: The large force of the people of the east which looked like the fleecy clouds of autumn was protected by the Anga prince and the greatly powerful Kripa.

question: यत् त्वद्य मे व्यवसितं तच्छृणुध्वं नरर्षभाः॥ इह प्रायमुपासिष्ये यूयं व्रजत वै गृहान्।
answer: O foremost of men, listen to me now as to what I intend to do. I shall stay here fasting, all of you go back home.

question: निहते सैन्धवे वीरे भूरिश्रवसि चैव ह। : यदाभ्यगान्महातेजाः पञ्चालानपराजित॥
answer: (You say that) on the slaughter of the heroic king of Sindhu as well as of Bhurisrava that unvanquished one (i.e., Drona) endued with great energy rushed against the Srinjayas.

question: निदेशाद् धर्मराजस्य द्रौपद्याः पदवीं चरन्। निर्धार्तराष्ट्रां पृथिवीं कर्तास्मि नचिरादिव॥
answer: At the command of the king (Yudhisthira) and remembering the wrongs done to (Draupadi), I shall soon make the earth freed from the sons of Dhritarashtra.

question: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम तयो?रं पराक्रमम्। अयुध्येतां स्थिरौ भूत्वा महत्या सेनया सह॥
answer: We saw wonderful prowess in those two princes for they fought with great coolness, though they had to fight with a very large number of troops.

question: सतीं त्वामहमत्यन्तं व्यवस्याम्यसती सतीम्। रूपिणीं विषसंयुक्ता पीत्वेव मदिरां नरः।७६ ।।
answer: Like to a goodly liquor, which people having partaken it, subsequently find to contain poison. I have found you, who had passed for a chaste woman, to be now really unchaste.

question: अथ कूले स्वके राजन् जपन्तमृषिसत्तमम्। जुह्वानं कौशिकं प्रेक्ष्य सरस्वत्यभ्यचिन्तयत्॥ इदमन्तरमित्येवं ततः सा सरितां वरा। कूलापहारमकरोत् स्वेन वेगेन सा सरित्॥
answer: Seeing then that best of Rishis, viz., Vashishtha engaged in silent recitation of Mantras on her bank and seeing Kushika's son Vishvamitra also engaged in homa, Sarasvati thought, this is my opportunity.' Then that foremost of rivers, by her current, washed away one of her banks.

question: ततः शतसहस्रांशुर्मथ्यमानात्तु सागरात्। प्रसन्नात्या समुत्पन्नः सोमः शीतांशुरुज्ज्वलः॥
answer: Then from churning the ocean rose the amiable and brilliant Moon of thousand rays.

question: हन्यते प्रेक्षमाणानां हतास्तत्र सभासदः। विद्धो धर्मो ह्यधर्मेण सभां यत्र प्रपद्यते॥ न चास्य शल्यं कृन्तन्ति विद्धास्तत्र सभासदः। धर्म एतानारुजति यथा नद्यनुकूलजान्॥
answer: If this happens with the knowledge of the members thereof, they are themselves slain; when virtue, pierced by vice, makes an appeal to an assembly and the shaft (of vice) is not taken out, the members thereof are themselves pierced by it. In fact virtue kills them like a river destroying the trees growing upon its banks.

question: हरिक्षरजोनाम्नः पुत्रस्तस्य महात्मनः॥ अध्यास्ते तु महावीर्यः सुग्रीव इति विश्रुतः।
answer: There dwell the famous lord of monkeys, Sugrīva, the heroic son of the great Rkşarajā.

question: गतिर्वेगश्च तेजश्च लाघवं च महाकपे। पितुस्ते सदृशं वीर मारुतस्य महौजसः॥ तेजसा वापि ते भूतं न समं भुवि विद्यते। तद् यथा लभ्यते सीता तत्त्वमेवानुचिन्तय॥
answer: And your motion, vehemence, energy and fleetness, are, O hero, O mighty ape, even like those of your sire, the powerful wind god; and there exists no creature on earth that is like to you in energy. Therefore do you bethink you how Sītā may be recovered.

question: ततः समाने प्रतितिष्ठतीह इत्येव पूर्वं प्रजजल्प वाणी। तस्मान्मनः स्थावरत्वाद् विशिष्टं तथा देवी जङ्गमत्वाद् विशिष्टा॥
answer: After that, she lives in Samana. Even thus did Word formerly speak. Hence Mind, on account of being immovable, is distinguished, and the goddess Word, on account of being movable, is also distinguished.

question: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्त्वा समयं तत्र चक्राते तावुभो नृप। अन्योऽन्यस्याभिसंदेहे तौ संक्रामयतां ततः॥
answer: Bhishma said Having spoken thus, they two made an agreement O king, and they transferred to each other their (respective) sexes.

question: मथास्य कायो निपपात पश्चात्। तदुद्यतादित्यसमानतेजसं शरन्नभोमध्यगभास्करोपमम्॥ वराङ्गमुक्मपतञ्चमूमुखे दिवाकरोऽस्तादिवरक्तमण्डलः।
answer: Thus sundered with Anjalika arrow Karna's trunk dropped down on earth. The head also of the commander of the Kuru army, effulgent like the risen, sun and the meridian sun of the autumn, dropped down on earth like the crimson sun falling down from the setting hill.

question: तयोरण्डानि निदधुः प्रहृष्टाः परिचारिकाः। सोपस्वेदेषु भाण्डेषु पञ्चवर्षशतानि च॥
answer: Their maid servants kept them separately in warm vessels and thus five hundred years passed away.

question: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य गम्भीरार्थपदं महत्। तयं ब्रूहीति सौमित्रिः सूतं तं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।२०
answer: Hearing these grave and important words of Sumantra, Laksmana ordered him to relate.

question: उभे चैते मते ज्ञाते नृपते शिष्टसम्मते। अनुष्ठिते यथाशास्त्रं नेयतां परमां गतिम्॥ तुल्यं शौचं तपोयुक्तं दया भूतेषु चानघ। व्रतानां धारणं तुल्यं दर्शनं न समं तयोः॥
answer: agree with noth those systems of science, O king, so do the good and wise. If practised duly according to the instructions laid down, both would, O king, make a person acquire the highest end. In both systems purity is equally recommended as also mercy towards all creatures, O sinless one. In both, again, the observance of vows has been equally sanctioned. Only the scriptures which point out their paths are different.

question: कच्चिन्न चानुदृश्यन्ते कपयः कामरूपिणः। अथैवमुक्ते वचने हनूमानिदमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Having been addressed with those words, Hanumăn replied, communicating to Bharata, having truth for his prowess, the truth.

question: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टलकेषु च॥ नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च। कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च॥ सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेषु च। ध्वजाः समुच्छ्रिताः साधु पताकाश्चाभवंस्तथा॥
answer: Standards with pennons were beautifully reared up in the abodes of the gods resembling a peak, enveloped with white clouds, and at the crossing, and on high ways; and over the Caitya tree; and edifices; and over the ware-houses of merchants abounding in goods and the goodly and prosperous mansions of householders, and over all the council-houses and conspicuous trees.

question: तथाहं धर्मनित्यस्य धर्मपत्नी दृढव्रता। त्वया स्प्रष्टुं न शक्याहं राक्षसाधम पापिना॥
answer: So I, the religiously wedded wife of that one, ever intent on virtue, and (always) firm in my vows, is incapable, you vilest of Raksasas, of being touched by you, a sinner.

question: पाञ्चजन्यस्य निर्घोषं विस्फूर्जितमिवाशनेः। निशम्य सर्वसैन्यानि समहृष्यन्त सर्वशः॥
answer: All the soldiers of the army became cheerful in every way at hearing the sound of the Panchajanya conch which was similar to the roaring of thunder.

question: एष ते प्रसवो राजन् जगतः सम्प्रकीर्तितः। निखिलेन महाप्राज्ञ किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
answer: Thus, O king, the origin of the universe has been described fully to you. What, O you of great wisdom, do you wish to hear after this.'

question: तत्र वेदविधिः स स्याज्ञानं चेत् पुरुषं प्रति। उपपत्त्युपलब्धिभ्यां वर्णयिष्यामि तच्छृणु॥
answer: About this if acts, are ordained for man for gaining knowledge, they should be considered as obligatory. I shall now describe them by the light of inferences and experience. Here me. some

question: आपवस्तु ततो रोषाच्छशापार्जुनमच्युत। दग्धेऽऽश्रमे महाबाहो कार्तवीर्येण वीर्यवान्॥ त्वया न वर्जितं यस्मान्नमेदं हि महद् वनम्। दग्धं तस्माद् रणे रामो बाहूंस्ते छेत्स्यतेऽर्जुन॥
answer: O mighty-armed king, seeing his hermitage consumed by the powerful Kshatriya, the highly energetic Apava cursed that monarch in anger, saying,-Since, O Arjuna, without reserving these my woods, you have burnt them, therefore, Rama (of Bhrigu's race), will cut your thousand arins.

question: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण श्रुतेन प्रज्ञयाऽपि च। सन्तो यां गतिमिच्छन्ति तां प्राप्तस्तव पुत्रकः॥
answer: Your son of tender years has attained to that end which the pious desire to have through the performance ascetic austerities and Brahmacharya and through knowledge of the Shastras and wisdom.

question: क्रोधमूलो विनाशो हि प्रजानामिह दृश्यते। तत् कथं मादृशः क्रोधमुत्सृजेल्लोकनाशनम्॥
answer: Anger is in this world, the root of the destruction of mankind; how can, one like me indulge in anger which brings about the destruction of the world?

question: न धारये कोपमुदीर्णवेगं निहन्मि सुग्रीवमसत्यमद्य। हरिप्रवीरैः सह वालिपुत्रो नरेन्द्रपुत्र्या विचयं करोतु॥
answer: I am unable to bear the outburst of my ire forsooth shall I kill today, that liar Sugrīva. May the son of Vāli with other principal monkeys engage in quest of that daughter of a king.

question: यस्य बाहुबले तुल्यो न भूतो न भविष्यति। अतीव समरं दृष्ट्वा हर्षो यस्योपजायते॥ योऽजयत् सङ्गत्तान् सर्वान् ससुरासुरमानवान्। तादृशेन सहायेन कस्मात् स न विजेष्यते॥
answer: None has been and none will be his equal in strength of arms. It is he only who takes delight on seeing a mighty encounter. Why should he not come off victorious, being aided by him who defeated all the celestials, the Asuras and the human beings, assembled together?

question: ततस्तु स्वनमासाद्य वायुः सम्भवमात्मनः। अधश्चोर्ध्वं च तिर्यक् च दोधवीति दिशो दश॥
answer: Obtaining its own attribute, viz., sound the Wind begins to move upwards and downwards and transversely along all the ten points.

question: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो वाष्पेण विहितेक्षणः। स विवेश स धर्मात्मा भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः। शोकसंविग्रहृदयो निशश्वास यथा द्विपः॥
answer: While saying this, the eyes of the virtuoussouled Rāma were covered with tears. Sighing hard like to an elephant, he, with a heart stricken with grief, departed to his own quarter in the company of his brothers.

question: माल्यवान् नाम वैदेहि गिरिणामुत्तमो गिरिः । ७९ ।। ततो गच्छति गोकर्ण पर्वतं केसरी हरिः। स च देवर्षिभिर्दिष्टः पिता मम महाकपिः।। तीर्थे नदीपतेः पुण्ये शम्बसादनमुद्धरन्॥ यस्याहं हरिणः क्षेत्रे जातो वातेन मैथिलि। हनूमानिति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा ॥
answer: There is a hill, O Vaidehi, named Malyavana, the foremost of all the mountains. There lives my father, the great monkey Kesari. Being commanded by the celestial ascetics, he once repaired thence to the mount Gokarna and at the holy watering place of the lord of the rivers he brought about the destruction of (the Asura) Sammasādana. O Vaidehi, I was bom, on the field, of that monkey. And I am known all over the world as Hanumān by my own actions.

question: तान् प्रदुतान् कुरून् दृष्ट्वा कर्णः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। संचिन्तयित्वा पार्थस्य वधे दने मनः श्वसन्॥
answer: Having seen that the Kauravas have all fled from the battle-field, Karna the best of warriors, drew a deep sigh and thinking a while determined to slay Partha,

question: अविधिश्च विधिश्चैव समुत्पन्नौ तथैकतः। विद्याविद्येति विख्याते श्रुतिशास्त्रार्थचिन्तकैः॥
answer: Allotment of attributes and the destruction thereof, called respectively by the names of Ignorance and Knowledge by persons learned in the Shrutis, then arose, referring to this, that, or the other of the three.

question: एवमुक्तस्तदा राजा महापार्श्वेन रावणः। तस्य संपूजयन्वाक्यमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Thus addressed by Mahāpārsva, king Rāvana, honouring his speech, said.

question: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम्। संदधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ॥ एकेनांशेन वत्स्यामि पूर्णोदासु नदीषु वै। चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्दर्पघ्नी कामचारिणी॥
answer: Hearing the words of the high-souled celestials she divided herself into four parts and wishing for a separate habitation said:-By one portion, I shall at my pleasure, live in rivers full of water during rains and shall obstruct people from going there.

question: तान्यस्माभिर्गृहीतानि निहितानि च राघव। आनयिष्याम्यहं तानि प्रत्यभिज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
answer: All these, O Rāghava, I have taken and kept (with me). I will bring them. It behoveth you to recognise them.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच नार्थोपभोगलिप्सार्थमियमर्थेप्सुता मम। भरणार्थं तु विप्राणां ब्रह्मन् काझे न लोभतः॥
answer: Yudhishthira said: O Brahmana, this my desire for wealth is not for the purpose of enjoying it when obtained. I do not desire it through avarice. I desire it only for the support of the Brahmanas.

question: नीलमग्निसुतं चैव हनूमन्तं च वानरम्। पितामहसुतं चैव जाम्बवन्तं महौजसम्॥ सुहोत्रं च शरारि च शरगुल्मं तथैव च। गजं गवाक्षं गवयं सुषेणं वृषभं तथा॥ मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव सुषेणं गन्धमादनम्। उल्कामुखमनङ्गं च हुताशनसुताबुभौ॥ अङ्गदप्रमुखान् वीरान् वीरः कपिगणेश्वरः। वेगविक्रमसम्पन्नान् संदिदेश विशेषवित्॥ तेषामग्रेसरं चैव बृहद्बलमथाङ्गदम्। विधाय हरिवीराणामादिशद् दक्षिणां दिशम्॥ ये केचन समुद्देशास्तस्यां दिशि सुदुर्गमाः। कपीशः कपिमुख्यानां स तेषां समुदाहरत्॥
answer: And appointing the exceedingly mighty Angada as the leader of those heroic monkeys, that hero, the lord of monkey bands, conversant with the countries intended to be explored, despatched heroes endowed with speed and prowess, headed by Angada, Nīla the son of Fire, and the monkey Hanumān; and the exceedingly energetic Jämbavān, son to the Great-father, and Suhotra, and Sarari, and Saragulma, Gaja, Gavaksya, and Gavaya, Sus ena, Vrsabha, Mainda, Dvivida, and Gandhamādana, and Ulkāmukha and Anangasons of Fire both. And the lord of monkeys began to describe to the monkey-chiefs those tracts in those directions, that were difficult of access.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं स तान् समाश्वस्य व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः। एकचक्रामभिगतः कुन्तीमाश्वासयत् प्रभुः॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : Having thus comforted them, the son of a Satyavati, Vyasa, led them to (the town of) Ekachakra. The lord (Vyasa) comforted Kunti also.

question: ततः पादाववच्छाद्य पटान्तेन ससमम्भ्रमः। पुत्रेति परिपूर्णार्थमब्रवीत् रथसारथिः॥
answer: The charioteer (Adhiratha) hurriedly covered his feet with the end of his sheet and addressed the successful Karna as his son.

question: अशोभन्त महाराज ग्रहास्तारागणैरिव॥ राजभ्योऽपि ततः प्रादाद् रत्नानि विविधानि च। गजानश्वानलं कारान् स्त्रियो वासांसि काञ्चनम्।।३२
answer: To those kings they made presents of various jewels and gems, and elephants and horses and ornaments of gold, and female slaves and cloths and immense quantity of gold.

question: क्षयं नीतोऽस्मि वार्ष्णेय राज्यहेतोः पराक्रमी। भ्रातरश्चैव मे वीराः कर्शिताः शरपीडिताः॥ मत्कृते भ्रातृहार्देन राज्याद् भ्रष्टास्तथा सुखात्। जीवितं बहु मन्येऽहं जीवितं ह्यद्य दुर्लभम्॥ जीवितस्य च शेषेण तपस्तप्स्यामि दुश्चरम्। न घातयिष्यामि रणे मित्राणीमानि केशव॥
answer: O Vrishni chief, using prowess for the sake of acquiring a kingdom, I am being (unconsciously) led to destruction. My heroic brothers are all wounded with arrows for my sake. They are deprived of both sovereignty and happiness only through the great love they bear for their eldest brother. We highly regard life, for, under the circumstances. Life is very precious. During the reminder of my days I will practice the severest asceticism. O Keshava, I shall not bring about the destruction of my friends.

question: तं निर्विषाशीविषसंनिकाशं शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम्। गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूटमुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥
answer: Rāma in the encounter addressed the lord of Rākşasas, resembling a serpent bereft of venom, shorn of his splendour, like to the sun shrouded (in mist), without his wonted grace, and having his entire tiara riven-saying.

question: हेमत्सरुरनाधृष्यो नैषध्यो भारसाधनः। कस्य पाचनखे कोशे सायको हेमविग्रहः॥
answer: Whose is this sword made of gold, manufactured in the country of Nishadas, capable of bearing heavy weight and cased in a sheath of goat skin?

question: प्रनष्टे तु शरीरेऽसौ राजर्षिः परया मुदा। तृप्तः प्रमुदितो राजा जगाम त्रिदिवं सुखम्॥
answer: And the body being dissolved, the royal saint Śveta, greatly delighted, happily went to the land of immortals.

question: ततो गुरुसुता तस्य पद्मपत्रनिभानना॥ जग्राहाश्रूणि सुश्रोणी करेण पृथुलोचना। पितुर्नियोगाद् धर्मज्ञा शिरसाऽवनता तदा॥ तस्या निपेततुर्दग्धौ करौ तैरश्रुबिन्दुभिः।
answer: Knowing every duty, the daughter of his preceptor then who had cyes resembling lotus petals, and hips that were full and round, at the command her father, sought, with downcast face, to hold Utanka's tears in her hands. Her hands scemed to burn with those tear-drops that she held. Unable, accordingly, to hold them longer, she was compelled to throw them down on the earth.

question: महोदरस्य तल्लग्नं जंघाया वै यदृच्छया॥ वने विचरतो राजन्नस्थि भित्वाऽस्फुरत् तदा। स तेन लग्नेन तदा द्विजातिर्न शशाक ह॥
answer: That head, coursing at will through the sky, fell upon the thigh of Mahodara while the latter was walking in the woods. Piercing his thigh, O king, it stuck to it and remained there.

question: राजोवाच केनेदृशी जातु परा हि दृष्टा वागुच्यमाना शकुनेन संस्कृता। यां वै कपोतो वदते यां च श्येन उभौ विदित्वा कथमस्तु साधु॥
answer: The King said : Has any one seen before that birds speak the pure speech of man? knowing what the pigeon says and also what the hawk says, what is good for us to do?

question: बहून्यव्यक्तवर्णानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च। विसृजन्तौ महावृक्षौ तद् वनं व्याप्य तिष्ठतः॥
answer: The two trces which stand filling that forest, produce many flowers and fruits which are of unmanifest colours.

question: एवं ममापि पुत्रस्य पुत्रः पितरमन्वगात्। दुर्योधनं महाबाहो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा॥
answer: Thus. also, my grandson, that slayer of hostile heroes, viz., the mighty-armed Lakshmana, has followed his father Duryodhana.

question: स्थितो राज्ये च्युतान् राज्याच्छ्यिा हीनाञ्छ्यिा वृतः। असमृद्धान् समृद्धार्थः पश्य पाण्डुसुतान् नृप॥
answer: You a (great) sovereign and they deprived of their sovereignty, you in prosperity and they deprived of it, you are in affluence and they are in poverty. O king, go and (now) see the Pandavas.

question: तपस्वी उवाच आनीयतामिति मुनिस्तं चोवाच नराधिपम्। स राजा समुपाजह्वे तदन्नं सह भार्यया।॥
answer: The Ascetic said Let the food be brought. Assisted by his wife, the king soon brought there the food.

question: संजय उवाच भीमसेनं ततो द्रोणी राजन् विव्याध पत्रिणा। परया त्वरया युक्तो दर्शयन्नस्त्रलाघवम्॥
answer: Sanjaya said Thereupon, O king, the son of Drona, who was possessed of great alacrity and who showed easiness in the management of weapons, pierced Bhimasena with an arrow.

question: प्रसुप्तांस्तृषिताश्रान्तान् प्रकीर्णान् नाभिघातयेत्॥ मोक्षे प्रयाणे चलने पानभोजनकालयोः। अतिक्षिप्तान् व्यतिक्षिप्तान् निहतान् प्रतनूकृतान्॥ सुविश्रब्धान् कृतारम्भानुपन्यासान् प्रतापितान्। बहिश्चरानुपन्यासान् कृतवेश्मानुसारिणः॥ पारम्पर्यागते द्वारे ये केचिदनुवर्तिनः। परिचर्यावतो द्वारे ये च केचन वर्गिणः॥
answer: No one should kill the sleepy, or the thirsty, or the fatigued, or one whose armours have fallen away, or one who has set his heart on final liberation, or one who is flying away, or one who is walking along a road, or one engaged in drinking or eating, or one who is mad, or one who is insane, or one who has been wounded morally, or one who has been greatly weakened by his wounds, or one who is residing confidentally, or one who has begun any task without having been able to finish it, or one who is a master of some particular art, or one who is in grief, or one who goes out of the camp for procuring forage or fodder, or men who pitch camps or are camp-followers, or those who wait at the gates of the king or of his ministers, or his menials, or the head of such servants.

question: प्रतिपद्य कुरुक्षेत्रं भीष्ममासाद्य चानघ। सुखां न रजनी पृष्ट्वा गाङ्गेयं रथिनां वरम्॥
answer: Proceeding to the field of Kuru and approaching the sinless Bhishma, they enquired of that best of car-warriors if he had spent the night happily.

question: श्वशुरान् सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि। तान् समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान् बन्धूनवस्थितान्॥ कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्।
answer: Seeing in the two armies all friends and Kinsmen (present), the son of Kunti was ency said.

question: क्लिन्नवस्त्रस्य तु जले किंकरा राजनोदिताः। ददुर्वासांसि मेऽन्यानि तच्च दुःखं परं मम॥
answer: My robes having been wet, the servants gave me other clothes at the command of the king (Yudhishthira). That also is my great sorrow.

question: रथनीडानि देहांश्च हतानां गजवाजिनाम्। आश्रित्य श्रममोहार्ताः स्थिताः पश्य महाभुज॥
answer: See, O you of great might, those dames, exhausted with fatigue, are taking rest, supporting themselves against broken boxes of cars and the bodies of slain elephants and steeds.

question: द्रोणपुत्रेण शल्येन कृपेण च महात्मना। समसज्जत पाञ्चाल्यस्तरिभिरेतैर्महारथैः॥
answer: The Panchala prince fought with Drona's son (Ashvathama), Shalya, and the illustrious Kripa.

question: धृतराष्ट्रस्तु तान् सर्वान् पश्यन् दिव्येन् चक्षुषा। मुमुदे भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रसादात् तस्य वै मुनेः॥
answer: Dhritarashtra seeing all those heroes with their celestial vision obtained through the favour of that sage, became full of joy, O chief of Bharata's race.

question: लक्ष्मणस्तु तदोवाच रक्ष्यमाणास्त्वयानघ। नात्र भीता वयं सर्वे धर्ममेवानुपश्यता॥ कथं दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया। शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धं जीवितं वा सुखानि वा॥
answer: Thereupon Laksmana said, O sinless one, protected by you ever having your sight fixed on virtue, we do not fear to live in this place. But how with Dasaratha's son lying down on the ground along with Sītă can I indulge in sleep or what is the use of my living and enjoying happiness?

question: मदव्यायामखिन्नास्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य योषितः। तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु प्रसुप्तास्तनुमध्यमाः॥
answer: The slender-waisted wives of the sovereign of the Rākşasas, overcome with languor consequent on drink and amorous encounter, were fast asleep at the very places where they were seated.

question: दधीचिरुवाच सर्वेषामेव मन्त्रोऽयं येनासौ न निमन्त्रितः। यथाहं शंकरादूर्ध्वं नान्यं पश्यामि दैवतम्। तथा दक्षस्य विपुलो यज्ञोऽयं न भविष्यति॥
answer: Dadhichi said This seems to be the advice of all that are here, namely, that Maheshvara should not be invited. As, however, I do not see any god that can be said to be superior to him, I am sure that this proposed Sacrifice of Daksha will surely be destroyed. a

question: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः। आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्विनाशेन दुःखिताम्॥
answer: Carrying your pious and iniquitous deeds you have attained to your own state-I am only lamenting for me who have been sorry for your destruction.

question: हनूमानुवाच नास्ति शक्तिर्ममोत्थातुं व्याधिना क्लेशितो ह्यहम्। यद्यवश्यं प्रयातव्यं लवयित्वा प्रयाहि माम्॥
answer: Hanuman said : I am suffering from illness, therefore I have no strength to rise. If you are resolved to go, then go overleaping me.

question: ततः प्रहृष्टः सुग्रीवः श्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा॥ प्रत्युवाच तदा रामं हर्षव्याकुललोचनः।
answer: Next Sugriva, feeling high rapture, with his eyes expanded with joy, answered Rāma blandly in sweet words.

question: गदाखड्गधनुष्पाणिः समभित्यक्तजीवितः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः॥
answer: There stood Bhimasena of mighty-arms devoid of all thoughts of life, firm as a rock, with club, sword and bow in his hand.

question: हतप्रवीरं विमुखं भयात पराङ्मुखं प्रायशोऽधृष्टयोधम्। शस्त्रार्चिषा भीमसेनेन दग्धं तदा युद्धं धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
answer: With their heroic leaders killed and his soldiers struck with fear flying with their backs towards the field and their vast army dispersed, consumed as it were by the fire of the arms of Bhimasena, then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

question: न हि केवलमस्माकमयमर्च्यतमोऽच्युतः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानामर्चनीयो महाभुजः॥
answer: This mighty-armed hero of unfading glory deserve to be worshipped not only by us alone, but by all the three worlds.

question: ततः सलिलमादाय विद्यया परिजप्य च। सुग्रीवनेत्रे धर्मात्मा प्रममार्ज विभीषणः॥
answer: And taking water, the righteous Vibhīşaņa by means of his knowledge, washed Sugrīva's eyed there with.

question: ये च शक्त्यवराः पुत्रा वसिष्ठस्य महामुने। ते च सर्वे मुदा युक्ता मोदन्ते सहिताः सुरैः॥
answer: Shakti and other sons of the great Rishi Vasishtha are all even now in great happiness enjoying themselves with the celestials.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्रह्मादित्यमुन्नयति देवास्तस्याभितश्चराः। धर्मश्चास्तं नयति च सत्ये च प्रतितिष्ठति॥
answer: Yudhishthira said: It is Brahma that makes the sun rise. The celestials remain near him. Dharma makes him set. And he is established in truth.

question: अद्यप्रभृति भद्रं वः प्रतिज्ञां मे निबोधत। त्रयोदश समास्तात को ममार्थोऽस्ति जीवतः॥
answer: "O children, O blessed ones, listen to the vow I make from this day. For what other purpose am I to live for thirteen years?

question: अवमानाः सुकष्टाश्च राजतः स्वजनात् तथा। शारीरा मानसा वापि वेदना भृशदारुणाः॥
answer: I have received from king and relatives insults and excessive misery. I have suffered from serve mental and physical pain.

question: पृच्छयमानो विशङ्केत सहसा बुद्धिमान्वचः। तत्र मित्रं प्रदुष्येत मिथ्या पृष्टं सुखागतम्॥
answer: An intelligent man, when questioned by any suddenly, suspects many things. And if the newcomer be a friend and has come here for his own happiness, how greatly shall his mind be changed by such a course?

question: भृगुपन्यो गिरिं दुर्गं हिमवन्तं प्रपेदिरे। तासामन्यतमा गर्भ भयाद् दधे महौजसम्॥
answer: One among them, a lady of tapering things, desiring to perpetuate her husband's race, kept a greatly energetic embryo hidden in one of her things.

question: ततः प्रीतमना राजा प्राप्य यज्ञमनुत्तमम्॥ पापापहं स्वर्नयनं दुस्तरं पार्थिवर्षभैः। ततोऽब्रवीदृष्यशृङ्ग राजा दशरथस्तदा॥ कुलस्य वर्धनं तत् तु कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत।
answer: Then having celebrated that excellent and sindestroying sacrifice, bringing heaven, and incapable of being celebrated by foremost monarchs, king Dasaratha, well pleased, spoke to Rsyasriga, saying, Oyou of excellent vows, it behove you to do that whereby my line may increase.

question: भर्तृपिण्डविमोक्षार्थं भर्तृकार्यविनिश्चिताः॥ स्वर्गसंसक्तमनसो योधा युयुधिरे तदा।
answer: For paying off the debt they owed to their masters on account of the maintenance received or bent upon achieving the objects of their friends and allies, the warriors, desirous of going to heaven, fought with one another.

question: एवं संचिन्त्य यो याति तिथिनक्षत्रपूजितः। विजयं लभते नित्यं सेना सम्यक् प्रयोजयन्।
answer: That king, who, having attended to all these points, marches, under a proper constellation and an auspicious luminary, always succeeds in acquiring victory by properly leading his troops.

question: वाक्सम्भाषाप्रवृत्तं यत् तन्मनःपरिवर्जितम्। बुद्ध्या चाध्यवसीयीत ब्रह्मचर्यमकल्मषम्॥
answer: It is a state of existence only on the mind. It has no connection with the senses. That pure state should be attained to by the understanding alone.

question: तं पर्वतं महाकुक्षिमुद्दिश्य स महाखगः! जवेनाभ्यपतत्तार्क्ष्य: सशाखागजकच्छपः॥
answer: The great bird, carrying the bough, the elephant and the tortoise, proceeded in great speed towards that mountain of broad waist.

question: अवमानस्तथा मोहः प्रमादः स्वप्नतन्द्रिता। कथंचिदभिवर्तन्ते विविधास्तामसा गुणाः॥
answer: Disgrace, delusion, error, slcep and stupefaction, that befall one through excess of ill-luck, are various properties of the state of Jgnorance.

question: एवं द्वादश वर्षाणि तापयामास रोदसी। निवर्त्यमानापि च सा ज्ञातिभि:व शक्यते॥
answer: And thus she continued for twelve years (her austerities) and made the heaven not. Nor could she be made to desist from the course by her relatives.

question: सारथे पश्य विध्वस्ता अयोध्या न प्रकाशते॥ निराकारा निरानन्दा दीना पतिहतस्वना ॥
answer: O charioteer, behold that Ayodhyā, which shorn of its splendour and decorations, and plunged in grief, forlorn and silent, does not appear delightful.

question: विष्णोः सहायानृक्षीषु वानरीषु च सर्वशः। जनयध्वं सुतान् वीरान् कामरूपबलान्वितान्॥
answer: You all beget on monkeys and bears heroic and powerful sons capable of assuring forms at will to help Vishnu."

question: हन्यादेकरथेनैव देवगन्धर्वमानुषान्। एकीभूतानपि रणे दिव्यैरस्त्रैः प्रजापवान्॥
answer: With the assistance of a single car he can slay the gods, the Gandharvas and the human beings united together, with the aid of his heavenly weapons.

question: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच रामं संनिहितं दृष्ट्वा गदायुद्ध उपस्थिते। मम पुत्रः कथं भीम प्रत्ययुध्यत संजय॥
answer: Dhritarashtra said Beholding Rama approach that spot, when the mace-fight was about to take place, how, O Sanjaya, did my son fight with Bhima?'

question: आनृशंस्यमथो वृत्तं रक्षन् सत्पुरुषोचितम्। अतोऽर्थकरमप्येतन्न करोम्यद्य ते वचः॥
answer: At the same time however showing due kindness and observing proper duties which ought to be observed by good men, I shall not act up to your words now as they are beneficial.

question: अथार्जुनं रथवरं त्वदीयाः समभिद्रवन्। नानाजनपदाध्यक्षा: सगणा जातमन्यवः॥
answer: Thereupon several kings of many countries, who were accompanied by their attendants and who, again, were highly enraged, belonging to your army, proceeded most rapidly against Arjuna, that foremost of car-warriors.

question: ईश्वरेण प्रयत्नेन कारणात् क्षत्रियस्य च। दण्डो दत्तः समानात्मा दण्डो हीदं सनातनम्॥
answer: God himself has, with great care, sent Punishment for the use of the Kshatriya. This eternal universe is impartial Punishment's self.

question: उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञः सीताया दर्शनं यथा। तं मणिं काञ्चनं दिव्यं दीप्यमानं स्वेतजसा ॥ दत्त्वा रामाय हनुमांस्ततः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्। समुद्रं लवयित्वाहं शतयोजनमायतम्॥ अगच्छं जानकी सीतां मार्गमाणो दिक्षया। तत्र लङ्केति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥ दक्षिणस्य समुस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे।
answer: Conferring on (Rāma) the heavenly jewel set on a golden leaf and burning with its own effulgence, Hanumān, with folded hands, began-Anxious to behold Sītā, the daughter of the king Janaka, I ploughing over the main extending over a hundred Yojana, wended my way and by and by reached Lankā, the capital of the vicious-souled Rāvaņa. Lankā is situated on the southern bank of the southern ocean,

question: आकाशात् तु विकुर्वाणात् सर्वगन्धवहः शुचिः। बलवाञ्जायते वायुस्तस्य स्पर्शो गुणो मतः॥
answer: From Ether, by modification, originates the bearer of all scents, viz., the pure, and powerful Wind. It is said to possess the property of Touch.

question: स मासः पञ्चरात्रेण पूर्णो भवितुमर्हति। ततः श्रोष्यसि रामेण सहितः सुमहत् प्रियम्॥
answer: That month will be complete in another five nights. And then you will, together with Rama, hear that great and joyful news about the discovery of Sita)."

question: यां तां वने दुःखशय्यामवात्सीत् प्रव्राजितः पाण्डवो धर्मचारी। आप्नोतु तां दुःखतरामनर्थामन्त्यां शय्यां धार्तराष्ट्रः परासुः॥
answer: The bed of woe which the son of Pandu attached to virtuous habits lay, exiled in woods-let the son of Dhritarashtra when dead in the field obtain a bed of greater endless woe.

question: श्वस्तु गन्तासि तं देशं वसाद्य सह मन्त्रिभिः। एतं मे कुरु सुप्राज्ञ कामं कामार्थकोविद॥
answer: On the morrow you will set out for that region. Do you to-day sojourn here along with your counsellors. O wise one, do this at your pleasure, O you understanding interest and desire.

question: उद्यन्तं वा गदा गुर्वीः शरान् वा क्षेप्तुमाहवे। जवे लक्ष्यस्य हरणे भोज्ये पांसुविकर्षणे॥
answer: In uplifting maces, in shooting arrows, in hitting the target, in eating and in sporting in the dust,

question: वीरासनं वीरशय्यां वीरस्थानमुपागतः। अक्षयास्तस्य वै लोकाः सर्वकामगमास्तथा।॥
answer: He who on the battlefield, lays himself down as a warrior on a warrior's bed, goes to those eternal regions where all the objects of desire are fulfilled.

question: मयापि सहधर्मज्ञ तीर्थान्येतान्यनुक्रमात्। प्राप्स्यसे महतीं कीर्तिं यथा राजा महाभिषः।।१२४
answer: You can go with me O virtuous man, to visit some of the Tirthas. You will by this obtain great fame as did king Mahavisha,

question: विदित्वा परमास्त्राणि क्षत्रधर्मव्रते स्थितः॥ षष्टिं वर्षाणि धर्मात्मा वसुधां पालयिष्यति।
answer: Having acquired all knowledge of all high weapons and observing all Kshatriya duties, that righteous king shall rule the earth for sixty years.

question: तत्फलं प्राप्स्यते चापि भृगुशापकृतं महत्। अयोध्यायाः पती रामो दीर्घकालं भविष्यति ॥
answer: O conferer of honours, for sooth shall Rāma partake of the fruits of Bhrgu's curse. He shall reign in Ayodhyā for a long time.

question: ततो देवगिरौ तस्मिन् रम्ये पुण्ये सनातने। न शर्वं भूतसंधं वा ददृशुर्मुनयस्तदा॥
answer: Then on that charming, sacred and eternal breast of that celestial, celestial, mountain, the assembled Rishis no longer saw the ghostly beings who associate with Mahadeva.

question: जाहस्यमाने सुप्रीते सुखं तत्र निषीदतुः। चिरस्य दृष्ट्वा राजेन्द्र तेऽन्योन्यस्य प्रियंवदे॥ कथयामासतुश्चित्राः कथा: कुरुयत्थिताः। अथाब्रवीत् सत्यभामा कृष्णस्य महिषी प्रिया।॥ सात्राजिती याज्ञसेनी रहसीदं सुमध्यमा। केन द्रौपदि वृत्तेन पाण्डवानधितिष्ठसि॥
answer: O king of kings, with hearts full of joy, they laughed merrily and they seated themselves at their ease. Those ladies who always spoke sweetly to each other, having met after a long time, began to talk upon various delightful topics arising out of the accounts of the Kurus and the Yadus. The slender waited Satyabhama, the favourite wife of Krishna and the daughter of Satrajit then asked (Draupadi) in private saying, "How, O Draupadi, can you rule the sons of Pandu.

question: ततोऽहं वचनात् तस्य गिरिमारुह्य शैशिरम्। तपोऽतप्यं महाराज मासं मूलफलाशनः॥
answer: Then, following his instructions I ascended the mountain Saisira (Himalayas) and began to practice asceticism, living on fruits and roots in the (first) month.

question: दुर्योधन उवाच स्वागतं ते महाबाहो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मानद। अहं च कुरुराज्यं च यथेष्टमुपभुज्यताम्॥
answer: Duryodhana said : "O mighty armed hero welcome to you! man deserving of politeness, I have got you by good fortune. Command me and the Kuru kingdom at your pleasure.

question: सर्वं तदपि जानामि करिष्यति च पाण्डवः। न ह्यस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु सदृशोऽन्ति धनुर्धरः॥
answer: Will all be done by the son of Pandu, I know. In the three worlds there is no wilder of the bow equal to him.

question: शान्तनुरुवाच आपवो नाम को न्वेष वसूनां किं च दुष्कृतम्। यस्याभिशापात् ते सर्वे मानुषीं योनिमागताः॥
answer: Shantanu said : Who was Apava and what fault was committed by the Vasus that they had to be born among men in consequence of his curse?

question: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ। पूर्ववृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम्॥
answer: O foremost of men, the worshipful Jānaki, related as a token, all the incidents at the Mount Citrakūta from the beginning to the end.

question: परस्परं चाधिकमाक्षिपन्ति भुजांश्च पीनानधिविक्षिपन्ति। मत्तप्रलापानधिविक्षिपन्ति मत्ता चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्ति ॥
answer: And (Raksasas) were parleying, moving about their plump arms, railing at each other; and throwing intemperate speeches at each other.

question: कच्चित् पुरुषकारेण पुरुषः कर्म शोभयन्। लभते मानमधिकं भूयो वा भक्तवेतनम्॥
answer: Docs a man who shows exceptional merit in an act get from you more regard, and also an increase of rations and pay?

question: शिरोभिः प्रपतद्भिश्च बाहुभिश्च विभूषितैः। अश्मवृष्टिरिवाभाति पाणिभिश्च सहाकुशैः॥
answer: In consequence of the thick falling of the heads (of elephants-riders), their arms decked with ornaments and their hands grasping the iron hook, a shower of stones appeared to fall.

question: यो यो यत्र द्विजो भोज्यं भोक्तुं कामयते तदा। तस्य तस्य तु तत्रैवमुपजह्वस्तदा नृप॥ तत्र तत्र स्थिता राजन् रौहिणेयस्य शासनात्। भक्ष्यपेयस्य कुर्वन्ति राशींस्तत्र समन्ततः॥
answer: Costly garments and bedsteads and coverlets were distributed amongst the Brahmanas desirous of ease and comfort. Whatever a Brahmana or Kshatriya wanted, it was given to him.

question: भीमं च बलिनां श्रेष्ठं सन्त्वयामास पार्थिवः॥ स चास्य सम्यङ् मेधावी प्रत्यपद्यत वीर्यवान्।
answer: The king comforted Bhima, that foremost of all persons gifted with great strength. Gifted with great energy and great intelligence, Bhima showed his sub-missiveness to the king.

question: भागिनेयकृते वीरः स करिष्यति संगरे। सुमहत् कर्म पाण्डूनां स्थितः प्रियहिते रतः॥
answer: For the sake of his nephew the hero will do great deeds in the battle for he is ever on the side of the Pandavas and devoted to their interests.

question: ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि पृथगेकैकमुद्दिशन्॥ धनै रत्नैश्च गोभिश्च वस्त्रैश्च समतर्पयत्।
answer: For each of these, the king pleased thousands of Brahmanas with presents of wealth, gems, kine and clothes.

question: अष्टमं पर्व निर्दिष्टमेतद्भारतचिन्तकैः। एकोनसप्ततिः प्रोक्ता अध्यायाः कर्णपर्वणि॥ चत्वार्येव सहस्राणि नव श्लोकशतानि च। चतुःषष्टिस्तथा श्लोकाः पर्वण्यस्मिन् प्रकीर्तिताः॥
answer: The leader of the Bharata calls this Parva the eighth Parva. The number of its chapters is sixty nine and that of the slokas is four thousand nine hundred and sixty four.

question: देवदानवगन्धर्वा दैत्यासुरमहोरगाः। यक्षराक्षसनागाश्च पिशाचा मनुजास्तथा॥ ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैष्याः शूद्राश्च द्विजसत्तम। ये चान्ये भूतसङ्घानां सङ्घांस्तांश्चापि निर्ममे॥
answer: After this, the gods and the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Daityas, the Asuras, the great snakes, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Serpents, the Pishachas, and mankind with their four divisions, viz., Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras, O foremost of twice-born ones, and all the other orders of creatures, were created.

question: सेनजिदुवाच का बुद्धिः किं तपो विप्र कः समाधिस्तपोधना किं ज्ञानं किं श्रुतं चैव यत् प्राप्य न विषीदसि॥
answer: Senajit said What is that intelligence, what that penance, O learned Brahmana, what that concentration of mind, O you having asceticism for wealth, what that knowledge, and what that learning, by gaining which you do not give way to grief?

question: पक्षौ तु भीमसेनश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः॥ द्रौपदेयाभिमन्युश्च सात्यकिश्च महारथः।
answer: Bhimasena, the descendant of Prishat Dhrishtadyumna, the sons of Draupadi, Abhimanyu, and that great car-warrior Satyaki became its two wings.

question: अङ्गिरा उवाच यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णं दद्याद् दीपं करञ्जके। सुवर्चलामूलहस्तः प्रजा तस्य विवर्धते॥
answer: Angirasa said The offspring of that man multiplies who stands every night for a full year under a Karanjaka tree with a lamp for lighting it and holds in his hands the roots of the Suvarchala plant.

question: अथाब्ररीद् द्रोणसुतस्तवात्मजं करं करेण प्रतिपीडय सान्त्वयन्॥ रलं विरोधेन धिगस्तु विग्रहम्। हतो गुरुर्ब्रह्यसमो महास्त्रवित् तथैव भीष्मप्रमुखा महारथाः॥
answer: Then Drona's son taking Duryodhana by the hands entreatingly said to him O Duryodhana, be pacified; you need not prolong this quarrel; make peace with Pandavas; war is detestable. The preceptor (Drona) who was like Brahma and was master of most powerful weapons he and other foremost of men with Bhishma have been killed in this war.

question: इदं तु सुमहत् कार्यं शृणु मे यत् समर्थितम्। परायणं पाण्डवानां नियच्छामि जनार्दनम्॥
answer: Listen to this great deed which I have fixed in my mind. I shall make Janardana-the refuge of the Pandavas, the captive.

question: जरासंधश्च बलवान् सर्वराजविरोधनः॥ भविष्यत्यसुरः स्फीतो भूमिपालो गिरिव्रजे। मम बुद्धिपरिस्पन्दाद् वधस्तस्य भविष्यति॥
answer: A proud Asura will appear as a king at Girivraja, of the name of Jarasandha, who will fall out with all the other kings of the world. His death will be brought about by me through some one else guided by my intelligence.

question: यो भर्ता वासितातुष्टो भर्तुस्तुष्टा च वासिता। यस्मिन्नेवं कुले सर्वे कल्याणं तत्र वर्तते॥
answer: That house in which the husband is pleased with his married wife, and the wife pleased with her husband, all auspicious results ensue.

question: सत्त्वस्य तु रजो दृष्टं रजसश्च तमस्तथा॥ तमसश्च तथा सत्त्वं सत्त्वस्याव्यक्तमेव च।
answer: Sometimes Rajas is seen mixed with Sattva Tamas also exists with Rajas. With Tamas may also be seen Sattva. Also Sattva and Rajas and Tamas may be seen existing together and in cqual parts. They then form the Nature.

question: स्वधर्मस्य परित्यागः परधर्मस्य च क्रिया। अयाज्ययाजनं चैव तथाभक्ष्यस्य भक्षणम्॥ शरणागतसंत्यागो भृत्यस्याभरणं तथा। रसानां विक्रयश्चापि तिर्यग्योनिवधस्तथा॥ आधानादीनि कर्माणि शक्तिमान करोति यः। अप्रयच्छंश्च सर्वाणि नित्यदेयानि भारत॥ दक्षिणानामदानं च ब्राह्मणस्वाभिमर्शनम्। सर्वाण्येतान्यकार्याणि प्राहुर्धर्मविदो जनाः॥
answer: The rejection of one's own religion, the following of other people's religion, assisting at the sacrifice or the religious rites of one who does not deserve such assistance, eating of forbidden food, deserting one who seeks refuge, neglect in maintaining servants and dependents, selling salt and treacle, killing of birds and animals, refusal, though able to beget children, upon a soliciting woman, negligence of making the daily offering, negligence to present the Dakshina, humiliating a Brahmana, these all are considered as forbidden acts by persons conversant with duty.

question: ततः प्रबोधिता भेर्यञ्चन्द्रपाण्डुरपुष्कराः। हेमकोणैरभिहता राक्षसानां समन्ततः॥
answer: Then awoke the kettle-drums, having moonlike pale faces-sounded by means of golden sticks.

question: ग्रामे गृहे वा ये द्रव्यं पारक्यं विजने स्थितम्। नाभिनन्दन्ति वै नित्यं ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
answer: Those who not others' belongings, even when they see it lying in a house or a village that has been deserted, ascend to Heaven.

question: आर्यपुत्राभिरामोऽसौ मृगो हरति मे मनः। आनयैनं महाबाहो क्रीडार्थं नो भविष्यति ॥
answer: O son of the worshipful Sire, this deer has attracted my mind, get it for me, pray, O you of mighty arms: it shall be an object of sport for us.

question: यदीमां भवतो बुद्धिं विद्याम वयमीदृशीम्। शस्त्रं नैव ग्रहीष्यामो न वधिष्याम कंचन॥
answer: If we knew that this was your intention, we would then have never taken up arms and killed a single creature.

question: दशमेऽहनि तस्मिंस्तु भीष्मार्जुनसमागमे। अवर्तत महारौद्रः सततं समितिक्षयः॥
answer: Then in that battle on the tenth day when Bhishma and Arjuna confronted one another, the carnage that was caused was indeed terrible to the extreme.

question: यः स्याद्दान्तः सोमपश्चार्यशीलः सानुक्रोशः सर्वसहो निराशीः। ऋजुर्मूदुरनृशंसः क्षमावान् स वै विप्रो नेतरः पापकर्मा॥
answer: He, who is self-controlled, has drunk the Soma in sacrifices, is of good conduct, has mercy for all creatures and patience to bear everything, has no desire of improving his position by acquisition of wealth, is frank and simple, mild, shorn of cruelty, and forgiving, is truly a Brahmana, and not he who is of sinful deeds.

question: तावुभौ ख्याकर्माणावुभौ वायुसमौ जवे। उभौ दिव्यास्त्रविदुषावुभावुत्तमतेजसौ।
answer: Both of them were equally illustrious and equal to the wind in speed, equally conversant with celestials weapons and gifted with great energy.

question: तथा पृष्टा यथान्यायमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे। मातास्य युगपद्वाक्यं विप्रियं प्रियशंसया॥
answer: Thus questioned, his mother at the same time duly said in words which although highly unwelcome, she took as agreeable to Bharata.

question: तां दृष्ट्वा चारुसर्वाङ्गी रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं क्रोधाद्रक्षोधिपात्मजम्॥
answer: Beholding that beloved spouse of Räma, having a tender and beautiful person, he addressed angrily the son of the lord of Rākşasas with harsh words.

question: नातप्ततपसः पुंसो नामहायज्ञयाजिनः। नानृता नास्तिकाश्चैव तत्र गच्छन्ति मुद्गल॥
answer: O sage, atheists and untruthful persons, those that have not performed asceticism and those that have not performed great sacrifices, cannot go there.

question: क्षत्रियाच महावीर्या भगदत्तपुरोगमाः। दिव्यास्त्रविदुषः शूराः क्षपयिष्यन्ति ते रिपून्।॥
answer: Other greatly powerful Kshatriyas headed by Bhagadatta, all learned in the celestials weapons, will kill your enemies.

question: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामेन रामः प्रव्राजितो वनम्। यदि सत्यं ब्रवीम्येतत् तदसत्यं भविष्यति॥
answer: If I shall truthfully say I have sent Rāma to the woods for compassing Kaikeyi's pleasure, that will count for a falsehood.

question: इरावांस्तु रणे क्रुद्धो भ्रातरौ तौ महारथौ। ववर्ष शरवर्षेण सारथिं चाप्यपातयत्॥
answer: Thereupon, inflamed with wrath, Iravat poured an arrow downpour on the two brothers both mighty car-warriors; and he felled their charioteer.

question: पादच्छाया सुखं भर्तुस्तादृशस्य महात्मनः। स हि नाथो जनस्यास्य स गतिः स परायणम्॥
answer: Even the shadow of the feet of our master, so high-souled, would bring us happiness. He is the lord of all these, he is the refuge, he is the accomplishment of our religious duties.

question: प्राकारैश्च पुरद्वारैः प्रासादैश्च पृथग्विधैः। नगराणि न शोभन्ते हीनानि ब्राह्मणोत्तमैः॥
answer: Cities adorned with walls and gates and palaces lose their beauty if they are not inhabited by Brahmanas.

question: तत्रैषा परमा काष्ठा रौद्रकर्मक्षयोदया। यद् वयं कौरवान् हत्वा तानि राष्ट्राण्यवाप्नुमः॥
answer: It is the greatest of all vicious deeds for us to prosper after this destruction-that we should obtain the kingdoms after slaying the sons of Kuru.

question: दण्डकारण्यमेषोऽहं गच्छाम्येव हि सत्वरः। अविचार्य पितुर्वाक्यं समा वस्तुं चतुर्दश॥
answer: I shall, not even judging the propriety of my father's words, speedily repair to the forest of Dandaka for fourteen years.

question: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्ता तु क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना॥ अब्रवीत् परुषं वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यवादिनम्।
answer: Being thus addressed by him her eyes were reddened with ire, and she spake these harsh words to the truthful Lakşmaņa.

question: दक्षिणार्थं समानीता राजभिः कांस्यदोहनाः। आरण्या बहुसाहस्रा अपश्यंस्तत्र तत्र गाः॥
answer: As I saw many thousands of wild kine with as many vessels of white copper for milking them, brought there by the kings of the earth to be given away Dakshina (sacrificial presents) by Yudhishthira.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अनिवृत्तं परं यत्तदव्यक्तं ब्रह्मणि स्थितम्। तद्भूतो जापकः कस्मात् स शरीरमिहाविशेत्॥
answer: Yudhishthira said When the Reciter attains to the essence of that which exists in its own nature, which is Supreme, which is beyond description and comprehension, and which dwells in the syllable. OM forming the subject of both recitation and meditation, why is it that they have a gain to take birth in embodied forms?

question: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम्। यथा रक्षा कृता पूर्वं विपुलेन महात्मना॥
answer: About it I shall recite to you the old history of how in days of yore the great Vipula had succeeded in restraining women within the limits laid down for them.

question: हेमरूप्यप्रसृष्टानां वाससां शिल्पिनिर्मिताः॥ नानावर्णा रथे भान्ति श्वसनेन प्रकम्पिताः।
answer: Many flags of diverse colours and embroidered with gold, made by skillful artisans and shining on Arjuna's car shaken by the wind.

question: तस्मान्नित्यं दया कार्या चातुर्वर्ये विपश्चिता। धर्मात्मा सत्यवाक् चैव राजा रञ्जयति प्रजाः॥
answer: Therefore, a wise king should always show mercy towards the four orders of his subjects. The righteous and truthful king succeeds in pleasing his subjects.

question: कथं तदल्पकालेन क्षीणं येनास्मि पातितः। भगवन् वेत्थ लोकांश्च शाश्वतान् मम निर्मितान्। कथं नु मम तत् सर्वं विप्रनष्टं महाद्युते॥
answer: How could that all be spent up in a very short time in consequence of which I was hurled down; O you endued with divine prosperity, you know that the eternal regions were built for me and how and why were all these destroyed, O you of great effulgence?

question: न किंचिदुक्त्वा दुर्मेधास्तस्थौ किंचिदवाङ्मुखः तमशुश्रूषमाणं तु विलिखन्तं वसुंधराम्॥ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनं राजन् मैत्रेयं कोप आविशत्। स कोपवशमापनो मैत्रेयो मुनिसत्तमः॥
answer: That wicked wretch (Duryodhana) did not speak a word, but he hung down his head. O king, seeing Duryodhana thus offer an insult to him by silently scratching the earth (by his foot), Maitreya became angry. That best of Rishis, Maitreya, overwhelmed with anger.

question: जघन्यजस्तक्षकश्च श्रुतसेनेति यः सुतः। अवसद्यो महद्युम्नि प्रार्थयन्नाममुख्यताम्॥ करवाणि सदा चाहं नमस्तस्मै महात्मने।
answer: I also worship Takshaka's younger brother Shrutasena, who dwelt at the holy place called Mahadyumna with the intention of becoming one of the chiefs of the Nagas.”

question: स चेन्ममार संजय चतुर्भद्रतरस्त्वया। पुत्रात् पुण्यतरश्चैव मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः॥
answer: When even be, O Srinjaya, who was far superior to you in the four attributes and who was purer than your son, met with death, do not grieve for your son who is dead.

question: शतक्रतोर्वचः श्रुत्वा देवाः साग्निपुरोगमाः। पितृदेवानुपेत्याहुः सर्वे सह मरुद्गणैः॥
answer: Hearing Satakratu's (performer of an hundred sacrifices, one of the appellations of Indra). The manes of ancestors. words, the deities along with the Maruts led by Agni, presented themselves before the divine Pitrs. And then Agni addressed the latter, saying.

question: वृतं नैकात्मकं येन कृतं त्रैलोक्यमात्मना। तथैव बहुरूपत्वाद् विश्वरूप इति स्मृतः॥
answer: The three worlds of numberless ingredients have been created by Him without help from any source and have been overwhelmed by him. On account of His manifold forins, He is said to be of universal form.

question: इन्द्रजित्तु रथे स्थाप्य सीतां मायामयीं तदा। बलेन महतावृत्य तस्या वधमरोचयत्॥
answer: Placing an illusory figure of Sītā on the car, encircled by a huge army he began to make arrangements for her destruction.

question: स्वभावयुक्त्या युक्तस्तु स नित्यं सृजते गुणान्। उर्णनाभिर्यथा सूत्रं विज्ञेयास्तन्तुवद् गुणाः।४९।।
answer: One living in this way creates the qualities (i.e. transcends them), like a spider creating threads. The qualities should indeed, be considered as the threads of the spider.

question: क्षुरप्रेण च तीक्ष्णेन कौरव्यस्य महद् धनुः। सहदेवो रणे छित्त्वा तं च विव्याध पञ्चभिः॥
answer: Cutting off with a sharp razor-headed arrow the mighty bow of the Kuru-descendant, Sahadeva pierced him with five arrows.

question: अथोद्यम्य गदे घोरे सशृङ्गाविव पर्वतौ। तावाजघ्नतुरन्योन्यं मण्डलानि विचेरतुः॥ क्रियाविशेषकृतिनौ रणभूमितलेऽचलौ।
answer: Uplifting their terrible weapons, they again strucks each other like mountains striking each other with their summits at the time of an earthquake.

question: द्रौपदेयाश्च संरब्धाः शैशुपालिश्च वीर्यवान्। केकयाश्च महावीर्याः सृञ्जयाश्च सहस्रशः॥
answer: The wrathful sons of Draupadi, the valiant son of Shishupala, the highly powerful Kekayas and the Srinjayas by thousands,

question: ततो रक्षो महाबाहुं सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम्। विव्याध विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः सिंहनादं ननाद च।॥
answer: Then the mighty-armed Rakshasa, O you uf prowess incapable of being baffled, pierced Satyaki with sharp arrows and uttered aloud his war-cry.

question: स देशः क्व नु यत्रासौ वसते धर्मसंकटे। कथं वा स विमुच्येत नरस्तस्मान्महाभयात्॥
answer: Where is that region, so inimical to the practice of virtue, where that person lives, Oh, tell me how that man will be freed from all those great dangers?

question: कृतदारास्तु ते राम सुकेशतनयास्तदा॥ चिक्रीडुः सह भाभिरप्सरोभिरिवामराः।
answer: And having wedded, O Rama, Sukesa's sons began to sport with their wives, like celestials sporting with Apsarās.

question: किं नु नाद्य कृतं तात सर्वेषां नः परं प्रियम्। यन्नः कुन्तीसुता वीरा नगरं पुनरागताः॥
answer: What good is not done to us today when the heroic sons of Kunti returns to our city?

question: अस्त्राणां च धनुर्वेद ब्राह्मे वेदे च पारगम्। तं सत्य धृतिमायान्तमरुणा: समुदावहन्॥
answer: Crimson steeds bore the assaulting Satyadhriti, who was proficient in the sciences dealing with the use of weapons and the bow and also in the divine Vedas.

question: कोष्ठकीकृत्य चाप्येनं परिक्षिप्य च सर्वशः। शस्त्रैर्नानाविधैर्जघ्नुर्युद्धपारं तितीर्षवः॥
answer: Desirous of terminating the hostilities, the Pandavas, forming a wall, encircled Shakuni on all sides and began to strike him with various kinds of weapons.

question: तीर्थान्यगच्छन् विबुधास्तेनापुभूतिमुत्तमाम्। तथा त्वमपि राजेन्द्र स्नात्वा तीर्थेषु सानुजः॥ पुनर्वेत्स्यसि तां लक्ष्मीमेष पन्थाः सनातनः।
answer: And visited all the Tirthas, they obtained great good fortune. O king of kings, you will too therefore, bathing with your younger brothers in the Tirthas, obtain again great good fortune. This is the eternal road.

question: नास्त्यसाधारणो राजा नास्ति राज्यमराजकम्। राज्येऽसति कुतो धर्मो धर्मेऽसति कुतः परम्॥
answer: There is no one who possessed the kingly office without some one else possessing it in the world, and there is no kingdom without a king. If there be no kingdom, there can be no virtue and if there be no virtue, whence can Liberation arise.

question: अलम्बुषो राक्षसेन्द्रः क्रूरकर्मा महारथः। हनिष्यति परान् राजन् पूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन्॥
answer: Alambusha, that chief of the Rakshashas of hard deeds, is a Maharatha and O king he will slay the enemies remembering the old enmity.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धन्या धन्या इति जनाः सर्वेऽस्मान् प्रवदन्त्युत। न दुःखिततरः कश्चित् पुमानस्माभिरस्ति ह॥
answer: All men describe ourselves as highly fortunate. In sooth, however, there is no person more wretched than ourselves.

question: अथ तान् द्विरदान् सर्वान नानालिङ्गैः शरोत्तमैः। सपताकध्वजारोहान् गिरीन् वज्रेरिवाहनत्॥
answer: As the mountain is broken to pieces by thunder, so those elephants, with their riders and their standards were knocked down by various choice shafts (from Arjuna).

question: कथंवीर्यः समभवत् स राजा वदतां वर। कथं च जातरूपेण समयुज्यत स द्विज॥
answer: Yudhishthira said O best of speakers, how that king waxed so powerful? And how, O twice-born one, did he get so much gold?

question: कंचित् कालं स धर्मात्मा सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च। अन्वास्यमानो न्यवसत् स्वर्गलोके यथामरः॥
answer: And ministered to by Sītā and Lakşmaņa that righteous one lived there, like the immortals in heaven.

question: ततो बृहस्पति शक्रः प्राञ्जलिः समुपस्थितः। तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञः श्रेय इच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
answer: Shakra then, with joined hands, approached Brihaspati. Endued with great wisdom, the god of the celestials addressed to the great preceptor, saying,-I desire you to tell me the source of happiness.

question: विषाणं चास्य निष्कृष्य वालिपुत्रो महाबलः॥ देवान्तकमभिदुत्य ताडयामास संयुगे।
answer: Then pulling out his tusks, the highly powerful son of Vāli, darting against Devāntaka, dealt him a blow therewith in that encounter.

question: तेन मायामयाः सृष्टा हयास्तावन्त एव हि। स्वारूढा राक्षसैोरैः शूलपट्टिशधारिभिः॥
answer: He then created, as many illusive chargers, all mounted by fierce Rakshasas, bearing in their hands lances and battle axes.

question: प्रस्थाप्य सेनां कन्याश्च गणिकाश्च स्वलकृताः। मत्स्यराजो महाप्राज्ञः प्रहृष्ट इदमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Having ordered out soldiers, maidens and well-adorned harlots, the wise king delightedly said these words.

question: प्रावर्तयत संग्रामे शोणितोदां महानदीम्। मध्येन कुरुसैन्यानां पाण्डवानां च भारत॥
answer: Then, O Bharata, between the armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas, he crushed a mighty river of bloody current to flow.

question: प्रीतश्चास्मि महाबाहो शासनस्य प्रतिग्रहात्। त्वां चाहमभिषेक्ष्यामि प्रीतियुक्तो नराधिपम्॥
answer: I have been greatly pleased that you have satisfied my behests. I shall, now pleased, install you on the royal throne.

question: विस्त्रस्तयन्त्रकवचाः कांदिग्भूता रिचेतस्ः। अन्योन्यमवमृद्नन्तो वीक्षमाणा भयर्दिताः॥
answer: Deprived of their coats of mail and weapons, unconscious of the right direction and bewildered they crushed one another in their flight and cast fearful looks upon one another.

question: अग्निरुवाच अधीयानः पण्डितं मन्यमानो यो विद्यया हन्ति यशः परेषाम्। प्रभ्रश्यतेऽसौ चरते न सत्यं लोकास्तस्य ह्यन्तवन्तो भवन्ति॥
answer: Agni said The Brahmana who engaged in study and considering himself learned, seeks with the help of his learning to destroy the reputation of others falls away from virtue and comes to be regarded as divorced from truth. Such persons of refractory spirit never acquire regions of happiness hereafter.
