answer: And on oceans and mountains, in forests and tanks, the monkeys began to send away all the apes on behalf of Rāma.

question: कशाग्रदण्डाभिहता काल्यमाना ततस्ततः। क्रोधरक्तेक्षणा क्रोधं भूय एव समादद॥
answer: Afflicted with their stripes and being dragged hither and thither, her anger (doubly) ! increased and her eyes became red in wrath.

question: स्वसा तस्यानवद्याङ्गी द्रौपदी तनुमध्यमा। नीलोत्पलसमो गन्धो यस्याः क्रोशात् प्रवाति वै॥
answer: His sister is the slender wasted and faultless featured Draupadi, whose body emits the Perfume of lotus over full two miles around.

question: धनुर्धरात्र्यो धृतिमान् यशस्वी जितेन्द्रियो वृद्धसेवी नृवीरः। भ्राता च शिष्यश्च युधिष्ठिरस्य धनंजयो नाम पतिर्ममैषः॥
answer: That foremost of bow-men, intelligent, illustrious, self-controlled and reverencing the old and heroic among men, is the brother and disciple of Yudhishthira. He is my husband by name Dhananjaya.

question: स्वधर्मस्य च संयोगाज्जितस्तेन महात्मना। स्वर्गः परिगृहीतश्च प्राणानपरिरक्षता॥
answer: The abode of the celestials, which was conquered by this high-souled one by his former piety, has now been occupied by him after resigning his body.

question: राजन्नदृश्यतैकस्थो राजस्तस्य महामखे। जत्र जातिसहस्राणि पुरुषाणां ततस्ततः॥ गृहीत्वा भाजनान् जग्मुर्बहूनि भरतर्षभ। स्रग्विणश्चापि ते सर्वे सुमृष्टमाणकुण्डला:॥ पर्यवेषन द्विजातीस्ताशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
answer: Thousands of nations and races were there. A large number of men. O chief of Bharata's race, adorned with garlands and wearing bright ear-rings made of gold, taking numberless vessels in their hands, distributed the food to the twice-born classes by hundreds and thousands.

question: न कालस्यातिभारोऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः। यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपातितः॥
answer: There is nothing which is too hard for Time; and the Destroyer is incapable of being overcome; inasmuch as Rāma along with his brother Lakşmaņa has fallen in fight.

question: वेद कृष्णस्य माहात्म्यं वेदास्य दृढभक्तिताम्। अत्याज्ययस्य जानामि प्राणैस्तुल्यं धनंजयम्॥
answer: I know the noble-mindedness of Krishna and I know his firm devotion and I know that Dhananjaya is inseparable from him even as life itself.

question: एवं लोकानुरोधेन शास्त्रमेतन्महर्षिभिः। संक्षिप्तमायुर्विज्ञाय मानां ह्रासमेव च॥
answer: Considering the period of human existence and the general decrease (of every thing), great Rishis did thus, for the well-being of the world, abridge that science.

question: अभिव्यक्तः परेषां च कृत्स्नो भुवि पराजयः। अह्ना टेकेन भीष्मोऽयं प्रयुतं हन्ति भारत॥
answer: Our defeat and the success of enemies, too, are proclaimed in the world. In one day this Bhishma kills ten thousand (enemies), 0 Bharata.

question: मया च पापकर्मासौ धृष्टद्युम्नो महीपते। प्रविश्य शिविरं रात्रौ पशुमारेण मारितः॥
answer: Entering into their camp in the night, O king, I have killed the sinful Dhrishtadyumna, as one kills an animal.'

question: इन्द्रियाणि च भावाश्च गुणाः सप्तदश स्मृताः। तेषामष्टादशो देही यः शरीरे स शाश्वतः॥
answer: There are five organs of knowledge, and five of action; with muscular power, mind, understanding, and faculty, and with also the three qualities of goodness, darkness and ignorance, the number, it has been said, comes up to seventeen. The eighteenth in the calculation is he who owns the body. Indeed, he who lives in this body is eternal.

question: स्वनाम नामा दुर्धर्षो द्वितीयो हेमपर्वतः। द्युतिमान् नाम कौरव्य तृतीयः कुमुदो गिरिः॥
answer: It is called after the island, this mountain is made of gold and it is inaccessible. O descendant of Kuru, there is another greatly effulgert mountain called Kumuda.

question: तेषामाशु प्रयातानां स्थानां तत्र वेगिनाम्। बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो दिवस्पृक् पृथिवीपते॥
answer: The noise made by the cars of those quickly-proceeding warriors became very loud, O king and touched the very sky.

question: निर्याय च महाबाहुर्वासुदेवो महामनाः। निवेशाय ययौ वेश्म विदुरस्य महात्मनः॥
answer: And the large minded Vamadeva of long arms, coming out went to the residence of the great-souled Vidura.

question: स्तोकका: शिखिनश्चैव पुंस्कोकिलगणैः सह। मत्ताः परिपतन्ति स्म दर्दुराश्चैव दर्पिताः॥
answer: The Chatakas, .the peacocks, the male kokilas and the excited frogs all intoxicated (with joy) began to frolic about.

question: गण्डली मेस्थामा च देवाधिपतिरेव च। अथर्वशीर्ष: सामास्य ऋक्सहस्रामितेक्षणः॥
answer: You are he who ranges over hills and hillocks; you are he who lives on the mountains of Meru; you are the king of the celestials; you have the Atharvans for your head; you have the Samans for your mouth; you have the thousand Riches for your immeasurable eyes.

question: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्स्थो मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्। मध्यकक्षान्तरं रामो निर्जगाम सुहद्धृतः॥
answer: Having thus addressed Maithili, the daughter of Janaka, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, then issued out of the inner apartment and entered the middle one filled with his friends.

question: सात्यकि प्रेक्ष्य गोप्तारं पाञ्चाल्यं च महाहवे। शराणां त्वरितो द्रोणः षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत्॥
answer: That foremost descendant of Sini then rescued the prince of the Panchalas from Drona. Beholding Satyaki save the Panchala prince in that battle. Drona quickly sped at him twenty-six arrows.

question: असौ हि भूरिश्रवसो माता शोकपरिप्लुता। आश्वासयति भर्तारं सोमदत्तमनिन्दिता॥ दिष्ट्या नैनं महाराज दारुणं भरतक्षयम्। कुरुसंक्रन्दनं घोरं युगान्तमनुपश्यसि॥
answer: There the mother of Bhurishravas that faultless lady, beside herself with grief, is addressing her lord Somadatta, saying,-By good luck, O king, you do not witness this terrible destruction of the Bharatas, this extermination of the Kurus, this sight resembling the spectacles occurring at the end of a cycle.

question: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा मेघनादं प्रजापतिः। नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं हि कस्यचित्प्राणिनो भुवि॥ पक्षिणश्चतुष्पदो वा भूतानां वा महौजसाम्।
answer: Thereat the highly powerful patriarch said to Meghanāda, “There is none perfectly immortal on earth among created beings, birds, quadrupeds and other highly powerful beings.”

question: विदुर उवाच देवव्रत निबोधेदं वचनं मम भाषतः। प्रणष्टः कौरवो वंशस्त्वयाऽयं पुनरुद्भूतः॥
answer: Vidura said O you of divine vows, listen to these words spoken by me; this race of Kurus made extinct by you, had again been saved from extermination.

question: ते समीक्ष्य च तं कृष्णमुग्रकर्माणमाहवे। सर्वे ययुधिरे वीरा रथस्थास्तं पदातिनम्॥
answer: Themselves seated on cars, they fought Arjuna of dreadful feats who was on foot,

question: ततो ज्ञात्वा हतामित्रं युधिष्ठिरमुपागतम्। गान्धारी पुत्रशोकार्ता शप्तुमैच्छदनिन्दिता॥
answer: The innocent Gandhari, stricken with grief on üccount of the death of her hundred sons, thought that king Yudhishthira the just had killed all his enemies, and wished to curse him.

question: अरुन्तुदं परुषं तीक्ष्णवाचं वाक्कण्टकैर्वितुदन्तं मनुष्यान्। विद्यादलक्ष्मीकतमं जनानां मुखे निबद्धां निर्ऋतिं वहन्तम्॥
answer: He who pricks another by the thorns of cruel words holds in his mouth a persecuting Rakshasa. Lakshmi (prosperity) leaves the man who casts his eyes on even such a man.

question: प्रवृत्तमेतद् भगवन् महर्षे महाद्युतेश्चक्रमनन्तवीर्यम्। विष्णोरनन्तस्य सनातनं तत् स्थानं सर्गा यत्र सर्वे प्रवृत्ताः। स वै महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमो वै तस्मिन् जगत् सर्वमिदं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
answer: O illustrious Rishi, O holy one, I see this wheel of Time, endued with great energy, of the most effulgent and Infinite Vishnu, has been set in motion. Eternal is that station from which all sorts of creation originate. That Vishnu is the Supreme Soul. He is the foremost of Beings. In Him this entire universe lives.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच देयाः किंलक्षणा गावः काश्चापि परिवर्जयेत्। कीदृशाय प्रदातव्या न देयाः कीदृशाय च॥
answer: Yudhishthira said What should be the marks of those kine that deserve to be given away? What are those kine that should be looked over in the matter of gifts? What should be the characters of those persons to whom should kine be given? Who, again, are those to whom kine should not be given?

question: न कामये नरश्रेष्ठ जीवितं पृथिवीं तथा। यथा तव प्रियं राजंश्चिकीर्षामि परंतप॥
answer: a state O foremost of men, I do not wish for life and the Earth! O scorcher of enemies, I shall engage myself in doing what is pleasant to you.

question: कौरवेषु निवृत्तेषु पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः। सिंहनादान् भृशं चक्रुः शङ्खान् दध्मुश्च भारत॥
answer: Upon the withdrawal of the Kurus, the victorious Pandavas sent up their war cries accompanied with the blare of conchs and cornets.

question: यत्र ते सुकृतात्मानो विहरन्ति महर्षयः। तत् पुण्यं शबरीस्थानं जगामात्मसमाधिना॥
answer: By virtue of her devout meditation, Savarī repaired to that holy region where dwelt her spiritual preceptors-the pure-hearted ascetics.

question: दृढाश्वः कपिलाश्वश्च चन्द्राश्वश्चैव भारत। तेभ्यः परम्परा राजनिक्ष्वाकूणां महात्मनाम्॥ वंशस्य सुमहाभाग राज्ञाममिततेजसाम्।
answer: O descendant of the Bharata race, they (the sons) were called Dridhashva, Kapilashva and Chandrashva, from whom, O king, has sprung the line of greatly powerful kings belonging to that most illustrious race of Ikshyaku.

question: पाण्डवास्तु जयं लब्वा तव सैन्यं समाद्रवन्। समन्तान्निशितान् बाणान् विमुञ्चन्तो जयैषिणः॥
answer: Having thus accomplished victory the Pandavas, desirous of achieving (further) success, pursued your soldiers, on all sides, making a discharge of arrows.

question: ततो व्यासस्थली नाम तत्र व्यासेनधीमता॥ पुत्रशोकाभितप्तेन देहत्यागे कृता मतिः। ततो देवैस्तु राजेन्द्र पुनरुत्थापितस्तदा॥ अभिगत्वा स्थलीं तस्य गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्।
answer: One should then go to the Tirtha named Vyasasthali where the wise Vyasa. Afflicted as he was with the grief for the death of his son, determined to give up his being and where, O king of kings, he was cheered up by the celestials. Going to (Vyasa) sthali one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

question: दिशस्तस्यास्ततो भूयः प्रस्थितो दक्षिणां दिशम्। विन्ध्यपादपसंकीर्णा चन्दनदुमशोभिताम्॥
answer: And changing that direction, I again made for the South crowded with trees belonging to Vindhya, and embellished with sandal woods.

question: अपि कौशिकं भद्रं ते गुरुणा मम संगता। मम माता मुनिश्रेष्ठ रामसंदर्शनादितः॥
answer: O Kausika good betide you, has my mother, in consequence of beholding Rāma, been united with my revered sire?

question: अत्रैव नाहुषो राजा राजन् क्रतुभिरिष्टवान्। ययातिर्बहुरत्नौधैर्यवेन्द्रो मुदमभ्यगात्॥
answer: O king, here did king Yayati, the son of Nahusha, perform sacrifices in which gifts of gems were in great abundance and by which Indra was much gratified.

question: तेषामर्थे महाराज योद्धव्यमिति मे मतिः। अतस्त्वां क्लीबवद् ब्रूयां युद्धादन्यत् किमिच्छसि॥
answer: O king, I must fight for them. I therefore speck like a eunuch in telling you, “Battle excepted, what do you desire to get?"

question: हत्वा रक्षः क्षितिं प्राप्य कृत्येव निपपात ह। तं राक्षसं भीमबलं भीमसेनेन पातितम्॥ ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि सिंहेनेव गवां पतिम्। तं प्रेक्ष्य निहतं भूमौ हतशेषा निशाचराः। भीममार्तस्वरं कृत्वा जग्मुः प्राची दिशं प्रति॥
answer: Killing the Rakshasa reached ground. And all the creatures beheld that exceedingly powerful Rakshasa slain by Bhima as a bull is slain by a lion. Seeing him slain on the ground the surviving Rakshasa, uttering loud cries of distress, went towards the East.

question: आसनानि विचित्राणि रुचिराणि महीपतिः। प्रयत्नोपहितानि स्म दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागमत्॥
answer: The king was much astonished to see the beautiful carpets which these Brahmanas offered him (for his seat).

question: ब्रह्मर्षीश्चापि देवांश्च गोपायस्व त्रिविष्टपे। अभिषिक्तः स राजेन्द्र ततो राजा त्रिविष्टपे॥
answer: Protect also the Brahmarshis and the gods in heaven. And that chief among the kings being anointed the king in heaven.

question: ततस्ते तापसाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म तं नृपम्। पूजाभिः स्वागताधाभिरासनेनोदकेन च॥
answer: Then did all those ascetics worship that ruler of men and welcome him with their greetings, seat and water.

question: चेकितानोऽनुविन्देन युयुधे चातिभैरवम्। यथा देवासुरे युद्धे बलशक्रौ महाबलौ॥
answer: The dreadful Chekitana fought with Anuvindha; they careered through the field of battle, disappearing at times and exciting great wonder.

question: रसातलं प्रविष्टायां वैदेह्यां सर्ववानराः। चुक्रुशुः साधुसाध्वीति मुनयो रामसंनिधौ॥
answer: Sītā having entered Rasātala, all the monkeys and Rșis repeatedly eulogised her before Rāma.

question: स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षिमपराजितम्॥
answer: Art you well come, O chief of men? It is by our luck that, O descendant of Raghu, you have come to us, headed by the respected Maharși Visvamitra.

question: राजहंससमूहैश्च कृष्णैः परभृतैस्तथा॥ पक्षिराजो गरुत्मांश्च यं नित्यमधितिष्ठति।
answer: Many bevies of swans also, and many flights of gladdened coils, too, adorned the place. The king of birds, viz., Garuda, live on that suimit constantly.

question: पञ्चैव हि सुता देवि भविष्यन्ति तव ध्रुवाः॥ सार्जुना वा हते कर्णे सकर्णा वा हतेऽर्जुने।
answer: Forsooth, O goddess, you will always have five sons! If Karna be killed with Arjuna, You will have five! If, on the other hand, Arjuna be killed, You will have five, with me.'

question: इदं तु त्वां कुरुराजोऽभ्युवाच पूर्वं पृष्ट्वा कुशलं चाव्ययं च। इयं सभा त्वत्सभातुल्यरूपा भ्रातृणां ते दृश्यतामेत्य पुत्र॥
answer: The Kuru king has commanded me first to enquire after your peace and prosperity, and then to tell you on his behalf the following. (He says to you), "The Assembly-hall of your cousin (built by me) is equal to your Sabha. Therefore, (come) and see it.

question: यज्ञे वा भुजगास्तस्मिञ्छतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। जनान्दशन्तु वै सर्वे नैवं त्रासो भविष्यसि॥
answer: Or let the snakes go in hundred and thousands to the sacrifice, bite every one and thus create a terror.

question: ते वध्यामानाः समरे तव पौत्रेव धन्विना। व्यद्रवन्त दिशस्तूर्णं दावदग्धा इव द्विपाः॥
answer: Those warriors, having been slain by that bowman, your grandson, in the field of battle, most speedily ran away in all directions; even, the elephants, burnt by the forestconflagration, (run away from the forest).

question: कल्माषगोयुगेनाथ युक्तेन तरतो जलम्। पितरोऽभिलषन्ते वै नावं चाप्यधिरोहिताः॥
answer: When one crosses a river on a car to which is yoked a couple of oxen of variegated colour, or from them that cross a river on boats, the departed Manes expect oblations of water.

question: पौराश्च बहुला राजन् हृषीकेशं दिदृक्षवः। यानैर्बहुविधैरन्यैः पन्दिरेव तथा परे॥
answer: Crowds of the townsmen, o king, desirous of having a look of Hrishikesha, were there in diverse sorts of conveyances, while there were others on foot. son

question: निर्वाणं सर्वधर्माणां निवृत्तिः परमा स्मृता। तस्मान्निवृत्तिमापन्नश्चरेत् सर्वाङ्गनिर्वृतः॥
answer: The highest Renunciation is the annihilation of all duties and acts. Hence, by adopting Renunciation one should act in complete happiness.

question: अकरोत् स ततः कालं शरतल्पगतो मुनिः। अयनं दक्षिणं हित्वा सम्प्राप्ते चोत्तरायणे॥
answer: Lying on abcd of arrows, Bhishma waited like an ascetic till the sun leaving his southwards path entered on his northerly course when that hero died.

question: ग्रस्तान् हि कौरवान् मन्ये मृत्युना तात संगतान्। विक्रमोऽपि रणे तेषां न तथा दृश्यते हि वै॥
answer: O son, I consider the assembled Kaurava host already within the jaws of Death. Their prowess in battle is no longer seen to be what it once was.

question: कुरवस्तु ततः कर्ण परिवार्य समन्ततः। अवाकिरन् भीमसेनं शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
answer: Thereupon the Kurus surrounding Karna, on all sides, began to shower upon Bhimasena, numerous arrows of depressed knots.

question: निरुत्साहस्य दीनस्य शोकपर्याकुलात्मनः। सर्वार्था व्यवसीदन्ति व्यसनं चाधिगच्छति॥
answer: Of a person that is dispirited and poor in pluck and that has his soul overwhelmed with grief, every interest droops, and he comes by misfortunes (one after another).

question: स्त्वसम्भवं नो व्यसनं नरेन्द्र। मास्मान् क्रूरैर्वाक्प्रतोदैस्तुदंस्तवं भूयो राजन् कोपयेस्त्वल्पभाग्यः॥
answer: O ruler of mankind, it was you who had played at dice and it was for you alone that our kingdom was lost and we have fallen on evil days. Therefore, O king, do not provoke us too much by casting cruel aspersions on us.

question: अब्रवीच्च दशग्रीवः पिशाची?रदर्शनाः॥ यथा नैनां पुमान् स्त्री वा सीतां पश्यत्यसम्मतः।
answer: Then the Ten-headed one spoke to some female friends of terrible visages, Let no man or woman behold Sītā without my permission.

question: व्यूढेनासुरयुद्धेन हत्वा दैतेयदानवान्। व्यभजत् पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ययातिनहुषात्मजः॥
answer: Having killed many Daityas and Danavas duly in battle, Nahusha's son Yayati divided the whole Earth (among his children).

question: न ह्यदत्तां महीं पित्रा भरतः शास्तुमिच्छति। त्वयि वा पुत्रवद् वस्तुं यदि जातो महीपतेः॥
answer: Bharata never wishes to govern a kingdom that has not been conferred upon him by his father; nor, if he has really been begotten by the monarch, will he any further act by you as a son.

question: दण्डेनोपनतं शत्रु यो राजा न नियच्छति। स मृत्युमुपगृह्णाति गर्भमश्वतरी यथा॥
answer: That king who does not crush down an enemy by military force, provides for his own death like the crab when she conceives.

question: अथाध्वनि परिश्रान्तमर्धरात्रे स्थितं बलम्। सुखसुप्तं समासाद्य चरितं प्रथमं चरैः॥
answer: Then at midnight (my) spies coming to that host, thus stationed, fatigued from travel, and sleeping soundly (in consequence), first ranged it.

question: जानामि त्वां युधां श्रेष्ठमत्यन्तं पूर्ववैरिणम्। अनयस्याद्य सम्प्राप्तं फलं पश्य सुदारुणम्॥
answer: “I know you to be one of the foremost in battle; your enmity for us in days gone by, was also implacable. Today, reap the mortal fruit of that wicked behaviour of yours.

question: पुत्रो दशरथस्यैष सिंहसंहननो युवा। दूषणो निहतो येन स्वरश्च त्रिशिरास्तथा॥
answer: And this is Dasaratha's son—this you resembling a lion, who slew Düşana and Khara and Triſiras.

question: एतावानिह संवासो विहितस्ते मया सह। षण्मासान् सप्तमे मासि त्वं वीर निधनं गतः॥
answer: Your union with me in this world had, it seems, been ordained for only six months, for on the seventh, O hero, you lost your life.

question: स्वर्णशृङ्गी च कपिला सवत्सां वस्त्रसंवृताम्। वाचकाय च दद्याद्धि आत्मनः श्रेय इच्छता॥
answer: One desirous of one's own behoot should give to the reciter a Kapila cow with horns cased in gold and accompanied by her calf, covered with a cloth.

question: धनंजयो स्थानीकमभ्यवर्तत वीर्यवान्॥ विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु व्याक्षिपद् गाण्डिवं धनुः।
answer: Drawing his bow Gandiva known all over the three worlds the highly energetic Dhananjaya rushed against your car-warriors.

question: स रथो भ्राजतेऽत्यर्थमुह्यमानो रणे तदा। उह्यमानमिवाकाशे विमानं पाण्डुरैर्हयैः॥
answer: That chariot, borne in that battle by white steeds, appeared excessively effulgent, like a celestial car borne through the firmament.

question: प्रमृते मयिधर्मात्मन् पुत्रदारादि नक्ष्यति। रक्षमाणः कपोतं त्वं बहून् प्राणान् न रक्षसि॥
answer: O virtuous-minded one, at my death my wife and children will perish. By protecting the pigeon you do not (at all) protect many lives.

question: शक्रवीर्योपमा युद्धे दीप्तया वह्निस नास्तथा॥ शत्रूणां विग्रहे नित्यं भयदास्ता भवन्त्युत।
answer: In battle, their energy esembled that of Shakra. In lustre they reseat-led fire. In battle they always struck terror to 'eir enemies.

question: गच्छ मद्वचनाद् रामं जामदग्न्यं तपस्विनम्। रामस्ते सुमहद् दुःखं शोकं चैवापनेष्यति॥
answer: By my advice go to the ascetic Rama, the son of Jamadagni. Rama will remove this heavy and horrible grief of yours.

question: एवं कृत्वा विधानं स संनिवेश्य वसुं तदा॥ धर्मनित्यः प्रजाः पुत्र क्षत्रधर्मेण पालय।
answer: Having made those arrangements and placed Vasu on the throne the king Nļga said:-“Do not leave the path of morality, O my son, and do you duly govern the subjects according to the custom of the Ksatriyas.

question: ततोऽपरे सुबहवो भरतानां महारथाः। प्राद्रवन्त भयत्रस्ता ह्रियाविष्टा विचेतसः॥
answer: Assailed with fear and shame and beside themselves with grief the remaining car warriors of the Bharata army, still a large number, fled aw.y.

question: इत्येवं विलपन्तीनां स्त्रीणां वेश्मसु राघवम्। जगामास्तं दिनकरो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत ॥
answer: As the women were thus bewailing Rāghava in their homes, the Sun set and night came on.

question: यावत् तिष्ठन्ति समरे हतशेषाः सहोदराः। नृपाश्च बहवो राजस्तावत् संधिः प्रयुज्यताम्॥
answer: As still, O king, these your uterine brothers and these myriad kings here survive the battle, let peace be concluded.

question: भुञ्जतां चैव विप्राणां वदतां च महास्वनः। अनिशं श्रूयते तत्र मुदितानां महात्मनाम्॥
answer: The noise of these illustrious Brahmanas eating and talking cheerfully was continuously heard.

question: भीष्म उवाच समुद्यतोऽयं भारो मे सुमहान् सागरोपमः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संग्रामे वर्षपूगाभिचिन्तितः॥
answer: Bhishma said The great burden (the impending fight) vast as the ocean is ready to fall on me, a calamity which I had foreseen for a series of years,

question: त्रेताद्वापरयोः संधौ तदा दैवविधिक्रमात्। अनावृष्टिरभूद् घोरा लोके द्वादशवार्षिकी।॥
answer: Towards the end of Treta and the commencement of Dvapara, a dreadful drought took place, extending for twelve years, in consequence of what the gods had ordained.

question: ये पठन्ति सदा मा येषां चैवोपतिष्ठति। श्रुत्वा च फलमाचष्टे स्वयं नारायणः प्रभुः॥
answer: Those men who always read the scriptures about these subjects, those who bear them properly in their mind, and he who, having listened to them, follows them in practice, are all considered to be as holy and sinless as the powerful Narayana himself.

question: कामं खलु न रोषो मे हैडिम्बे विद्यते त्वयि॥ किं तु रोषान्वितो जन्तुर्हन्यादात्मानमप्युता
answer: O son of Hidimva, I am in no way angry with you in my mind. But when a creature is excited with rage, it may (then) kill its own self.

question: तमापतन्तमुत्पत्य हनूमान्कपिकुञ्जरः॥ आजघान तदा मूर्ध्नि वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना।
answer: As he rushed on, that foremost of monkeysHanuman-~-dealt on the crown of his head, a blow resembling the thunder-bolt itself.

question: कृत्वा समयमव्यग्रो भवान् वै सहितो मया॥ यो भवेद्धदि संकल्पः शुभो वा यदि वाशुभः। अन्योन्यस्य स आख्येय इति तद् वै मृषा कृतम्॥ भवता वचनं ब्रह्मस्तस्मादेष शपाम्यहम्।
answer: And he said, ‘Having of your own accord made an agreement with me that, whatever wish, good or bad, would be entertained by either of us should be disclosed to the other you have violated it! These were your own words. O Brahman! It is for this that I shall curse you.

question: दशग्रीव तथा यत्नं कुरुष्वामितविक्रम। यथा त्वमपि मे पुत्र भवेर्वैश्रवणोपमः।॥
answer: Therefore, O Ten-necked one, O you of measureless prowess, do you so strive that you also, my son, may be like Vaisravana himself.

question: अथाब्रवीद् राजपुत्री कौरव्यो महिषीं प्रियाम्। गच्छ सैरन्ध्र मात्र स्थाः सुदेष्णाया निवेशनम्॥
answer: Then the chief of the Kurus addressed the princess, his beloved consort, saying "O Sairandhri, do not stay here, go to the apartment of Sudeshna.

question: नारद उवाच सुखदुःखैरहं त्वं च प्रजाः सर्वाश्च संजय॥ अविमुक्ता मरिष्यामस्तत्र का परिदेवना।
answer: Narada said Subject to happiness and misery myself, yourself, and all creatures, Srinjaya, shall have to die. What cause then is there for grief.

question: यथास्वं चाहकाण्येषां शब्दादीनामिमानि तु। इन्द्रियाणि यदा देही धारयन्निव तप्यते॥ लोके विततमात्मानं लोकं चात्मनि पश्यति। परावरज्ञो यः शक्तः स तु भूतानि पश्यति॥
answer: When a person engages in Tapa after having duly subdued his senses which have their own proper objective play in the external conditions of sound, form, then he sees that his own spirit pervades the whole universe and the universe is also reflected in him.

question: तां शस्त्रवृष्टिमतुलां द्विपहस्तैः प्रवेरिताम्। चिच्छेद निशितैर्भल्लैरर्धचन्दैश्च फाल्गुनः॥
answer: Phalguni cut-off with his broad-edged and crescent-shaped sharp arrows all those hosts of excellent weapons, although some of them were thrown by elephants with their tusks.

question: नमस्कार्यास्तथा विप्रा वर्तमाना यथातथम्। यथासुखं यथोत्साह ललन्तु त्वयि पुत्रवत्॥
answer: Let the Brahmanas live in whatever way they like. You should always bend your head to them with respect. Let them always rejoice in you as your children, living happily and according to their wishes.

question: साप्येवं ब्रुवतीं सीतां सरमा मृदुभाषिणी। उवाच वचनं तस्याः स्पृशन्ती बाष्पविक्लवम्।।१२
answer: This is the highest favour that I seek (at hands). Thereat, the mild-speeched Saramā, wiping (Sītā's) face washed in tears, spoke to her, as she said this.

question: जाग्रत्स्वपुंश्च कौन्तेय कर्णमेव सदा ह्यहम्। पश्यामि तत्र तत्रैव कर्णभूतमिदं जगत्॥
answer: Even while awake, O Arjuna, I see his illusion (of Karna) and it seems as if the whole universe is filled with Karna.

question: वपुर्भिश्च नरेन्द्राणां चन्द्रसूर्यसमप्रभैः। विरराज तदा राजंस्तत्र तत्र रणाङ्गणम्॥
answer: Then, O monarch, here and there, the field of battle appeared beautiful being strewn over with the bodies of monarchs which were effulgent like the sun or the moon.

question: एवमाश्वासितः पार्थः कृष्णेनाद्भुतकर्मणा। ततोऽव्रबीत् तदा भ्रातृन् सर्वान् पार्थः सगद्गदान्॥
answer: Thus consoled by Krishna of wonderful deeds, the son of Pritha (Arjuna) said to all his brothers these words in a voice choked with griefस दीर्घबाहुः पृथ्वंसो दीर्घराजीवलोचनः।

question: ततस्तदर्थं यतते कर्म चारभते महत्। इष्टानां रूपगन्धानामभ्यासं च निषेवते॥
answer: For that end, they labour and perform great works and indulge in their much desired pleasures of beauty, of flavour.

question: विक्रीडितं कुमारेण यथानीकं बिभित्सता। आरुग्णाश्च यथा वीरा दुःसाध्याश्चापि विप्लवे॥
answer: I shall tell you, how that hero played amidst us, having penetrated into our ranks; as also how, many irresistible heroes inspired with hopes of victory were afflicted by him.

question: कथं परानुभावज्ञः स्वं प्रशंसितुमर्हति। परेण समवेतस्तु यः प्रशस्यः स पूज्यते॥
answer: He who knows the velour and the strength of others never applauds himself. He is really worthy of praise who even in fighting with his enemies bear himself with all commendation.

question: ते सालैश्चाश्वकर्णैश्च धवैर्वशैश्च वानराः। कुटजैरर्जुनैस्तालैस्तिलकैस्तिनिशैरपि ॥ बिल्वकैः सप्तपर्णैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः। चूतैश्चाशोकवृक्षैश्च सागरं समपूरयन् ॥
answer: The monkeys filled the Ocean with Sālas, and Ašvakarņas, dhavas, bamboo's and kutajas, arjunas, palms, tilakas, tinicas, billakas, saptaparnas, and blossoming karnikāras, mangoes, and asoka trees.

question: आदित्यानां भवान् विष्णुर्वसूनां चैव पावकः। पक्षिणां वैनतेयस्त्वमनन्तो भुजगेषु च॥
answer: Among the Adityas, you are Vishnu (Upendra), among the Vasus, you are Pavaka, among birds you are Garuda, and among snakes you are Ananta.

question: स्मृत्वा वियोगजं दुःखं त्यज स्नेहं प्रिये जने। अतिस्नेहपरिष्वङ्गाद् वर्तिरार्दापि दह्यते॥
answer: Remembering the grief consequent on separation do you forsake your attachment to your dear one. Out of an excess of oil even the wick burn itself.

question: अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां युष्मान्वा पुरुषर्षभाः॥ अपवादभयाद्भीतः किं पुनर्जनकात्मजाम्।
answer: O foremost of men, what to speak of the daughter of Janaka-I can even renounce my life and yourselves in fear of a bad name.

question: शुकेन ख्यापितो विप्र तं देवाः समुपाद्रवन्। शशाप शुकमग्निस्तु वाग्विहीनो भविष्यसि॥
answer: This new residence of Agni was made known by a parrot. The gods there upon went there. Enraged with the conduct of the parrot, the God of Fire cursed the whole parrot race, saying, You shall from this day be deprived of the power of speech.

question: अशोभत महादेवः पौर्णमास्यामिवोडुराट्। तस्य तेजोभवो वह्निः समेघः सन्तयित्नुमान्।।२४५ सहस्रमिव सूर्याणां सर्वमापूर्य धिष्ठितः। ईश्वरः सुमहातेजाः संवर्तक इवानलः॥ युगान्ते सर्वभूतानां दिधक्षुरिव चोद्यतः।
answer: Mahadeva shone like the full-moon. The fire born of his energy shone ini effulgence like lightning that flashes amid clouds. It seemed as if a thousand suns rose there, filling every quarter with a dazzling splendour. That energy of the Supreme Lord looked like the Samvartaka fire which destroys all creatures at the end of the Yoga.

question: स एवमुक्तोऽथाश्वास्य आशीर्वादैः सुमङ्गलैः। गृहानुपययौ चापि कृतार्थः सुमहामनाः॥
answer: Thus addressed by her, that high-souled Brahmana solaced Damayanti by the expression of auspicious benedictions, and then he returned home, thinking himself successful in his endeavours.

question: कुण्डली मुकुटी खड्गी रक्तचन्दनरूषितः। शिरसा धारयन् दीप्तां तपनीयमी स्रजम्॥
answer: And graced with Kundalas and a diadem and armed with a sword and anointed with red sandal paste and wearing round his head an effulgent garland of gold.

question: न सन्ति तस्मात् पुत्रा यत् कृतं वृष्णिवीरेण कर्म शंससि मे रणे। नैतदुत्सहते कर्तु कर्म शक्रोऽपि संजय॥
answer: Tell me O Sanjaya, how the single-handed grandson Sini passed through that host of mine, which was fighting vigorously against him?

question: कर्तृत्वाच्चापि सर्गाणां सर्गधर्मा तथोच्यते। कर्तृत्वाच्चापि योगानां योगधर्मा तथोच्यते॥ कर्तृत्वात् प्रकृतीनां च तथा प्रकृतिधर्मिता॥
answer: On account of the Soul's Supremacy over the principles that originate from Nature he is said to partake of the nature of those principles. On account also of his agency in the matter of creation, he is said to possess the quality of creation. On account of his agency in the matter of Yoga, he is said to possess the quality of Yoga. For his Supremacy over those particular principles know by the name of Nature, he is said to possess the character of Nature.

question: पिष्टोदकं सुतो यस्य पीत्वा क्षीरस्य तृष्णया। नृत्यति स्म मुदाविष्टः क्षीरं पीतं मयाप्युत॥ इति सम्भाषतां वाचं श्रुत्वा मे बुद्धिरच्यवत्। आत्मानं चात्मना गर्हन् मनसेदं व्यचिन्तयम्॥ अपि चाहं पुरा विप्रैर्वर्जितो गर्हितो वसे। परोपसेवां पापिष्ठां न च कुर्यां धनेप्सया॥
answer: His son in the thirst for milk drinks Pistaudaka; in ignorance he dances, crying “I have drunk milk.” Hearing these derisive words, I was quite beside myself! Then reproaching myself by myself, I began to reflect thus in my mind, "Cast off and censured by Brahmanas, I would not yet, from the desire of wealth, be any body's servant, which is ever sinful."

question: नारद उवाच अहो बत महत् पापं सावित्र्या नृपते कृतम्। अजानन्त्या यदनया गुणवान् सत्यवान् वृतः॥
answer: Narada said: Alas, O king, Savitri has done a very foolish act in as much as she, has through ignorance, chosen for her husband, Satyavana endued with (high) qualities.

question: तथा ब्रुवाणं भरतं दृष्ट्वा तं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। मुमुचुनिरा बाष्पं राक्षसश्च विभीषणः॥
answer: Hearing Bharata speak in that wise and beholding him devoted to his brother all the monkeys and the Rākşasa Vibhîşana shed tears.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरस्तं तथेत्युक्त्वा भीष्मेण सह भारत। पाण्डु संस्कारयामास देशे परमपूजिते॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of the Bharata race, Vidura said, “Be it so" and he with Bhishma performed the funeral ceremony of Pandu on a sacred spot.

question: प्रकाशयात्मनाऽऽत्मानं दैत्यदानवसूदन। तेजः समाप्नुहि विभो देवराज्यं प्रशाधि च॥
answer: O you slayer of Daityas and Danavas, hide no longer your ownself. O lord, assume your own strength and rule the kingdom of the gods.

question: अथ गोकर्णमासाद्य त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। समुद्रमध्ये राजेन्द्र सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम्॥ यत्र ब्रह्मादयो देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः। भूतयक्षपिशाचाश्च किंनराः समहोरगाः॥ सिद्धचारणगन्धर्वमानुषाः पन्नगास्तथा। सरितः सागराः शैला उपासन्त उमापतिम्॥
answer: The going to Gokarna, celebrated all over the three worlds and, O king of kings, which is situated in the midst of the ocean and is reverenced by all the worlds. Where Brahma and other celestials, the ascetic Rishis, the Bhutas, the Yakshas, the Kinnaras, the great Nagas, the Siddhas, the Charanas, the Gandharvas, the men, the snakes, the rivers, the seas and the hills, worship the lord of Uma.

question: भ्रातुर्वचनमाज्ञाय पाण्डवा धर्मचारिणः। यथार्ह नृपतीन् सर्वानेककैकं समनुव्रजन्॥
answer: Having been thus commanded by their brothers, the virtuous Pandava princes followed the kings one after the other as each deserved.

question: नास्यान्तरं ददृशुः स्वे परे वा यथा पुरा वज्रधरस्य दैत्याः। दैत्याः पुरा वासवस्येव राजन्॥ ते पाण्डवाः सोमकाः सृञ्जयाश्च तमेकनागं ददृशुः समन्तात्। सहस्रशो वै विचरन्तमेकं यथा महेन्द्रस्य गजं समीपे॥
answer: The Pandavas, the Somakes and the Srinjayas, saw one elephant look like a thousand elephants moving around them as the enemies of the gods had in days of yore seen the elephant of Indra in battle.

question: अर्थों द्वावपि निष्पन्नौ युधिष्ठिर भविष्यतः। प्रतीकारश्च वासस्य धर्मश्च चरितो महान्॥
answer: O Yudhisthira, two objects will be gained by this act, one is the requital of the Brahmana's services (to us) and the other is the acquisition of great religious merit.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच पितामहं गुरुं चैव प्रत्युद्गम्य युधिष्ठिरः। अभिवाद्यः ततो राजन्निदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Vaishampayana said O king, having approached and worshipped his grandfather (Bhishma) and his preceptor (Drona), Yudhishthira thus spoke to,

question: सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद्ब्रतं मम॥
answer: I always declare 'no fear' to all creatures, whenever any, approaching me, says, 'I am thine' and seek my shelter. Even this is my pious observance.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच सभां गत्वा स चोवाच द्रौपद्यास्तद् वचस्तदा। युधिष्ठिरं नरेन्द्राणां मध्ये स्थितमिदं वचः॥
answer: Vaishampayana said Having returned to the Sabha, he (Pratikamin) told all present there the words of Draupadi. He spoke these words to Yudhisthira sitting in the midst of the kings.

question: महात्मनां तु भूयिष्ठं त्वद्विधानां कृतात्मनाम्। निश्चला भवति प्रीतिधैर्यमात्मवतां वर॥
answer: O free one, the felicity of high-souled and self-governed friends like you abounds and is enduring.

question: योऽरुन्धतीं न पश्येत दृष्टपूर्वां कदाचन। तथैव ध्रुवमित्याहुः पूर्णेन्दुं दीपमेव च॥ खण्डाभासं दक्षिणतस्तेऽपि संवत्सरायुषः।
answer: One who, having previously seen the fixed star called Arandhati, cannot see it, or that other star called Dhruva, or one that sees the full Moon or the flame of a burning lamp to be broken towards the south, has but one year to live.

question: भीष्म उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि येन श्रेयो ह्यवाप्स्यसि। पीत्वामृतमिव प्राज्ञो ज्ञानतृप्तो भविष्यसि॥
answer: Bhishma said I shall describe to you that by which you may acquire high merit. Wise as you are, you will be satisfied with the knowledge I will impart to you, like a person gratified with having drunk ambrosia.

question: अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु संतोषः शीलमार्जवम्। तपो दमश्च सत्यं च प्रदानं चेति सम्मितम्॥
answer: Abstention from injury to all creatures, contentment, conduct, sincerity, penances, selfcontrol, truthfulness, and gifts, are each equal in point of merit to sacrifice.

question: अशोकवनिका चापि महतीयं महादुमा। इमामधिगमिष्यामि नहीयं विचिता मया।५३ ।।
answer: This is the Asoka wood, extensive and containing mighty trees. This I shall explore, as it has not yet been searched by me.

question: एकान्तेन हि सर्वेषां न शक्यं तात रोचितुम्। मित्रामित्रमथो मध्यं सर्वभूतेषु भारत॥
answer: No man, O sire, can acquire the golden opinion of all persons in the world. All persons have friends, foes, and indifferent ones, O Bharata.

question: अनादिष्टस्तु गुरुणा को नु युध्येत मानवः। आदिष्टस्तु यथा राजन् को न युध्येत मादृशः॥
answer: Unless commanded by his preceptors, what man goes to battle with his enemies? When again commanded, O king, like myself, by his preceptors, what man is there that would not fight?

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं सम्पूजितो राजा पाण्डवैरम्बिकासुतः। विजहार यथापूर्वमृषिभिः पर्युपासितः॥
answer: Thus adored by the Pandavas, the royal son of Ambika passed his time happily as before, waited upon and honoured by the Rishis.

question: स तैर्विकर्णस्य रथात् पातयामास वीर्यवान्। ध्वजं सूतं हयांश्चैव नृत्यमान इवाहवे॥
answer: Possessed of great prowess, and as if dancing in battle, with those shafts he cut down the standard of Vikarna from this car and also slew his charioteer and steeds.

question: महीपालाश्च सर्वे त्वां प्रजापतिमिवामराः। निरीक्षन्ते महात्मानं लोकनाथं यथा वयम्॥ पुत्राश्च पितृवद्राजन्पश्यन्ति त्वां महाबल। पृथिव्या गतिभूतोऽसि प्राणिनामपि राघव॥ स त्वमेवंविधं यज्ञमाहर्तासि कथं नृप। पृथिव्या राजवंशानां विनाशो यत्र दृश्यते॥
answer: O you of unmitigated prowess, as the deities honour the patriarch so other kings hold you in reverence. O king, all creatures mobile and immobile consider you as their father. O you of great strength, you are the refuge of all animals and of the universe. Therefore of what use is such a sacrifice to you? In such a sacrifice all the royal families meet with ruin.

question: तदेतत्सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्य भीमपराक्रम। नहि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली॥
answer: Therefore, o you of dreadful strength! summon your entire energy. Him find I not among all beings, who is your peer in prowess.

question: ते शरार्ता महाराज विप्रकीर्णमहाध्वजाः॥ नाभ्यवर्तन्त राजानः सहिता वानरध्वजम्। सध्वजा रथिन: पेतुर्हयारोहा हयैः सह॥ सगजाश्च गजारोहाः किरीटिशरताडिताः। ततोऽर्जुनभुजोत्सृष्टैरावृताऽऽसीद् वसुन्धरा॥ विद्रवद्भिश्च वहुधा बलैः राज्ञां समन्ततः। अथ पार्थो महाराज द्रावयित्वा वरुथिनीम्॥
answer: Then, O mighty monarch, those Kaurava warriors with their tall standards splintered into pieces, ventured nor, even in a body, experienced against Arjuna owning the standard marked with the device of an ape. S011 Afflicted with shafts by the diadem-decked Arjuna, car-warriors fell with their standards, horse-riders with their horses and elephantriders with their elephants. Then the earth become soon covered with divisions of kings flying in all directions in consequence of the shafts shot by the arms of Arjuna. Then having completely crushed the enemy's ranks, the son of Pritha,

question: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्नि विबोधयितुमिच्छसि। न्यस्य चापं निवर्तस्व प्राणान्न जहिमद्गतः॥
answer: You wish to rouse a fire slumbering sweetly. Leaving alone your bow, do you return. Do not lose your life by coming in contact with me.

question: भीमसेनोऽभिमन्युश्च राक्षश्च घटोत्कचः। द्रौपदेयाः सत्यधृतिः क्षत्रदेवश्च भारत॥
answer: Bhimasena, Abhimanyu, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, the son of Draupadi, Satyadhriti, Kshatradeva, and O sire,

question: हत्वैतान् मानुषान् सर्वानानयस्व ममान्तिकम्। अस्मद्विषयसुप्तेभ्यो नैतेभ्यो भयमस्ति ते॥
answer: Killing all these men, bring them to me. They are asleep in my dominion. There is no fear for you.

question: ब्रह्म वक्त्रं भुजौ क्षत्रं कृत्स्नमूरूदरं विशः। पादौ यस्याश्रिताः शूद्रास्तस्मै वर्णात्मने नमः॥
answer: Brahmanas are your mouth, Kshatriyas are your two arms., Vaishyas are your stomach and thighs, and Shudras are your feet. Salutations to you in your form of caste.

question: तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान् हरिसत्तमः। वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम्॥
answer: Seeing the Ten-necked one of mighty energy, that foremost of monkeys, endued with strength, calmly spoke to him words containing sense,

question: तपोनित्येन दान्तेन मुनिना संयतात्मना। अजितं जेतुकामेन भाव्यं सङ्गेष्वसङ्गिना॥
answer: One should live always practising penances, and with all passions completely controlled; observing the vow of silence, and with soul concentrated on itself; desirous of conquering the senses, and unattached.

question: दयिताश्च नरास्ते स्युभक्तिमन्तो द्विजेषु ये। न कोशः परमोऽन्योऽस्ति राज्ञां पुरुषसंचयात्॥
answer: Those persons who revere the Brahmanas should be favoured by you. There is no wealth more valuable to kings than the proper selection of servants.

question: अप्राप्तमन्तरा रामः सप्तभिस्तमजिह्मगैः। चिच्छेद गिरिशृङ्गं तं पुनः संधाय कार्मुकम्॥ ततस्तु रामो धर्मात्मा तस्य शृङ्ग महत्तदा। शरैः काञ्चनचित्राङ्गैश्चिच्छेद भरताग्रजः॥ तन्मेरुशिखराकारै?तमानमिव श्रिया। द्वे शते वानराणां च पतमानमपातयत्॥
answer: Thereat Bharata's elder brother, the righteous Rāma, ere that prodigious peak had alighted, severed the same by means of seven straightspeeding shafts wrought with gold. Then that crag, like a peak of mountain Meru and shining with its radiance, falling on the earth knocked down two hundred monkeys too.

question: राज्ञो बलं दर्शयन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य भारत॥ शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य त्रातुमैच्छन्महारथाः।
answer: And displaying their prowess to your royal son, O descendant of Bharata, desired to rescue Shveta, with Shikhandin at their head.

question: ततो राजा तयोः पादावभिवाद्य महात्मनोः। प्रत्याजगाम स्वपुरं धर्मं चैवाचरद् भृशम्॥
answer: Then the king, bowing to the feet of the two great-souled beings, returned to his own capital and thenceforward acted most righteously.

question: जङ्गमाः स्थावराश्चैव दिवि वा यदि वा भुवि। सर्वे कालात्मकाः सर्प कालात्मकमिदं जगत्॥
answer: All creatures, mobile and immobile, in heaven, or earth, are pervaded by the influence of Kala. The whole universe, O serpent, is permeated by this same influence of Kala.

question: लङ्कायामथ गुप्तायां सागरेण समन्ततः। सम्प्राप्य सागरस्यान्तं सम्पूर्णं शतयोजनम्॥ आसाद्य दक्षिणं तीरं ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम्। तत्रैव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रं विक्रमध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः॥
answer: As the end of the ocean after a full hundred Yojanas, arriving at its southern shore, you shall see Rāvana in Laņkā, protected by ocean from all sides. You monkeys, do you hie thither speedily with vigour.

question: ततोऽब्रवीन्महाबाहुपदो बुद्धिमान् नृप। लुब्धोऽयं क्षत्रियान् हन्ति व्याघ्रः क्षुद्रमृगानिव॥
answer: His adversaries considered him to be none other than Indra himself armed with the thunder. Then, O king, the intelligent, Drupada

question: वानर उवाच सदा चाहं फलाहारो ब्राह्मणानां प्लवङ्गमः। तस्मान्न ब्राह्मणस्वं तु हर्तव्यं विदुषा सदा। समं विवादो मोक्तव्यो दातव्यं स प्रतिश्रुतम्॥
answer: The ape said In my former life I used to eat the fruits belonging to Brahmanas. Hence have I become an ape. Hence it is clear that one endued with intelligence and learning should never take what belongs to Brahmanas. As one should abstain from this, one should avoid also all quarrels with Brahmanas. Having promised, one should certainly make the promised gift lo them.

question: यावन लङ्कां समभिद्रवन्ति वलीमुखाः पर्वतकूटमात्राः। दंष्ट्रायुधाश्चैव नखायुधाश्च प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली॥
answer: Therefore before the monkeys, resembling mountain peaks, having teeth for their arms and nails, for their weapons, subjugate Lankā, do you render Maithili to Dasaratha's son.

question: कार्मुकं तस्य चिच्छेद फाल्गुनः परवीरहा। अविध्यच्च भृशं तीक्ष्णैः पत्रिभिः शत्रुकर्शनः॥
answer: Thereat the slayer of his foes, that humiliator of his antagonists, namely, Phalguna (Arjuna), cut down the bow of Drona's son and pierced him sore in return with five sharp arrows.

question: अहो देहप्रदानेन दर्शितातिथिपूजना॥ तस्माद् धर्मं चरिष्यामि धर्मो हि परमा गतिः। दृष्टो धर्मो हि धर्मिष्ठे यादृशो विहगोत्तमे॥
answer: Alas, by giving up his body the pigeon has shown how a guest should be adored! Taught by his example, I shall hereafter practise righteousness. Righteousness is the greatest refuge! Indeed, I shall practise the righteousness shown by the virtuous pigeon, that foremost of all winged creatures.

question: ऋषयश्च हि देवाश्च प्रीयन्ते पितृभिः सह। पूज्यमानेषु गुरुषु तस्मात् पूज्यतमो गुरुः॥
answer: If preceptors are adored the very Rishis, and the gods, together the Pitris, are all pleased. Therefore, the preceptor deserves the highest respect.

question: एते च निहता भूमौ रामेण निशितैः शरैः। ये च मे पदवी प्राप्ता राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः॥
answer: And these Rākşasas, living on flesh who had arrived at that place, have been slain by Rāma with sharpened shafts.

question: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः। बभूवुर्हरिशार्दूला विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः॥
answer: Hearing his words, those powerful monkeys, with vigour (enhanced, seeing success before them, felt the height of joy.

question: विकीर्णान्त्रा विहतैरुत्तमाङ्गैः सम्भग्नाङ्गाः शिश्यिरे तत्र शूराः। छिन्ना हयाः कुञ्जराश्चापि भग्नाः संचूर्णिताश्चैव रथाः शिलाभिः॥
answer: heroic warriors with weapons broken or falling off from their gasp or deprived of heads or with maimed limbs, began to fall down on the field. Then steeds and elephants and chariots were also crushed to pieces by the shower of stones.

question: जानामि ते वासुदेवं सहायं जानामि ते गाण्डिवं तालमात्रम्। जानाम्येतत् त्वादृशो नास्ति योद्धा जानानस्ते राज्यमेतद्धरामि॥
answer: I know that Vasudeva is your ally, I know your Gandiva bow which is six cubits long. I know that there is no warriors equal to you, and knowing all this I deprive you of your kingdom.

question: बभूवुस्तेन घोषेण संहृष्टा हरियूथपाः। अमृष्यमाणास्तद्धोषं विनेदुर्घोषवत्तरम्॥
answer: At those sounds, the leaders of monkey-bands were delighted beyond measure, and, resenting the same, set up cries louder than those sounds.

question: प्रत्यगूहुर्महानद्यो दिशो नीहारसंवृताः। उल्काश्चाङ्गारवर्षिण्यः प्रापतन् गगनाद् भुवि॥
answer: The great rivers ran in opposite courses. The horizon on every side seemed to be always covered with fog. Meteors, showering coals, dropped on the Earth from the sky.

question: तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य न शेकुरपि वीक्षितुम्। वानरेन्द्रा महात्मानो वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
answer: Even the great deep cannot see his own shores, those high-souled lord of monkeys, coming within the range of his arrows, could not even see.

question: अन्तर्धानमकस्माच्च पुनरेव च दर्शनम्। पुनश्च शयनं विप्र दिवसानेकविंशतिम्॥
answer: Why did you, again, without any reason, disappear and once more become visible? Why, O learned Brahmana, did you again lay yourself down on the bed, and sleep, as before, for one and twenty days.

question: तैजसी सा सभा राजन् बभूव शतयोजना। विस्तारायामसम्पन्ना भूयसी चापि पाण्डव॥ अर्कप्रकाशा भ्राजिष्णुः सर्वतः कामरूपिणी। नातिशीता च चात्युष्णा मनसश्च प्रहर्षिणी॥
answer: O king, that effulgent Sabha covers an area of one hundred Yojanas. O son of Pandu, it possesses the splendour of the sun; it yields every thing that one may desire to have from it. It is neither very cold nor very hot. It delights the heart.

question: ये चापि तेषां श्रोतारः सदा सदसि सम्मताः। विज्ञानगुणसम्पन्नास्तेभ्यश्च स्पृहयाम्यहम्॥
answer: Indeed, my heart longs after them who endued with knowledge and all desirable attributes, and honoured by others, listen to such words when uttered in assemblies or the courts of kings.

question: एवमभ्यधिकः पार्थाद् भविष्यामि गुणैरहम्। शल्योऽप्यभ्यधिकः कृष्णादर्जुनादपि चाप्यहम्॥
answer: Thus I will be superior to the son of Pritha in respect to these (the above mentioned) qualities. And thus, again, A Shalya is superior to Krishna; and I am superior to Arjuna.

question: इह त्यक्त्वा न तिष्ठन्ति बान्धवा बान्धवं प्रियम्। स्नेहमुत्सृज्य गच्छन्ति बाष्पपूर्णाविलेक्षणाः॥
answer: Leaving dead kinsman however dear, kinsman leave this spot. With eyes full of tcars, they go away, ccasing to show affection for the dead.

question: ववल्गुश्चात्र कासांचित् कुण्डलानि शुभार्चिषाम्। मुखमारुतसंकम्पैर्मन्दं मन्दं च योषिताम्॥
answer: The ear-rings of some dames possessed of a pleasant sheen, stirred by the air that was breathing about their faces, were undulating gently.

question: विस्मितश्चापि राजर्षिरिमां गाथां जगाद ह। अहो कष्टं यदस्माभिः सर्वं बाह्यमनुष्ठितम्॥
answer: Stricken with wonder, that royal sage then sang this verse : Alas it is a pity that we should have performed all acts that are external.

question: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। वेषां त्वं कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः॥
answer: O Rāvana, surely shall all the Räkşasas meet with death, who have such a stupid, harsh and lustful person like you for their king.

question: ब्राह्मणार्थे समुत्पन्ने योऽरिभिः सृत्य युध्यति। आत्मानं यूपमुत्सृज्य स यज्ञोऽनन्तदक्षिणः॥
answer: That king, who, going out, fights his enemies in battles that have arisen for the sake of Brahmanas, and sacrifices his life, is regarded as the embodiment of a sacrifice with endless presents.

question: शक्र उवाच स्वर्गे लोके श्ववतां नास्ति धिष्ण्य मिष्टापूर्ते क्रोधवशा हरन्ति। ततो विचार्य क्रियतां धर्मराज त्यज श्वानं नात्र नृशंसमस्ति॥
answer: Indra said There is no place in the celestial region for persons with dogs. Besides the Krodhavashas take away all the merits of such persons. Thinking of this, acts, O king Yudhishthira the just! Do you abandon this dog. There is no cruelty in this.'

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः कुन्ती भीमसेनमर्जुनं यमजौ तथा। उवाच गमनं ते च तथेत्येवाब्रुवंस्तदा॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon Kunti spoke to Bhimasena, Arjuna and the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva) about the (proposed) journey and they said, “Be it so."

question: लध्वी वसुमती चापि कर्तव्या विष्णुना सह। गृहाणास्त्रं महाबाहो दण्डमप्रतिवारणम्। अनेनास्त्रेण सुमहत् त्वं हि कर्म करिष्यसि॥
answer: The earth shall be lightened of her burden by you along with Vishnu; O large-armed hero, accept this weapon of mine-this mace, incapable of being baffled and with it you will accomplish great deeds.

question: विजयी च रणे नित्यं भैरवास्त्रश्च पाण्डवः। तस्य मार्ग परिहरन् दुतं गच्छ यतव्रत॥
answer: He is ever victorious in battle and possessed of dreadful weapons. Avoiding his path do you repair to Bhishma of regulated vows.

question: अतीव चान्यत् सुमहदाश्चर्यं दृष्टवत्यहम्। यत् स पुष्पाण्युपादाय हस्ताभ्यां ममृदे शनैः॥ मृद्यमानानि पाणिभ्यां तेन पुष्पाणि नान्यथा। भूय एव सुगन्धीनि हृषितानि भवन्ति हि। एतान्यद्भुतलिङ्गानि दृष्ट्वाहं दुतमागता॥
answer: I have marked another wonder, which was extraordinarily great, that he took some flowers in his hands and pressed them slowly. Although these flowers were pressed by him with the hands, yet they, instead of losing their original forms, became more fragrant and beautiful than before. Observing those marks of wonder, I have hastily come here.

question: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्॥ बलिवासवसंवादं पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर।
answer: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Vali and Vasava,OYudhisthira.

question: ततोऽश्वशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तं देवममितौजसम्। लोककर्ता प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा लोकानां हितकाम्यया॥ मूर्ध्वा प्रणम्य वरदं तस्थौ प्राञ्जलिरग्रतः। स परिष्वज्य देवेन वचनं श्रावितस्तदा॥
answer: Seeing the great Deity of immeasurable energy in that form with an equine head, the powerful Brahman, the Creator of all the worlds, moved by the desire of doing good to his Creation, adored that boon-giving Lord with his head down and stood before him with hands joined in respect. The great Deity embraced Brahman and then told him these words.

question: दाशानां भुजवेगेन नद्याः स्रोतोजवेन च। वायुना चानुकूलेन तूर्णं पारमवाप्नुवन्॥
answer: Aided by the strength of arms of the boatmen and by the rapidity of the current and favourable wind, they then speedily reached the opposite bank.

question: समीपं राजसिंहस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः। संकल्पहयसंयुक्तैर्यान्तीमिव मनोरथैः॥
answer: She was proceeding as it were to that lion of a king-Rāma, knowing his own-self, in her mind's chariot drawn by the horses of resolution.

question: अनीकं ये विभिन्दन्ति भिन्न संस्थापयन्ति च। समानाशनपानास्ते कार्याः द्विगुणवेतनाः॥
answer: Those of your warriors who break the ranks of enemies, or rally your retreating soldiers, should have their pay doubled and should be honoured by you with food, drink, and seats equal to your own.

question: स्वकर्मसु प्रवर्तन्ते तुष्टाः स्वैरेव कर्मभिः। आसन्प्रजा धर्मपरा रामे शासति नानृताः॥ सर्वे लक्षणसंपन्नाः सर्वे धर्मपरायणाः। दशवर्षसहस्राणि रामो राज्यमकारयत्॥
answer: The people delighted engaged in their respective works and the subjects grew pious and truthful, under Rāma's regime, and were devoted to the observances of all pious works and gifted with all auspicious marks. And Rāma ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years.

question: तावप्येनं विविधतुर्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः। त्रिभरेव युधामन्युरुत्तमौजास्त्रिभिस्तथा॥
answer: They both in return pierced him each with ten shafts. Then again Yudhamanyu with three and Uttamaujas with another three arrows.

question: मारुद्य संध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशः प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं पिशाच एषोऽशनितुल्यवेगः॥
answer: That one having the vehemence of the thunder-bolt is Pisacha, that, mounted on a steed in variegated golden trappings, and having the aspect of a mass of evening clouds, or a mountain, (appear) with a prāsa furnished with effulgence.

question: तस्मै राजन् सुरेन्द्राय नारदो वदतां वरः। आसीनायोपपन्नाय प्रोक्तवान् विपुलां कथाम्॥
answer: Thus questioned, Narada, that foremost of speakers, O king, then began to recite to the king of the gods the extensive history that follows.

question: पुनश्चेदीदृशीं वाचं मत्समीपे वदिष्यसि॥ शिरस्ते पोथयिष्यामि गदया वज्रकल्पया।
answer: If you again speak such words before re, I shall knock down your head with a mace resembling the bolt of heaven.

question: आदातुं च नरव्याघ्रो यं यमिच्छत्ययं तदा। तस्य विप्लवते बुद्धिरेवं चेदिपतेर्यथा॥
answer: The intelligence of all men whom this best of men (Krishna) desires to take to himself become as perverse as that of this Chedi king.

question: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो नामर्यादः कथंचन। न लुब्धो न च दुःशीलो न च क्षत्रियपांसनः॥
answer: Rāma, the enhancer of Kausalyā's delight had not been abandoned by his father, nor is he devoid of propriety of conduct; he is not avaricious, wicked nor the destroyer of Kaşatriya race.

question: एकः पुत्रो विराटस्य शून्ये संनिहितः पुरे। स एष किल निर्यातो बालभावान्न पौरुषात्॥
answer: Excepting Dhananjaya who, in this world, alone can come to fight with us? Only one son of Virata has been left in the empty city.

question: स तेनाभिहतो वीरो ललाटे द्विजसत्तमः। अशोभत महाराज सशृङ्ग इव
answer: That hero, the best of the twice-born, struck by it on the forehead, shone beautiful as a mountain with its peak.

question: यस्मिन् नित्ये तते तन्तौ दृढे स्रगिव तिष्ठति॥ सदसद्ग्रथितं विश्वं विश्वाङ्गे विश्वकर्मणि।
answer: Having the universe for your work and the universe for your limbs, this universe consisting of mind and matter exists in your eternal and all-pervading soul like flowers strung together in a strong thread.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यौ च स्यातां चरणेनोपपन्नौ यौ विद्यया सदृशौ जन्मना चा मयाचमानाय च याचते च॥।॥
answer: Yudhishthira said To which of two Brahmanas, when both happen to be equally pure in conduct, equally, gifted with learning and purity, of birth and blood, but differing from each other in only this, viz., the one solicits and the other does not-I ask O grandfather, would a gift be more meritorious?

question: अहो भगवतो वीर्यं महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः। राज्ञश्चापि सभार्यस्य धैर्यं पश्यत यादृशम्॥
answer: Great is the energy of the holy Rishi of purified soul! See also the endurance of the king and his royal spouse.

question: रुद्रकोधात् प्रयत्नेन सर्वदेवैः सुरक्षितम्॥ तं यज्ञमदहच्छीघ्रं रुद्रकर्मा सभन्ततः।
answer: Of terrific deeds, those Reings, urged on by Rudra's anger very soon burnt, that Sacrifice although it was protected with great care by all the gods.

question: ततः स राजा दुपदः प्रहृष्टः पुरोहितं प्रेषयामास तेषाम्। विद्याम् युष्मानिति भाषमाणो महात्मानः पाण्डुसुतास्तु कच्चित्॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the king Drupada became exceedingly pleased and he sent to then his priest, directing him to ascertain who they were and whether they were (really) the sons of the illustrious Pandu.

question: मम वा मन्दभाग्यत्वान्मन्दस्ते विक्रमो युधि। धर्मराजप्रियार्थं वा द्रौपद्या वा न विद्म तत्॥
answer: It is either owing to my ill luck or owing to your desire to do good to the Dharmaraj ihat your prowess diminishes in battle, though I do not know what is the true cause.

question: स भवांस्त्रातु नो द्रोणात् सत्याज्ज्यायोऽनृतं वचः। अनृतं जीवितस्यार्थे वदन्न स्पृश्यतेऽनृतैः॥
answer: Save us from Drona; under the circumstances as the present falsehood is better than truth. Speaking falsehood for the sake of saving a life one does not become a sinner.

question: मया विश्राविते वाक्ये जहास धृतराष्ट्रजः। अथ भीष्मः सुसंक्रुद्ध इदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
answer: The one born of Dhritarashtra however laughed at them; and then Bhishma, being excited with wrath, said these words.

question: संजय उवाच इति कर्णस्य वाक्यान्ते शल्यः प्राहोत्तरं वचः। चुकोपयिषुरत्यर्थं कर्ण मद्रेश्वरः पुनः॥
answer: Sanjaya said After Karna had his say, Shalya the king of Madra, with a view to provoke him greatly, said in reply.

question: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ साश्वसूतध्वजरथं शल्यं प्राच्छादयच्छरैः।
answer: Taking up another bow, that great carwarrior, viz., the son of Dharma, covered Shalya, his horses and driver and standard and car, with many arrows.

question: तत्रास्य गाथा गायन्ति ये पुराणविदो जनाः। रन्तिदेवस्य तां दृष्ट्वा समृद्धिमतिमानुषीम्॥
answer: Seeing then the super-human prosperity of king Ratindeva, those that were conversant with the history of past ages sang this song.

question: तूष्णीम्भूतान्यनीकानि योधा युद्धादुपारमन्॥ ददर्श द्वैरथं ताभ्यां जातकौतूहलो जनः।
answer: The troops became silent and warriors withdrew from the fight, filled with curiosity, men began to behold that single combat between those two heroes.

question: स्तैन्यान्निवृत्ताः सततं संतुष्टाः स्वधनेन च॥ स्वभाग्यान्युपजीवन्ति ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः।
answer: Those who abstain from misappropriating others' things, who are perfectly contented with what they themselves possess, and who live depending upon their own destiny, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

question: इत्युक्तस्तारया वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहतम्। मृदुस्वभावः सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः॥
answer: Humbly addressed in these words informed with morality, Sumitra's son, resuming his native mildness, accepted them.

question: तमापतन्तं संप्रेक्ष्य कुम्भकर्ण महाबलम्। उत्पपात तदा वीरः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः। ५१।। स पर्वताग्रमुत्क्षिप्य समाविध्य महाबलः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भकर्ण महाबलम्॥
answer: Seeing the exceeding stout Kumbhakarņa approach, the heroic king of monkeys-Sugriva-sprang up; and taking a mountain-top that one possessed of great strength darted against the mighty Kumbhakarņa.

question: ससागरवना घोरा पृथिवी सचराचरा॥ चचालाथ सनिर्हादा दिशश्चैवाविलाभवन्।
answer: The whole earth, with her forests and seas, with all her mobile and immobile creatures, began to shake and produce a loud noise. All the points of the horizon were covered with darkness.

question: शलभैरिव चाकाशे धाराभिरिव चावृते। अभिमन्योः शरै राजन् न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
answer: Then when the sky was covered with the arrows of Abhimanyu, like the flights of locusts or thick showers of rain, o king, nothing could be distinguished.

question: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते। रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संसर्गमिति जानकी॥ एतत् ते देवि सदृशं पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः। का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद् वचनमीदृशम्॥
answer: The second argument—I shall not touch any other person's body than Rāma's, which you have produced, O Janaki! O you gifted with modesty! truely become you, who are the spouse of that high-souled one. Who else than you, O worshipful one, can give expression to such words?

question: तेषां तु षट् सहस्राणि ये शिखण्डिनमन्वयुः। पुत्रं तु शिशुपालस्य नरसिंहस्य मारिष॥
answer: Of these twelve thousands, six thousand followed Sikhandin. O sire, the son of Shishupala, the foremost of men.

question: तस्य कृद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतनशुबिन्दवः। दीपाभ्यामिव दीप्ताभ्यां साचिषः स्नेहबिन्दवः॥
answer: And from the eyes of that infuriated one fell drops of tears as drop from a flaming lamp drops of burning oil.

question: स मां प्रसाद्य देवेन्द्रः पुनरेवेदमब्रवीत्। यदि देरमवश्यं वै मातङ्गोऽहं महामते॥ भूत्वामृतं प्रदास्यामि भार्गवाय महात्मने। यद्येवं प्रतिगृह्णाति भार्गवोऽमृतमद्य वै॥ प्रदातुमेष गच्छामि भार्गवोऽस्यामृतं विभो। प्रत्याख्यातस्त्वहं तेन दास्यामि न कथंचन॥ स तथा समयं कृत्वा तेन रूपेण वासवः। उपस्थितस्त्वया चापि प्रत्याख्यातोऽमृतं ददत्॥ चाण्डालरूपी भगवान् सुमहांस्ते व्यतिक्रमः। यत् तु शक्यं मया कर्तुं भूय एव तवेप्सितम्॥
answer: The king of the celestials, then comforting me, said, If, Oyou of great intelligence, nectar is to be given to him. I shall then assume the form of a hunter and give it to that great descendant of Bhrigu. If that son of Bhrigu accepts it thus, I then go to him, O lord, for giving it to him! If, however, he sends me away from disregard, I shall not then give it to him by any means.

question: तांस्तु सर्वान् नरव्याघ्रः सैन्धवान् व्यचरत् बली। अलातचक्रवद् राजशरजालैः समार्पयत्॥
answer: The powerful warrior moved a midst that host of enemies with the celerity of a fiery wheel, all the time piercing those warriors with his arrows.

question: दुर्योधन उवाच ततोऽस्त्राणि समस्तानि वरांश्च मनसेप्सितान्॥ लख्वा बहुविधान् रामः प्रणम्य शिरसा भवम्। अनुज्ञां प्राप्य देवेशाजगाम स महातपाः॥
answer: Duryodhana said Thereupon, having obtained all the diverse kinds of weapons and boons desired in his heart, Rama performed the ceremony of bowing down his head to Shiva. Thus having received the command from the lord of the celestials, that great devotee went away.

question: कृतास्त्रं मन्यते बाल आत्मानमविचक्षणः। धार्तराष्ट्रो बलस्थं च पश्यत्यात्मानमातुरः॥
answer: That boy thinks himself wise and a master in the use of weapons, and though the son of Dhritarashtra considers himself strong yet in reality he is weak.

question: रश्मीन् समुत्सृज्य ततो महात्मा रथादवप्लुत्य विराटपुत्रः। वस्त्राण्युपादाय महारथानां तूर्णं पुन: स्वं रथमारुरोह॥
answer: The son of Virata immediately left the rein of his horses and jumped down from chariot. He collected the clothes of those warriors and again rod on his chariot.

question: स्वप्नान्ते निशि राजेन्द्र दर्शयामास रश्मिवान्। कृपया परयाऽऽविष्टः पुत्रस्नेहाच्च भारत॥
answer: The resplendent god, the sun, O king of kings, moved with great kindness consequent on paternal affection, showed himself, at night, in a dream, O Bharata.

question: लोकेषु पाण्डवाश्चैव गताः ख्याति द्विजोत्तम। एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥
answer: The Pandavas also, O best of Brahmanas have acquired great fame. I have these told you all that you had asked me.

question: तत्र ते स्तकृतास्तेन सुमहार्हपरिच्छदाः। उपास्यमानाः पुरुषैरूषुः पुरनिवासिभिः॥
answer: Being served by Purochana and adored by the citizens, they (the Pandavas,) attired in costly robes, lived there.

question: अशक्यं तु तमन्येन द्रोणं मत्वा युधिष्ठिरः। अविषहां गुरुं भारं सौभद्रं समवासृजत्॥
answer: At last regarding Drona to be incapable of being checked by any one else, Yudhishthira placed that unbearable heavy burden on the son of Subhadra.

question: सत्यनामानि पद्मानि स्त्रीणामुक्तानि लक्षणैः। तान्यद्य निहते रामे वितथानि भवन्ति मे॥
answer: Those marks that are pronounced infallible by those versed in such knowledge, on Rama being slain, are nullified in me.

question: महेश्वरच महतां भूतानातीश्वरश्च सः। बहुभिर्बहुधा रूपैर्विश्वं व्याप्नोति वै जगत्॥
answer: He is called Maheshvara and he is the supreme lord superior creatures. In multifarious forms of many kinds, he pervades the universe.

question: तः प्रीतमना भूत्वा स एनां ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। प्रीतोऽस्मि परमं भद्रे परिचारेण ते शुभे॥
answer: That Brahmana, then, with a joyful heart said to her “O gentle and graceful maid, I have been highly pleased with your ministrations.

question: भीष्मः खलु पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया सत्यवतीं मातरमुदवाहयत्; यामाहुर्गन्धकालीति॥
answer: Bhishma, being desirous of doing good to his father, got him married to Satyavati, who was also called Gandhakali.

question: तान् दृष्ट्वाप्रदुतान् संख्ये सात्वतेन शरार्दितान्। प्रभग्नं पुनरेवासीत् तव सैन्यं समाकुलम्॥
answer: Then once more seeing all those heroes routed and afflicted by the scion of the Satvata race, your troops once more began to give way, being overwhelmed with fear.

question: एवमेते महेष्वासास्तावकाः पाण्डवैः सह। समेत्य समरे शूरः सम्प्रहारं प्रचक्रिरे॥
answer: Thus the warriors of your army, all heroic and mighty bow-men, encountering the Pandavas in the battle, began to smite one another down.

question: तथा च शिविरं तेषां द्रौणिराहवदुर्मदः। व्यक्षोभयत राजेन्द्र महाह्रदमिव द्विपः॥
answer: Like an elephant agitating a large lake, Drona's son who cannot be checked in battle, agitated the camp of the Pandavas.

question: गृणीत चापानि महाधनानि शरांश्च शीघ्रं पदवीं चरध्वम्। पुरा हि निर्भर्त्सनदण्डमोहिता प्रमोहचित्ता वदनेन शुष्यता॥ ददाति कस्मैचिदनर्हते तनुं वराज्यपूर्णामिव भस्मनि स्रुचम्। पुरा तुषाग्नाविव हूयते हविः पुरा श्मशाने स्रगिवापविद्ध्यते॥ पुरा च सोमोऽध्वरगोऽवलिाते शुना यथा विप्रजने प्रमोहिते। महत्यरण्ये मृगयां चरित्वा पुरा शृगालो नलिनी विगाहते॥
answer: O warriors gifted with the strength of Indra and highly precious shafts, quickly proceed in quest of her, lest overpowered by ineanness and violence and being beside herself and with a dried mouth, she may give up her person to an unworthy person as the sanctified oblation is thrown into a mass of ashes. Let not the clarified butter be poured into an unigniting fire of paddy chaff and a garland of flowers be thrown into a cremation ground. Let not the Soma juice of a sacrifice be licked up by a dog through the carelessness of the officiating priest. Let not the lily be ruthlessly torn by a jackal walking for its prey in the deep forest.

question: तत्र भारत कर्णेन मातङ्गास्ताडिताः शरैः॥ सर्वतोऽभ्यद्रवन् भीताः कुर्वन्तो महदाकुलम्।
answer: Then, O Bharata, the elephants afflicted by Karna's arrows, bolted with fear and caused great commotion in the battle-field.

question: दास्यामि हि वरं तेऽद्य प्रीतिर्मेपरमा त्वयि। दिष्ट्या बुद्धिश्च ते धर्मे निविष्टा पन्नगोत्तम। भूयो भूयश्च ते बुद्धिर्धर्मे भवतु सुस्थिरा॥
answer: I am highly pleased with you and I shall grant you a boon today. O best of snakes, it is very good that your heart has been set on virtue. Let your heart be more and more firmly set on virtue."

question: जरासंध उवाच न स्मरामि कदा वैरं कृतं युष्माभिरित्युत। चिन्तयंश्च न पश्यामि भवतां प्रति वैकृतम्॥
answer: Jarasandha said I do not recollect when I have ever done you any injury. After careful reflection, I cannot recollect the injury I have done you.

question: सोऽश्वकर्णदुमाशालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान्। अन्यांश्च विविधान्वृक्षानीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे।७५ ।।
answer: In that encounter Nīla discharged Aśvakarņa trees, and sālas, and mangoes in full flower, and also various other trees.

question: ततो भीष्मो महास्त्राणि पातयामास भारत। मोहयन् पाण्डुपुत्राणां व्यूढं सैन्यं महाहवे।॥
answer: Thereupon Bhishma endued with great prowess, discharged powerful weapons that confounded in that fierce encounter the array of troops belonging to the sons of Pandu.

question: विशेषत: सूतपुत्रो राजा चैव सुयोधनः। दुःशासनश्च शकुनिः सौबलश्च महाबलः॥
answer: Especially the son of Suta, king Suyodhana, Dushasana and Shakuni could not at all sleep.

question: वृष्णीनां प्रवरं वीरं शूरं सर्वधनुष्मताम्। रामेण सममस्त्रेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च॥
answer: That foremost hero among the Vrishnis that bravest among all wielders of bow, who is equal to Rama himself in the use of weapons, in glory and in prowess.

question: ततस्तूर्यनिनादाश्च शङ्खानां च सहस्रशः। सिंहनादाश्च संजजुर्भेरीणां च महास्वनाः॥
answer: Then there arose the blare of trumpets and conchs by thousands, as also leonine roars and deafening sounds of drums.

question: न च ते ब्राह्मणं हन्तुं कार्या बुद्धिः कथंचन। अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणो ह्यनलोपमः॥
answer: But let not your heart be ever set on killing a Brahmana. A Brahmana is not to be killed amongst all creatures; he is like the fire.

question: तस्मात् त्वां देवदेवेश लोकार्थं ज्ञापयामहे। रक्ष लोकांश्च देवांश्च शक्रं च महतो भयात्॥
answer: O god of gods, it is for this we tell you what is our present trouble. Save the worlds, the celestials and Indra also from this great fear.

question: विराटदुपदौ चोभौ भीष्मद्रोणसमौ युधि। शङ्खश्चैव महाबाहु डिम्बश्च महाबलः॥
answer: And both of them viz., Virata and Drupada, who are equal to Bhishma and Drona (respective) in battle, and the powerful Shankha and the son of Hidimba of great strength,

question: ततो युधिष्ठिरः कर्णमदूरस्थं निवारितम्। अब्रवीत् परवीरनं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः॥
answer: Thereupon beholding Karna, the slayer of hostile heroes, obstructed at a distance, an Yudhishthira, with eyes reddened with anger, said-

question: अन्नं वै प्रथमं द्रव्यमन्नं श्रीश्च परा मता। अन्नात् प्राणः प्रभवति तेजो वीर्यं बलं तथा॥
answer: Food is, indeed, the first article. Food is considered as the highest prosperity. It is from food that life originates as also energy and prowess and strength.

question: तौ प्रयुद्धौ तदा वीरौ मृधे लक्ष्मणराक्षसौ॥ शरौघानभिवर्षन्तौ जघ्नतुस्तौ परस्परम्। अभीक्ष्णमन्तर्दधतुः शरजालैर्महाबलौ॥ चन्द्रादित्याविवोष्णान्ते यथा मेघैस्तरस्विनौ।
answer: Then there took place an encounter between those heroes in the field, Laksmana and the Räksasa-discharging vollies of shafts and smiting each other; and those mighty and impetuous ones repeatedly covered each other with networks of arrows; like to the sun and the moon covered by clouds at the expiration of Summer.

question: अर्जुनस्तु कटाक्षेण जिह्यं विप्रेक्ष्य पार्षतम्॥ सबाष्यंमतिनिःश्वस्य धिग्धिगित्येव चाब्रवीत्।
answer: But Arjuna only casting side glances at Prisata's son and sighing and shedding copious tears said 'fie, fie.'

question: वासुदेव उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजन् द्विजानां भरतर्षभ। यथा तत्त्वेन वदतो गुणान् वै कुरुसत्तम॥
answer: Vasudeva said Hear me, O king, with attention, O chief of Bharata's race, as I recite to you what the merits of the Brahmanas are, O foremost one of Kuru's race.

question: महासर्पाङ्गदधराश्चित्राभरणधारिणः। रजोध्वस्ताः पङ्कदिग्धाः सर्वे शुक्लाम्बरस्रजः॥
answer: Some had huge snakes for armlets, and some had beautiful ornaments on their body, Some were covered with dust, some with mire, and all were clad in white robes and garment, Some had blue limbs while others had twany limbs. And some were beardless.

question: ध्रुवाय नन्दिने होः गोप्ने विश्वसृजेऽग्नये। महाभाग्यं विभो—हि मुण्डिनेऽथ कपर्दिने॥
answer: Do you discourse the high blessedness of Him who is immutable, who is always cheerful and happy, who is Hotri, who is the universal Protector, who is Creator of the universe, and who is called Mundin and Kaparddin.

question: द्रौणेः सकाशमभ्येत्य रोषात् प्रज्वलिताङ्गदः। प्राह वाक्यमसम्भ्रान्तो वीरं शारद्वतीसुतम्॥ दहन्तं पाण्डवानीकं वनमग्निमिवोच्छ्रितम्।
answer: (Ghatotkacha), the ornaments of whose arms were falling down from rage, came up to the son of Drona who consuming the Pandava army like a raging forest-fire and fearlessly

question: नैवाहं राज्यमिच्छामि न सुखं न च मेदिनीम्। नैव सर्वानिमान् कामान् न स्वर्गं न च जीवितुम्॥
answer: I desire neither dominion, nor happiness, nor the earth, nor any object of enjoyment, nor heaven, nor life.

question: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे बाह्लीके पुरुषर्षभ॥ पुत्रास्तेऽभ्यर्दयन् भीमं दश दशरथेः समाः। नागदत्तो दृढरथो महाबाहुरयोभुजः॥ दृढः सुहस्तो विरजाः प्रमाथ्युग्रोऽनुयाय्यपि।
answer: That foremost of men, the heroic Valhika being (thus) slain, your ten sons, viz., Nagadatta, Dhridaratha, Viravahu, Ayobhuja, Dridha, Suhasta, Viraja, Pramatha and Ugrayayin; (each of whom) resembled the son of Dasharatha (i.e. Rama) began to torment Bhima.

question: गुह्यात्मन् सर्वयोगात्मन् स्फुटं सम्भूतसम्भव। भूताद्य लोकतत्त्वेश जय भूतविभावन॥
answer: O you of mysterious self, O you that are the soul of all Yoga, O you that are the origin of every thing that has sprung into existence, O you that are the knowledge of the souls of every being, O master of the universe, victory be unto you that are the creator of all beings.

question: सम्यगाह गुरुः क्षत्तरुपावर्तय पाण्डवान्। यदि ते न निवर्तन्ते सत्कृता यान्तु पाण्डवाः। सशस्त्ररथपादाता भोगवन्तश्च :॥ पुत्रकाः
answer: Dhritarashtra said O Kshatta (Vidura), the preceptor has said what is true. Go and back the Pandavas. If they do not come back, let them go, but after being treated with respect and affection; let my these children (the Pandavas) go with arms, soldiers and cars, enjoying every good thing.

question: धनुरादाय गाण्डीवं देवदत्तं स वारिजम्। शोशुभ्यमान: कौन्तेय आनुपूर्व्यान्महाभुजः॥ अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि दर्शनायोपचक्रमे। अथ प्रयोक्ष्यमाणेषु दिव्येष्वस्त्रेषु तेषु वै॥
answer: (And)o son of Kunti, the handsome (Dhananjaya) of mighty arms, holding (in his hand) the bow Gandiva, together with the conch presented to him by the celestials, was about to exhibit in due order those celestials weapons. (But) As he commenced to display those heavenly weapons,

question: मूनि चैनमुपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य च बाहुना। आशिषः परमाः प्रोच्य स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत॥
answer: Having locked Arjuna in his affectionate embrace and having smelled the crown of his head and pronouncing best benedictions of

question: सृजत्येष महाबाहो भूतग्रामं चराचरम्। काले विसृजते पुनः॥
answer: O you of mighty arms, it is He who creates all creatures mobile and immobile. In course of Time it is He, again, who withdraws all things and in Time it is He who once more sends them from Himself.

question: उक्तमात्रे त वचने तथा स मृगजीवनः। व्यसुः पपात मेदिन्यामग्निदग्ध इव दुमः॥
answer: No sooner did she utter these words, than that one subsisting on chase, fell down dead on the ground, even as a tree consumed by fire.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच गन्धर्वैस्तु महाराज भग्ने कर्णे महारथे। सम्प्राद्रवच्चमूः सर्वा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : O great king, when the great car-warrior Karna was routed by the Gandharvas, the great army of Dhritarashtra's son fled away in his very sight.

question: अथापश्यद् वरारोहा तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम्। विश्वामित्रं तप्यमानं मेनका भीरुराश्रमे॥
answer: The timid and the beautiful girl then entered the hermitage and saw Vishvamitra, who had destroyed all his sins by penances and who was still engaged in austere penances.

question: उवाच चैनं कल्याण्या वाचा मधुरयोत्थितम्। मा भर्मनुजशार्दूल भद्रमस्तु तवानघ॥
answer: He spoke to him these words, both sweet and beneficial, “O best of men, do not fear, O sinless one,, be blessed."

question: यदलं त्वं समाश्रित्य सीतां मे हृतवानसि। तदर्शय यथाकामं ससैन्यैश्च सबान्धवः॥
answer: That force relying on which you have carried away my Sita, do you as you wish, along with your forces and friends, display the same.

question: अरक्ष्यमाणं हि वृको हन्यात् सिहं महाबलम्। मा सिहं जम्बुकेनेव घातयामः शिखण्डिना॥
answer: Even a highly powerful lion may be killed, if left unprotected, by an wolf. Let us not therefore allow (by any means) Bhishma to be killed by Shikhandin as a lion killed by a jackal. two

question: तमब्रवीन्महातेजा लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः। विमृश्य राघवो वाक्यमिदं स्नेहपुरस्कृतम्॥
answer: Hearing those words the highly powerful Rāghava, in the presence of Lakşmaņa, gave vent to the following accents out of affection.

question: राज्यं शशास धर्मेण प्रजाश्च परिपालयन्॥ पुण्याहवाचने नित्यं धर्मकार्येषु चासकृत्। उत्स्मयन् प्राहसच्चापि दृष्ट्वा राजा पुरोहितम्॥ एवं स बहुशो राजन् पुरोधसमुपाहसत्।
answer: He ruled his kingdom piously and protected and maintained all his subject. Every day, however, the king, seeing his priest on the occasion of receiving benedictions from him as also of the performance of religious and other sacred rites, smiled or laughed loudly. In this way, O king, the reborn Shudra who had become a king, laughed at seeing his priest on numberless occasions.

question: यानीमान्युत्तमानीह वेदोक्तानि प्रशंससि। तेषां श्रेष्ठतरं दानमिति मे नात्र संशयः॥
answer: All those rites laid down in the Vedas which you highly speak of, do not equal a gift for, gift is undoubtedly fraught with very superior merit.

question: नीरजातेन हि बिना न किंचित् सम्प्रवर्तते॥ नीरजातश्च भगवान् सोमो ग्रहगणेश्वरः।
answer: Nothing can exist without the help of what comes from water. The very lord of all the planets, viz., the illustrious Soma, has originated from water.

question: प्रतिकूलितुमिच्छामि न हि वाक्यमिदं त्वया। शापितो मम पादाभ्यां गम्यतां वत्स मा चिरम्॥
answer: That you should act contrary to my words, is what I do not wish. Swearing by my feet, go you without delay, my brother.

question: तस्य शक्त्योपगूढस्य कस्माज्जीवेद् धनंजयः। विजयो मे ध्रुवं राजन् फलं पाणाविवाहितम्॥
answer: How can Dhananjaya escape (after a struggle with) from him who is thus protected; therefore is my victory certain, O king, as a fruit comes within the grasp of my two hands.

question: न हि शक्ष्यामि देवेश प्राणान् प्राणभृतां प्रियान्। हर्तुं विलपमानानामधर्मादभिरक्ष माम्॥
answer: O Lord of the celestials, I shall not be able to destroy the dear lives of living creatures, when they will weep in grief. Save me from unrighteousness.

question: यथेच्छकं स्वयं ब्रूया रथानतिरथांस्तथा। कामद्वेषसमायुक्तो मोहात् प्रकुरुते भवान्॥
answer: Actuated by desire and hatred and acting from ignorance you have enumerated the heroes. O Duryodhana of long arms, it is for you to judge properly. May you fare well.

question: अह्नः परिक्षये ब्रह्मस्ततः साऽचिन्तयत्तदा। वासुकेर्भगिनी भीता धर्मलोपान्मनस्विनी॥
answer: O Brahmana, as the day was fading away, fearing the loss of (Jaratkaru's virtue, the excellent sister of Vasuki grew very anxious.

question: आर्तहस्तप्रदो नित्यं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। सत्यः सत्यानि कुरुते नित्यं यः सुखदर्शनः॥
answer: He should interfere for removing the sorrows of the distressed, and should always rightcously cherish and protect his subjects. He should be truthful, and do all true works, and seek happiness in conduct like this.

question: कृत्वावश्यकार्याणि समाश्वस्य च भारत। योगमाज्ञापयामासुयुद्धाय च विनिर्ययुः॥ ते
answer: Having finished all the necessary ceremonies and consoled themselves, they, O Bharata, ordered for the array of soldiers and then started for battle.

question: अर्जुन उवाच त्वत्तोऽस्त्रेण वृणोम्यश्वान् संयोगः शाश्वतोऽस्तु नौ सखे तद् ब्रूहि गन्धर्व युष्मभ्यो यद् भयं भवेत्।।५८।
answer: Arjuna said : O Gandharva, I shall take your horses in exchange of my weapon. Let our friendship be ever-lasting. O friend, tell me that from which the danger of ours (human beings) arises from the Gandharvas.

question: स च नास्मासु कृतवान् मनो वीर कथंचन। नाकम्पत महातेजाः स्थितस्तपसि निर्मले।॥
answer: But he did not set his mind on us even for a moment. O best of the Kshatriyas, his mind, । being fixed on the meditation of the pure, the greatly effulgent (Brahmana), did not suffer his heart to waver.

question: विदुरस्त्वथ पाण्डूनां सदा दर्शनलालसः। जगामैकरथेनैव काम्यकं वनमृद्धिमत्॥
answer: Vidura, ever longing to see the Pandavas went (alone) in a single car to the forest of Kamyaka abounding in every good thing.

question: अस्त्राणि मे प्रनष्टानि विविधानि महामुने॥ शराश्च क्षयमापन्नाः क्षणेनैव समन्ततः।
answer: O great ascetic, my weapons of various kinds failed to appear. Soon, again, my arrows became exhausted.

question: बलैः समग्रैर्युधि मां रावणं जित्य संयुगे। विजयी स्वपुरं यायात् तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्॥
answer: But if (Rāma) himself together with all his forces, conquering Ravana and (recovering me) in battle, returned victorious to his own city, this would be worthy of himself.

question: विसृज्य सुहृदः सर्वान् भ्रातृन् पुत्रांश्च धर्मराट्। मुमोद पुरुषव्याघ्रो द्रौपद्या सहितो नृप।॥ केशवोऽपि मुदा युक्तः प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम्। पूज्यमानो यदुश्रेष्ठस्यसेनमुखैस्तथा॥
answer: That virtuous king, that best of men (Yudhishthira) then sent away all his friends and relatives, his brothers and sons; he then amused himself with Draupadi.

question: स्वर्गे लोके महीयन्तमप्सरोभिः शचीपतिम्। ऋषयः पर्युपासन्ते देवाश्च विबुधेश्वरम्॥
answer: The lord of Shachi is worshipped in the heaven by the Apsaras. The Rishis and the other gods all adore himn with respect.

question: तव चैव गुणैर्बद्धस्त्ववियोगान्महीपतिः। राजा देवत्वमापन्नो भरतस्य यथा श्रुतम्॥
answer: As I have heard from Bharata, king Dasaratha died for your separation, attached as he was to you for your accomplishments.

question: समन्तात् कीर्यमाणस्तु बाणसंधैर्महात्मभिः॥ न चचाल महाराज सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः।
answer: Though struck thus from all sides with numerous arrows by those illustrious warriors, Duryodhana still, O king, did not waver, in the presence of all the soldiers assembled there.

question: निर्दहन्निव चक्षुर्त्या पार्षतं सोऽभ्यवेक्षत॥ छादयामास च शरैर्नि:श्वसन् पन्नगो यथा।
answer: (And) as if to burn the son of Prishata with his eyes, he gazed at him. Heaving sighs like a snake he covered (Dhristadyumna with arrows) in that battle.

question: क्षत्रियस्य प्रमत्तस्य दोषः संजायते महान्। अधर्माः सम्प्रवर्धन्ते प्रजासंकरकारकाः॥
answer: If a king acts heedlessly, it produces a great evil. Unrighteousness multiplies causing an intermixture of castes.

question: अहं च संशयं प्राप्तः कृच्छ्रामापदमास्थितः। मातापितृभ्यां हि विना नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
answer: And (on account of which) I also placed in this critical position am filled with anxiety. Without my parents I do not care to bear life.

question: मृत्युर्वा रक्षणं वेति यस्य राज्ञो विनिश्चयः। प्राणद्यूते ततस्तस्य ब्रह्माश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
answer: That king, who fights with the object of protecting his kingdom or meeting with death, attains to the object of the Vanaprastha mode of life.

question: विश्वकृद् विश्वकृतां वरेण्यस्त्वं विश्ववाहो विश्वरूपस्तेजस्वी विश्वतोमुखः। चन्द्रादित्यौ चक्षुषी ते हृदयं च पितामहः॥ महोदधिः सरस्वती वाग् बलमनलोऽनिल: अहोरात्रं निमेषोन्मेषकर्म॥
