answer: You are Prajapati, and you are worshipped by the Patriarchs, you are the supporter of the universe, you have the universe for your form, you are gifted with great energy, and you have faces turned towards all directions. The Sun and the Moon are your two eyes, and the Grandfather is your heart. You are the Ocean. The goodess of learning is your speech, Fire and Wind are your might. You are Day and Night. You are all acts including the opening and the shutting of the eye.

question: सध्वजाः सपताकाश्च सशरासनतोमराः। रज्जुभिश्च विचित्राभिः सपाशाः सपरिच्छदाः॥
answer: With flags and banners, with huge arrows, and bows and bowstrings and diverse suites of ropes, with nooses and lashes;

question: एतेभ्यश्चाप्रमत्तः स्यात् सदा शत्रोर्युधिष्ठिर। भारुण्डसदृशा ह्येते निपतन्ति प्रमादतः॥
answer: The king, O Yudhishthira, should always be careful of his subjects as also of his eremies. If he becomes careless, they attack him like vultures.

question: इत्यक्तुवा सह सौमित्रिरुपस्पृश्याथ राघवः। प्रतिशिश्ये जलनिधिं विधिवत् कुशसंस्तरे॥
answer: Saying this, the descendant of Raghu together with the son of Sumitra performed achamana (i.e. touched water thrice as a purifactory ceremony) and duly laid themselves down on a bed of Kusha grass on the sea-shore.

question: कथेयमभवत् तत्र त्वया या परिकीर्तिता। सुमनोधूपदीपानां सम्प्रदाने फलं प्रति॥ ततः पप्रच्छ दैत्येन्द्रः कवीन्द्रं प्रश्नमुत्तमम्॥
answer: This very subject which you have introduced regarding the merits of the gift of flowers and incense and lamps, came up on the occasion. Indeed the king of the Daityas put this high question of Shukra that most learned of all ascetics.

question: इदमत्यद्भुतं भीरु यतो जातोऽस्मि भाविनी। दृष्टवान् देवगर्भोऽयं मन्येऽस्मान् समुपागतः॥
answer: "O timid lady, since my very birth I have never witnessed such a marvel. I think, this boy that has come to us, is begotten by a celestials,

question: एवमुक्त्वा तव पिता तूष्णीमासीद् विशाम्पते। व्यसर्जयच्च राजान शयनं च विवेश ह॥
answer: Having spoken thus, O ruler of men, your father became silent; and dismissing the king, he entered his own tent.

question: तत् खलु द्विविधं सुखमुच्यते शारीरं मानसं च। इह खल्वमुष्मिश्च लोके वस्तुप्रवृत्तयः सुखार्थमभिधीयन्ते। न ह्यतः परं त्रिवर्गफलं विशिष्टतरमस्ति स एव काम्यो गुणविशेषो धर्मार्थगुणारम्भस्तद्धेतुरस्योत्पत्ति: सुखप्रयोजनार्थ आरम्भः॥
answer: Happiness is of two sorts, viz., physical and mental. The visible and invisible fruits of action, both this and the other world, are described for the sake of happiness. There is nothing more important than happiness among the fruits of the threefold objects of life. Happiness is desirable. It is an attribute of the Soul. Both virtue and Profit are sought for it. Virtue is its origin. This, indeed is its origin. The end of all acts is the attainment of happiness.

question: ततः परीक्षामश्वानां चक्रे राजन् स बाहुकः। अश्वशालामुपागम्य भागासुरिनृपाज्ञया॥
answer: O king, thereupon Bahuka went, at the behest of the royal son of Vangasura, to the stables; and there he examined the horses.

question: प्राणदद् भैरवं नादं प्रावृषीव बलाहकः॥ अब्रवीच ततो राजन् दुर्योधनमिदं वचः।
answer: Then like clouds during the rainy season, he uttered a tremendous roar; and then O king,

question: तस्य तेनावकीर्णस्य शरजालेन सर्वतः। मोहात् पपात गाण्डीवमावापश्च करादपि।॥
answer: Overwhelmed by that dense cloud of arrows, Arjuna became stupefied. The bow, Gandiva, fell down from his relaxed grip and his leathern hence also dropped down.

question: ततोऽर्जुनः क्षिप्रमिहापयातु श्रुत्वा मृतान् यादवान् ब्रह्मशापात्। इत्येवमुक्तः स ययौ रथेन कुरुस्तदा दारुको नष्टचेताः॥
answer: Let Arjuna come here speedily hearing of the destruction of the Yadavas though the Brahmanas' course.' Thus addressed Daruka, deprived of his senses by sorrow, proceeded on a car to the capital of the Kurus.

question: स क्षत्रियाणां शेषार्थं करेणोद्दिश्य कश्यपः॥ स्रुक्प्रग्रहवता राजंस्ततो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत्। गच्छ तीरं समुद्रस्य दक्षिणस्य महामुने॥ न ते मद् विषये राम वस्तव्यमिह कर्हिचित्।
answer: For preserving the residence of the Kshatriyas, Kashyapa, O king, pointing with his hand that still held the sacrificial ladle, said these words,-Ogreat sage, go to the shores of the southern ocean. You should not, O Rama, live within my kingdom.

question: एवं बहुविधं भूरि विललाप स लुब्धकः। गार्हयन् स्वानि कर्माणि द्विजं दृष्ट्वा तथागतम्॥
answer: Indeed, seeing the bird lay down his life, the fowler, considering his own acts, began to bewail thus piteously.

question: सोऽस्मि कृष्ण तथा जातः पाण्डोः पुत्रोऽस्मि धर्मतः। कुन्त्या त्वहमपाकीर्णो यथा न कुशलं तथा॥
answer: O Krishna, in this way was I born and I am therefore morally the son of Pandu. I was however left destitute by Kunti who thought not of my welfare,

question: तथार्धचन्द्रेण शिरस्तस्य चिच्छेद पाण्डवः। स पपात हतो म्लेच्छस्तेनैव सह दन्तिना॥
answer: So again, the son of Pandu severed the head (of his antagonist) with a crescent shaped arrow. That Mlechchha, being thus cut-off, fell down with his elephant.

question: ततः परिवृतो ब्रह्मा हरिणा वेदसत्कृतः। निर्ममे स तदा लोकान् कृत्स्नान् स्थावरजङ्गमान्॥
answer: Helped then by Hari and assisted by the Vedas, Brahman created all worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

question: दत्त्वा धेनुं सुव्रता कांस्यदोहां कल्याणवत्सामलायिनी च। स्तावद् वर्षाण्यश्नुते स्वर्गलोकम्॥
answer: The kine, given away, should be accompanied by their calves. They should, again, be such as to bring forth good calves at the proper They should be accompanied with other articles. Having completed the gift, the giver should live for three days on only milk and abstaining from food of every other kind.

question: काञ्चने लोष्ठभावे च समदर्शी महातपाः। देवानपूजयन्नित्यमतिथींश्च द्विजैः सह॥ ब्रह्मचर्यरतो नित्यं सदा धर्मपरायणः।
answer: The great ascetic looked with an equal eye upon gold and pebbles. He daily worshipped the gods and guests and the Brahmanas. Righteous himself he always practised the vow of Brahmacharya

question: अभिगम्य च राजानमवदत् स्वं प्रयोजनम्। देहि मे खल्विमा राजन् क्षत्रियाय महात्मने॥
answer: Going to the king, he told him what he desired, saying, “O king, give your daughter to son of an illustrious Kshatriya.

question: अगस्त्य उवाच वित्तकामानिह प्राप्तान् विद्धि नः पृथिवीपते। यथाशक्त्यविहिंस्यान्यान् संविभागं प्रयच्छ नः॥
answer: Agastya said: O ruler of earth, know, that I have come to you for wealth. Give me a portion of your wealth according to your ability.

question: उपायं कर्मसिद्धौ च भगवन् वक्तुमर्हसि। निवारयेयं येनेन्द्रं वर्षमाणं महावने॥
answer: O illustrious one, you should give us the means by which we may gain success; and we can prevent Indra from pouring rains on that extensive forest.

question: चिरं गतं पुन: कन्या पित्रे तं संन्यवेदयत्। विप्रेण पुनराहूतो विद्यया गुरुदेहजः। पुनरावृत्य तद् वृत्तं न्यवेदयत तद् यथा॥
answer: Finding him again late in coming home, that maiden again told her father what had happened. Having been again summoned by that Brahmana (Shukra) to come home, Kacha appeared before the daughter of his preceptor. He again repeated to her all that had happened to him.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच धनंजयवचः श्रुत्वा वैराटिस्त्वरितस्ततः। हयान् रजतसंकाशान् हेमभाण्डानचोदयत्॥
answer: Hearing the words of Arjuna, Virata's son, without loss of time, urged his silver white steeds decked in golden armour.

question: महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना। हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा पहात्मना॥
answer: A sinful wretch and of wicked soul, you had obtained the kingdom of the monkeys through the agency of the eminently virtuous, kind and high-souled Rāma.

question: विशेषयिष्यशिष्यं च द्रोणो राजन् पराक्रमी। अदृश्यमर्जुनं चक्रे निमेषाच्छरवृष्टिभिः॥
answer: Thus, O monarch, the puissant Drona, worsting his disciple within a moment, caused Arjuna to disappear from the view, with his arrowy showers.

question: तानि सूक्ष्माणि सत्त्वानि विमुक्तानि शरीरतः। स्वेन सत्त्वेन सत्त्वज्ञाः पश्यन्ति नियतेन्द्रियः॥
answer: All those souls again that are encased in subtile forins after being alienated from the gross bodies in which they lived, are perceptible to Yogins, who have controlled their senses and who are gifted with knowledge of the soul. Indeed, helped by their own souls, Yogins see those invisible beings,

question: दश चिक्षेप च शरान् द्रोणस्य वधकाङ्क्षया। शक्तिं च दुपदो घोरामायसी स्वर्णभूषिताम्॥ चिक्षेप भुजगेन्द्राभां क्रुद्धो द्रोणरथं प्रति। ततो भल्लैः सुनिशितैश्छित्त्वा तांस्तोमरान् दश॥
answer: As also ten shafts at Drona, with a view to encompass his slaughter. Drupada also, equally enraged, hurled at the car of Drona, a dreadful dart made wholly of iron and decked with gold and effulgent like the body of a excellent snake. Then cutting off with a well-sharpened bhalla those tomaras.

question: त्वमस्य ब्रह्मलाभस्य दुर्वारस्यानिवर्तिनः। सत्त्वनेमिनिरुद्धस्य चक्रस्यैकः प्रवर्तकः॥
answer: You are indeed the one person for setting this wheel in motion, this wheel that has the quality of Goodness for its circumference, Brahma for its nave, and the understanding for its spokes, and which never turns back!

question: गङ्गायमुनयोस्तीर्थे तथा कालञ्जरे गिरौ। दशाश्वमेधानाप्नोति तत्र मासं कृतोदकः॥
answer: Bathing in the confluence of the Ganga and the Yamuna as also at the tirtha in the Kalanjara mountains and offering every day oblations of water to the departed manes for a full month, one acquires the merit of ten Horsesacrifices.

question: व्यवहारोऽत्र कात्स्येन धर्मार्थीयः प्रकीर्तितः। विविधानां च दानानां फलयोगाः प्रकीर्तिताः॥
answer: It then treats of the rules Dharma and Artha in detail, then the various rules of charity and its different merits.

question: नानारूपविकाराश्च नानाकवचशस्त्रिणः। पदातिनो नरास्तत्र बभूवुर्हेममालिनः॥
answer: sena There were also in that army, hundreds of thousands of infantry decked with gold, clad in diverse sorts of arms and diverse temper.

question: तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य संग्रामः सुमहानभूत्। बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवर्ष च वर्षताम्॥
answer: And each party approaching the other, great was the encounter that took place. And innumerable (monkeys and Rākṣasas) kept showering rocks and arrows.

question: तमिमं समुपातिष्ठ धर्मं कुरुकुलोचितम्। अनुरूपं महाबाहो पूर्वेषामात्मनः कुरु॥
answer: Therefore, follow the practice that is worthy of the Kuru race. O mighty-armed hero, act as your forefathers did before you.

question: दुर्योधनो भीमसेनमभ्यगच्छन्मनस्विनम्। पश्यतां कुरुमुख्यानां तस्य द्रक्ष्यति यत् फलम्॥
answer: In the presence of the chiefs among the Kurus he will see what the consequences of that will be. Vrikodara having once been made an enemy cannot make peace.

question: इदं वृत्तं मनुष्येषु वर्तते यो महीपतिः। उभौ लोकौ विनिर्जित्य विजये सम्प्रतिष्ठते॥
answer: That king, who deals with men in such a way, succeeds in subjugating both the worlds and enjoy the fruits of victory.

question: वासुदेव उवाच युधिष्ठिरं धर्मनिधि पुरुहूतपिवेश्वरः। उपमन्युर्मयि प्राह तपन्निव दिवाकरः॥ अशुभैः पापकर्माणो ये नराः कलुषीकृतः। ईशानं न प्रपद्यन्ते तमोराजसवृत्तयः॥
answer: Vasudeva said Upamanyu, who appeared to shine like the sun, said to me Those sinful men who are sullied with impious deeds, do not succeed in attaining to Ishana. Having their nature sullied by the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance they can never approach the Supreme Deity. It is only those twiceborn persons who are of purified souls that succeed in attaining to the Supreme Deity.

question: व्यास उवाच मा विषादं कृथा राजन् क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्। स्वधर्मेण हता ह्येते क्षत्रियाः क्षत्रियर्षभ॥
answer: Vyasa said, Remembering the duties of a Kshatriya, O king, do not indulge in grief! All those Kshatriyas, O foremost of Kshatriyas, have been killed while following their legitimate duties.

question: तं भूमौ देवसंकाशं पतितं दृश्य राघवम्। अभिपेतुः समुत्पत्य सर्वतः कपिसत्तमाः॥
answer: Seeing the god-like Råghava down on the earth, the foremost monkeys from all sides rushed forward and came to where (he was).

question: उत्तिष्ठ भगवन् क्षिप्रं प्रविश्याभ्यन्तरं गृहम्। द्रष्टुमर्हसि धर्मज्ञ मातरं पितरं च मे॥
answer: O exalted one, arise, soon enter this inner apartment. O virtuous one, you should see (first) my father and my mother.

question: अनागतं यन्न ममेति विद्यादतिक्रान्तं यन्न ममेति विद्यात्। दिष्टं बलीय इति मन्यमार्ना स्ते पण्डितास्तत्सतां स्थानमाहुः॥
answer: Future acquisitions should be considered by one as not one's own. Lost properties, should also be regarded by one as not his own. Destiny should be deemed as all powerful. They who think in this wise are considered wise. This mood of regarding all things is an attribute of the good.

question: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलो द्रोणसात्वतयोरभूत्। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां बलिवासवयोरिव॥
answer: Then a fierce fight commenced between Drona and him of the Satvata race, before the very eyes of all the troops-fight that resembled that between Bali and Vasava fought in the day's of yore.

question: लाक्षया मधुमांसेन लोहेन च विषेण च। सदैव बिभृयाद् भृत्यान् यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
answer: May he that had approved the exile of the noble one into the woods always feed his family with lac, honey, meat, iron, and poison!

question: बाह्रीकद्रोणभीष्माणां कर्णस्य च महात्मनः। जयद्रथस्य शूरस्य भगदत्तस्य चोभयोः॥ मद्रराजस्य शल्यस्य भूरिश्रवस एव च। पुत्राणां भरतश्रेष्ठ शकुनेः सौबलस्य च॥ मित्राणां सुहृदां चैव बान्धवानां तथैव च।
answer: Today I shall release myself from the debt I woe to the many illustrious Kshatriyas, to Valhika and Drona and Bhishma and the great Karna, to the heroic Jayadratha and Bhagadatta, to Shalya the ruler of the Madras and Bhurishravas, to my sons, O best of Bharata's race and Shakuni the son of Subala, to all my friends and well-wishers and relatives.

question: निदेशवर्तिनः सर्वे सर्वे गुरुहिते स्थिताः। अभिप्रेतमनुष्ठातुं तव शक्ष्यन्त्यरिंदम॥
answer: All abide by your command all are intent upon the welfare of their master, and, O subduer of foes, they are competent to bring about your end.

question: न हि धर्मविभागज्ञः कुर्यादेवं धनंजय। यथा त्वं पाण्डवाद्येह धर्मभीरुरपण्डितः॥
answer: O Dhananjaya, those who are versed in the niceties of religion would never act in the way as you are doing today, O pious son of Pandu, on not being acquainted with them.

question: ये हि निष्कलुषा लोके पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः। तेषां वै क्षेममध्वानं गच्छतां द्विजसत्तम॥
answer: The path that is theirs, O foremost of twiceborn ones, that are stainless and that are freed from both virtue and sin, is fraught with auspiciousness and happiness.

question: पदातिगणसंयुक्तस्रस्तो राजन् भयादितः। उलूकः प्राद्रवत् तत्र दृष्ट्वा द्रोणं निपातितम्॥
answer: Beholding Drona slain, Uluka, filled with fear and with his infantry divisions, fled away in great speed.

question: यथाहं त्वदृते वीर नान्यं स्वप्नेऽप्यचिन्तयम्। तथा मे देवनिर्दिष्टस्त्वमेव हि पतिर्भव॥
answer: As, O hero, I have thought of no other person than you even in my dreams, so you only be my husband as ordained by the gods."

question: अपरेऽवस्थितास्तत्र युद्धायाभिमुखास्तदा। ततः स्थाणुर्महाराज शूलधृक् क्रोधमूर्छितः॥
answer: Then others also took their stations there in his front with the object of battle. Upon this Sthanu, O mighty monarch, that wielder of the trident, became senseless with rage.

question: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च। यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
answer: O dignified one, I shall unfold to you potent and probable reasons why the brothers Rāma and Laksmana live.

question: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आचार्ये निहते द्रोणे धृष्टद्युम्नेन संयुगे। निहते वज्रहस्तेन यथा वृत्रे महासुरे॥
answer: Yudhishthira said Upon the slaughter of the preceptor Drona by Dhristadyumna like the slaughter of the mighly Asura Vrita by the wielder of thunderbolt.

question: स्कन्द उवाच सप्तमं मारुतस्कन्धं पालयिष्याम्यहं प्रभो। यदन्यदपि में कार्यं देव तद् वद माचिरम्॥
answer: O lord, very well, I shall command, the seventh army corps. Now tell me soon if I am to do any thing else.

question: मन्ये साभरणा सुप्ता सीतास्मिशयने शुभा। तत्र तत्र हि दृश्यन्ते सक्ताः कनकबिन्दवः॥
answer: I think that the graceful Sītā adorned with ornaments slept in this bed, for here and there are scattered particles of gold.

question: नागैरिव महानागा यथावद् गिरिहरे। तेऽपि प्रासैः सुनिशितैः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
answer: Like huge elephants falling down in mountain caves, slain by their compeers. Those warriors of the Pandava, army also with sharp lances and straight shafts,

question: तेषामेवंप्रभावाणां युष्माकं राक्षसर्षभाः॥ कथं भयमसंबुद्धं मानुषादिदमागतम्।
answer: O you foremost of the Rākşasas, how could this fear from man overwhelm you all who were so powerful.

question: म्लेच्छाचाराः सर्वभक्षा दारुणाः सर्वकर्मसु। भाविनः पश्चिमे काले मुनष्या नात्र संशयः॥
answer: When this age will come, men will certainly adopt the Mlechchha conduct; they will eat all things; they will be free in all their all acts.

question: अभ्यधावन् सुसंक्रुद्धाः सौभद्रमपराजितम्। ते तु पौत्रेण ते राजन प्रायशो विमुखीक़ताः॥
answer: All these warriors excited with rage rushed against the invincible son of Subhadra. Then those warriors also, O king, were almost beat back by your grandson (Abhimanyu).

question: तथा मन्त्रविदो विप्रास्तपस्तप्त्वा सुदुष्करम्। गुरूनभ्युपगच्छन्ति यशसोऽर्थाय भाविनि॥
answer: O handsome lady, Brahmanas, learned in Mantras, after having acquired ascetic merits most difficult to be achieved, still go to their preceptors for fame.

question: न्यमन्त्रयत चाप्येनां सा चाप्यैच्छदनिन्दिता। तौ तत्र सुचिरं कालमुभौ व्यहरतां तदा॥ रममाणौ यथाकामं यथैकदिवसं तथा। जनयामास स मुनिर्मेनकायां शकुन्तलाम्॥ प्रस्थे हिमवतो रम्ये मालिनीमभितो नदीम्। जातमुत्सृज्य तं गर्भ मेनका मालिनीमनु॥ कृतकार्या ततस्तूर्णमगच्छच्छक्रसंसदम्। तं वने विजने गर्भ सिंहव्याघ्रसमाकुले॥ दृष्ट्वा शयानं शकुनाः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। नेमां हिंस्युर्वने बालां क्रव्यादा मांसगृद्धिनः॥
answer: He invited her to come to him and that faultless featured beauty too accepted his invitation. They then passed many days in each others' company. Sporting with each other, they passed many years and thought that it was but only a day. That Rishi begot Shakuntala on her. Menaka went to the banks of the river Malini which passed playfully through the beautiful valley of the Himalaya mountains and there she gave birth to a daughter. She then left the child there (on the banks of the river) and went away. Thus having been successful in her mission, she soon returned to Indra. Some vultures, seeing that the child lay in the deep forest abounding in lions and tigers, sat round it to protect it from harm, so that no carnivorous animals might take her life.

question: नेहतं दूषणं दृष्ट्वा रणे त्रिशिरसा सह। खरस्याप्यभवत् त्रासो दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम्॥
answer: Seeing Düşaņa slain in fight along with Trisiră, Khara, witnessing Rāma's prowess, was filled with fear.

question: न माया हीन्द्रजालं वा कुहका वापि भीषणा। आत्तशस्त्रस्य संग्रामे वहन्ति प्रतिगर्जनाः॥
answer: Neither deception, nor illusion, nor the trick of a conjurer is frightful to one who has taken up arms for fight, these only tend to excite his anger.

question: प्रध्याय सोऽसृजन्मेघांस्तथा स्थावरजङ्गमान्। पृथिवीं सोऽसृजद् विश्वां सहितां भूरितेजसा॥
answer: After meditation he also created the clouds, and all the immobile and mobile objects. Highly energetic he also created the Vishvas and the Earth with all things upon her.

question: रेमे स तस्यां राजर्षिः प्रभावत्यां यथा रविः। स्वाहायां च यथा वह्निर्यथा शच्यां च वासवः॥
answer: The royal Rishi than spotted with her as Ravi (the son) with Prabhavati, as Agni (fire) with Svaha, and as Vasava (Indra) with Sachi;

question: ततो जलात् समुत्तीर्य कन्यास्ताः सहितास्तदा। वस्त्राणि जगृहुस्तानि यथासन्नान्यनेकशः॥ तत्र वासो देवयान्याः शर्मिष्ठा जगृहे तदा। व्यतिमिश्रमजानन्ती दुहिता वृषपर्वणः॥
answer: The maidens, after rising from the water all together, put on the clothes which each got near her from the mixed up heap. The cloth of Devayani was thus taken up and worn by Sharmishtha, the daughter of king Vrishaparva, not knowing that it belonged to others.

question: क्रुद्धाशीविषसंकाशान् सुकुमारान् सुखोचितान्। एकेन निहतान् दृष्ट्वा भीतो दुर्योधनोऽभवत्॥
answer: Beholding those young and delicate heroes reared up with all possible care and resembling furious snakes of virulent poison, slain by the single-headed son of Subhadra, Duryodhana became filled with fear.

question: भृगुरुवाच स्वधर्माचरणे युक्ता ये भवन्ति मनीषिणः। तेषां स्वर्गफलावाप्तिर्योऽन्यथा स विमुह्यते॥
answer: Bhrigu said The wise men who are engaged in performing the duties laid down for them, acquires heaven as their reward. By doing otherwise people are sullied with the sin of folly.

question: ततस्तान् भेदयित्वा तु परस्परविवक्षितान्। भुजीत सान्त्वयंश्चैव यथासुखमयत्नतः॥
answer: Creating dissensions among the common people who are to carry the burdens, the king should himself come forward to conciliate them and then enjoy happily what he would draw from them.

question: अनन्तरत्नान्यादाय स जहार महाक्रतून्। सुषाव च बहून् सोमान् सोमसंस्थास्ततान च॥
answer: Collecting jewels and precious stones, he performed afterwards great sacrifices. Extracting a large quantity of Soma juice, he performed (the great sacrifice) Soma Sanstha.

question: दिव्या पुण्योदका रम्या हिमवन्तमुपाश्रिता। लोकस्य हितकार्यार्थं प्रवृत्ता भगिनी मम॥
answer: And in order to compass the welfare of all creatures, my sister is now a noble and charming river of sacred waters, issuing from the Himavat mountains.

question: ततस्तु रामो महता बलेन प्रच्छाद्य सर्वां पृथिवीं महात्मा। प्रहृष्टरूपोऽभिजगाम लङ्कां कृत्वा मतिं सोऽरिवधे महात्मा॥
answer: Then, environed by a mighty host, the highsouled and magnanimous Rāma, his features mirroring forth high exultation, overshadowing the entire Earth (with his forces), set out for Lankā, determined upon destroying the enemy.

question: न मामसज्जनेनार्या समानयितुमर्हति। धर्माद् विचलितुं नाहमलं चन्द्रादिव प्रभा॥
answer: The worshipful one ought not to place me on the same footing with unrighteous persons. As brightness does not depart from the moon, so I cannot swerve from virtue.

question: तं दृष्ट्वा च सुसूक्ष्मेण रूपेणावस्थितं प्रभुम्। सूक्ष्मरूपधरा देवी बभूवोपश्रुतिश्च सा॥
answer: Beholding there Indra in a form of very minute, goddesses Upashruti and Indrani also became in the form of minuteness.

question: वैशम्पायन उवाच काम्यकं प्राप्य कौरव्य युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमाः। कृतातिथ्या मुनिगणैनिषेदुः सह कृष्णया॥
answer: Vaishampayana said : Arriving at (the forest of) Kamyaka and being hospitably received by the saints, Yudhishthira and the other Pandavas began to dwell there with Krishna.

question: पाञ्चालानां ततः सेनामुद्भूतार्णवनिःस्वनाम्। भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः॥ प्रविवेश महासेनां मकरः सागरं यथा। स्वयमभ्यद्रवद् भीमो नागानीकं गदाधरः॥
answer: As a Makara enters the sea, so the mightyarmed Yama-like Bhima with his club in his hand entered the Panchala ranks and roared as fiercely as the ocean in a tempest. Ever skillful in battle, Bhima, the son of Pritha, upraising his club, attacked the soldiers riding on elephants with the powers of his arms like the great destroyer himself.

question: अवराणां समानानां शिष्याणां च समाचरेत्। पापमाचक्षते नित्यं हृदयं पापकर्मिणः॥
answer: Such a word can be used to those who are inferior, or equal, or to disciples. A sinful man always speaks of the sins he has committed.

question: अथास्य चर्माप्रतिमं न्यकृन्त भीमो महात्मा नवभिः पृषत्कैः। खड्गं च भल्लैर्निचकर्त मुष्टौ नदन् प्रहृष्टस्तव सैन्यमध्ये॥
answer: Then the illustrious Bhima cut off the ten arrows the matchless shield of that hero. With another broad-headed arrow he cut off the sword also of that warrior. Filled with joy at this, he cried aloud in the midst of the army.

question: सत्ये धर्मे च निरतस्तस्य शक्र फलं शृणु। गोसहस्रेण समिता तस्य धेनुर्भवत्युत॥
answer: Hear, O Shakra, of the fruits which truthful persons enjoy. If such a person gives away a single cow, that becomes thousandfold.

question: स हि देवोऽत्यगाद् देवांस्तपसा विक्रमेण चा तस्माच्छरणमभ्येमि गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्॥
answer: In ascetic practices and power, he far! excells all the gods. I shall, therefore, seek refuge with Girisha armed with trident.'

question: इत्येवं बाधमानस्तु पार्थिवान्पार्थिवर्षभ। चचार रावणो राम पृथिवीं पृथिवीपते॥ ततो माहिष्मती नाम पुरीं स्वर्गपुरीप्रभाम्। संप्राप्तो यत्र सांनिध्यं सदासीद्वसुरेतसः॥ तुल्य आसीन्नृपस्तस्य प्रभावाद्वसुरेतसः। अर्जुनो नाम यत्राग्निः शरकुण्डेशयः सदा॥
answer: O Rāma, O lord of earth, traversing the earth, Rāvana arrived at the city of Māhismatī, resembling the city of the celestials, where lived perpetually the deity of fire. There reigned a king named Arjuna, effulgent like fire which was kept perpetually in a well covered with Sara.

question: वामे स्कन्धे तु वामोरूर्भर्तुर्बाहुं निवेश्य च। दक्षिणेन परिष्वज्य जगाम गजगामिनी॥
answer: Then that lady of fair thighs, placing her husband's left hand on her left shoulder and embracing him by her right hand proceeded slowly like an elephant.

question: किं नु वक्ष्यति राजासौ किं भीष्मः प्रतिवक्ष्यति। किं भीमः सपरश्लीघी किं नु कृष्णार्जुनाविति॥ विवक्षितं किमस्येति संशयः सुमहानभूत्। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् युधिष्ठिरकृते तदा।॥ सोऽवगाह्य चमूं शत्रोः शरशक्तिसमाकुलाम्। भीष्ममेवाभ्ययात् तूर्णं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥ तमुवाच ततः पादौ कराभ्यां पीड्य पाण्डवः। भीष्मं शान्तनवं राजा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्॥
answer: What will Bhima who is ever boastful of his prowess in battle and what Krishna and Arjuna say? What has Yudhishthira to say? O great king, the curiosity of both the armies in respect of Yudhishthira was great. (In the mean time) the king entered the hostile army full of arrows and darts. He then quickly proceeded towards Bhishma, surrounded by his brothers. Seizing his feet with his two hands, the king (Yudhishthira), the son of Pandu, then thus spoke to Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, who was then ready for battle.

question: यदाश्रौषं घोषयात्रागतानां बन्धं गंधर्वैर्मोक्षणं चार्जुनेन। स्वेषां सुतानां कर्णबुद्धौ रतानां तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
answer: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that my sons were taken prisoners by the Gandharvas their journey to Ghoshayatra, but were rescued by Arjuna.

question: पराङ्मुखवधं कृत्वा कोऽत्र प्राप्तस्त्वया गुणः। यदहं युद्धसंरब्धस्त्वत्कृते निधनं गतः॥
answer: What merit have you reaped by destroying me, who was not engaged in fight with you? I was exercised with ire, being engaged in conflict (with another person) and for you I have met with destruction.

question: एवं ब्रुवन्तीं बहुशः परिष्वज्य समर्थ्य च। इति चेति च कर्तव्यं राजा सर्वमथादिश॥
answer: And when she said thus repeatedly, the king encouraged and embraced her and then instructed her minutely as to what she ought to do.

question: शयानं धार्तराष्ट्रं तु सलिले स्तम्भिते तदा॥ पाण्डवाः सह कृष्णेन वाग्भिरुयाभिरादयन्।
answer: While resting at the bottom of the lake after solidifying its waters, Duryodhana approached by the Pandavas with Krishna and cut to the quick by their cruel words. are was

question: एवमुक्त्वा वचः सौम्यं प्रत्युत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः। उभौ मुनिवरौ राजा जनको वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
answer: Having said these amiable words, king' Janaka arose, and with clasped hands addressed both the foremost of ascetics, saying.

question: ततः प्रक्षाल्यमानेषु मत्स्येषु विपुले जले। मुक्त्वा रज्जु प्रमुक्तोऽसौ शीघ्रं सम्प्रतिपत्तिमान्॥
answer: They then removed them to a deep, water for washing them, Just then the Shakula known for presence of mind, left the string, and quickly escaped.

question: प्रजापतीनां षण्णां तु चतुर्थोऽयं प्रजापतिः। मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्य इति विश्रुतः॥
answer: Pulastya is the fourth of the six Prajāpatīs, (Prajāpatis are the lords of the created being first created by Brahmā.) a mind-born son of Brahmā and celebrated in the world.

question: अयं च पुत्रोऽतिबलस्तव रावण वीर्यवान्। जगतीन्द्रजिदित्येव परिख्यातो भविष्यति॥
answer: O Rāvana, this your son is highly powerful and gifted with great strength and he shall be celebrated in the world under the appellation of 'Indrajit' or the conqueror of Indra.

question: भूत्वैकाग्रमना विप्र उर्ध्वबाहुः समाहितः। स्तोत्रं जगौ स विश्वाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने॥
answer: With rapt mind, the twice-born Rishi, with arms upraised, stood in Yoga, and then sang the following hymn to the Lord of the universe, Him, viz., who is at once the soul of attributes and divested of ali attributes.

question: कृपणं त्वामभिप्रेक्ष्य सिद्धचारणसेविता। मया विनिहतं देवी रोदतामद्य पार्थिव॥
answer: O ruler of the earth, let your mothe worshipped by Siddhas and Charanas seeing yourself slain by me, weep today.

question: सहस्रहंसयुक्तेन विमानेन तु गच्छति। स गत्वा स्त्रीशताकीर्णं रमते भरतर्षभ॥
answer: Such a person rides on a car drawn by a thousand swans. Living, again, in a region teeming with hundreds of the most beautiful ladies, he passes his time in great joy.

question: एवमुक्ता तु रामेण बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा॥ कौसल्या पुत्रशोकार्ता रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।
answer: Being thus accosted by Rāma, Kausalyā being distressed with the thought of separation from her son, spoke to him with tears in her eyes the following words.

question: रथान् मण्डलचक्रांश्च योजयित्वा परः शतम्। उष्ट्रगोऽश्वखरै त्या भरतं यान्तमन्वयुः॥
answer: Thereat servants by means of an hundred cars, furnished with circular wheels, and yoked with camels, oxen, horses, and asses, followed Bharata.

question: शिलाभिः शङ्कभिर्वापि शुभैर्वा भरतर्षभ। ये मार्गमनुरुन्धन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
answer: They who obstruct paths and roads with stones and thorns and holes have to sink in hell.

question: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्। आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा।२९।। पन्नगैः सुमहाकायैर्वेष्टितं लोमहर्षणैः। येषां निःश्वासवातेन प्रदीप्तमिव संयुगे॥
answer: In the interval the heroic and the highly powerful Daśagrīva ascended the celestial car, constructed by the Architect of the deities, encircled by the huge-bodied serpents capable of making down erect and by whose breath the battle-field was ablaze.

question: चतुर्भुजे चतुर्वक्त्रे पीनश्रोणिपयोधरे। मयूरपिच्छवलये केयूराङ्गदधारिणि।
answer: I salute you, O you of four hands and four faces, O you that have large hips and a very high-boom, O you that wears bangles and bears arınlets.

question: सुहृदां यतमानानामाप्तैः सह चिकित्सकैः। जगामास्तमिवादित्यः कौरव्यो यमसादनम्॥
answer: His friends and relatives tried to effect a cure in consultation with the physicians, but (in spite of all their efforts), the Kuru prince went to the abode of Yama like a setting son.

question: तत्र पुण्येषु तीर्थेषु साऽऽप्लुताङ्गी दिवानिशम्। व्यचरत् काशिकन्या सा यथाकामविचारिणी॥
answer: And there, in the sacred waters of pilgrimages, she bathed herself night and day, and that daughter of the lord of Kashi roamed about, fierce as she was, according to her desire.

question: न राज्यलाभो विपुलः शत्रूणां च पराभवः। प्रीतिं धास्यति पार्थानां त्वामृते पुष्करेक्षण॥
answer: Neither the acquisition of a vast territory, nor the discomfitures of their foes, gives joy to the Parthas bereft of you, O lotus-eyed one.

question: विधिहीनस्य यज्ञस्य सद्यः कर्ता विनश्यति। तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते॥
answer: The performer thereof speedily perishes, should anything take place not consonant to the ordinance. And do you possessed of ability so arrange, that this sacrifice may be completed in harmony with the ritual.

question: एवं बहुविधै रूपैश्चरामीह वसुन्धराम्। ब्रह्मलोकं च कौन्तेय गोलोकं च सनातनम्॥ मया त्वं रक्षितो युद्धे महान्तं प्राप्तवाञ्जयम्।
answer: In this way, O son of Kunti, assuming various forms do I rove at will, through the Earth, the region of Brahman himself, and that other high and eternal region of happiness called Goloka. Protected by me in the great battle, you have acquired a great victory.

question: हयेषु पतितेष्वस्य चिच्छेद परमेषुणा। युधामन्युर्धनुः शीघ्रं शरावापं च संयुगे॥ हताश्वसूतात् स रथादवतीर्य नराधिपः। गदामादाय ते पुत्रः पाञ्चाल्यावभ्यधावत॥
answer: Then that foremost of warriors Duryodhana, jumping down from his chariot of which the steeds were slain rushed at the Panchala princes with a mace in his grasp.

question: सुखं प्रतिप्रबुद्धानामिन्द्रियाण्युपलक्षये। स भवान् सुहृदोऽस्माकमथवा न: पिता भवान्॥
answer: Their organs of sense indicate as if they have awakened from an agreeable slumber. Are you a friend of ours or are you our father himself?

question: ददर्श वासविर्धीमान् विहीनां वृष्णिपुङ्गवैः। गतश्रियं निरानन्दा पद्मिनी शिशिरे यथा॥
answer: Indeed, the son of Vasava, gifted with great intelligence, beheld the city to look even thus, reft as it was of the Vrishni heroes.
